track the target position more stiffly.

AnimationTrack.summary: Controls the playback of an animation on an `Animator`.

members.name: Animation

members.summary:

`AnimationTrack`. This will return `0` until the animation has fully

members.summary:
Sets whether the animation will repeat after finishing. If it is changed

members.summary:
Sets the priority of an `AnimationTrack`. Depending on what this is
set to, playing multiple animations at once will look to this property to

one another.

members.name: Speed
members.summary:
Read-only property that gives the current playback speed of the
`AnimationTrack`.

members.name: TimePosition
members.summary:
Returns the position in time in seconds that an `AnimationTrack` is
through playing its source animation. Can be set to make the track jump to
a specific moment in the animation.

members.name: WeightCurrent
members.summary:
Read-only property that gives the current weight of the
`AnimationTrack`.

members.name: WeightTarget
members.summary:
Read-only property that gives the current weight of the
`AnimationTrack`.

members.name: AdjustSpeed
AdjustWeight
members.summary:

determining how long it takes for `AnimationTrack.WeightCurrent` to

members.name: GetMarkerReachedSignal
members.summary:

members.name: GetTimeOfKeyframe
members.summary:

members.name: Play
members.summary:
Plays the `AnimationTrack`. Once called an `AnimationTrack`
will play with the specified `fadeTime`, weight and speed.

members.name: SetParameter
members.summary:
Sets a parameter value on the animation graph, driving animation graph
node inputs.

members.name: Stop
members.summary: Stops the `AnimationTrack`.

members.name: DidLoop
members.summary:
Fires when an `AnimationTrack` loops on the next update following
the end of the previous animation loop.

members.name: Ended
members.summary:
Fires when the `AnimationTrack` is completely done moving anything
in the world.

members.name: KeyframeReached
members.summary:
Fires every time playback of an `AnimationTrack` reaches a
`Keyframe` that does not have the default name of `Keyframe`.

members.name: Stopped
members.summary:
Fires when the `AnimationTrack` finishes playing. The AnimationTrack
might still animate the subject while the animation "fades out". To catch
when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world,
use the `AnimationTrack.Ended` event.

Atmosphere.summary:
The `Atmosphere` object pushes Roblox closer toward realistic
environments where sunlight scatters in different ways depending on density
and other air particle properties.

members.name: Color
members.summary: Changes the `Atmosphere` hue for subtle environmental moods.

members.name: Decay
members.summary:
When used with increased `Atmosphere.Haze` and
`Atmosphere.Glare`, defines the hue of the `Atmosphere` away
from the sun, gradually falling off from `Atmosphere.Color` towards
this value.

members.name: Density
members.summary:
Defines the amount of particles in the `Atmosphere` and essentially
controls how much in-game objects/terrain will be obscured by them.

members.name: Glare
members.summary:
When used with increased `Atmosphere.Haze`, specifies the glow/glare
of the `Atmosphere` around the sun. More glare results in an
increased effect of sunlight cast onto the sky and world.

members.name: Haze
members.summary:
Defines the haziness of the `Atmosphere` with a visible effect both
above the horizon and into the distance.

members.name: Offset
members.summary: Controls how light transmits between the camera and the sky background.

Explosion.summary:
Applies force to `BaseParts` within the explosion's
`Explosion.BlastRadius`. Breaks `JointInstances` and
`WeldConstraints` between parts and kills
`Humanoid` characters not protected by a `ForceField`.

members.name: BlastPressure
members.summary:
Used to determine the amount of force applied to
`BaseParts` caught in the `Explosion.BlastRadius`.

members.name: BlastRadius
members.summary:
This property determines the radius of the `Explosion`, in studs.
This radius determines the area of effect of the explosion, not the size
of the explosion's visuals.

members.name: DestroyJointRadiusPercent
members.summary:
Used to set the proportion of the `Explosion.BlastRadius`, between 0
and 1, within which all joints will be destroyed. Anything outside of this
range will only have the `Explosion` force applied to it.

members.name: ExplosionType
members.summary:
This property determines how the `Explosion` will interact with
`Terrain`. Used to set if explosions will cause damage to the
terrain or not.

members.name: LocalTransparencyModifier
members.summary:
A multiplier for the transparency of the `Explosion` visual effect
that is only visible to the local client.

members.name: Position
members.summary:
This property is the position of the center of the `Explosion`. It
is defined in world-space and not influenced by the `Explosion`
parent.

members.name: TimeScale
members.summary: Value between 0 and 1 that controls the speed of the particle effect.

members.name: Visible
members.summary:
This property determines whether or not the visual effect of an
`Explosion` is shown or not.

members.name: Hit
members.summary:
Fires when the `Explosion` hits a `BasePart` within its
`Explosion.BlastRadius`. Returns the part hit along with the
distance of the part from `Explosion.Position`.

members.name: AddSelectionTuple
members.summary:
**AddSelectionTuple** works similarly to
`GuiService:AddSelectionParent()`, but you can give it a tuple of
`GuiObject` that you want to be contained in the group.

Beware that the second argument is _not_ a table, but rather the first of
several `GuiObject` in the tuple. To pass the contents of a table,
use `unpack`/`table.unpack`:

```lua
local frame = script.Parent
-- Passing various GuiObject individually
GuiService:AddSelectionTuple("InventoryButtons", frame.Sort, frame.Trash, frame.Drop)
-- Unpacking a table of GuiObject (unpack/table.unpack are equivalent)
local inventoryButtons = { frame.Sort, frame.Trash, frame.Drop }
GuiService:AddSelectionTuple("InventoryButtons", unpack(inventoryButtons))
```

HingeConstraint.summary: Constrains its attachments to rotate about a single axis.

members.summary:

if so, what kind of actuation it uses.

members.name: AngularResponsiveness
members.summary:
Specifies the sharpness of the servo motor in reaching the
`TargetAngle`.

members.name: AngularSpeed
members.summary:
The desired angular speed a `HingeConstraint` with
`ActuatorType` set to
`Servo` will attempt to maintain while rotating towards
its `TargetAngle`. Measured in
radians/second.

members.name: AngularVelocity
members.summary:
The angular velocity a `HingeConstraint` with
`ActuatorType` set to
`Motor` will attempt to achieve. Measured in
radians/second.

members.name: CurrentAngle

members.name: LimitsEnabled
members.summary: Sets whether the `HingeConstraint` will limit the range of rotation.

members.name: LowerAngle
members.summary:
The minimum rotation angle the `HingeConstraint` will allow if
`LimitsEnabled` is true.

members.name: MotorMaxAcceleration
members.summary:
The maximum angular acceleration a `HingeConstraint` with
`ActuatorType` set to
`Motor` can apply to achieve its
`AngularVelocity`. Measured in
radians/second².

members.name: MotorMaxTorque
members.summary:
The maximum torque a `HingeConstraint` with
`ActuatorType` set to
`Motor` can apply when trying to reach its desired
`AngularVelocity`.

members.name: Radius
members.summary: The visualized radius of the `HingeConstraint`.

members.name: Restitution
members.summary:
How elastic `Attachment` connected by a `HingeConstraint` will

`LimitsEnabled` is true. Constrained

members.name: ServoMaxTorque
members.summary:
The maximum torque a `HingeConstraint` with
`ActuatorType` set to
`Servo` can apply when trying to reach its desired
`TargetAngle`.

members.name: TargetAngle
members.summary:
The target angle a `HingeConstraint` will attempt to rotate to if
its `ActuatorType` is set to
`Servo`. Measured in degrees.

members.name: UpperAngle

`LimitsEnabled` is true.

Humanoid.summary: A special object that gives models the functionality of a character.

A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as

to its back (such as capes).

members.summary:
Determines the factor by which the shape of a `Humanoid` is

`Climbing`.

members.summary:

members.name: Face

members.name: FaceAccessory
members.summary:
A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as
`Accessories` to a `Humanoid` rig when
`applied`, usually those attached
to the front of its face (such as glasses).

members.name: FallAnimation
members.summary:
When this description is `applied`
to a `Humanoid`, this determines the `Animation.AnimationId`
to play when its `state` is
`Freefall`.

members.name: FrontAccessory
members.summary:
A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as
`Accessories` to a `Humanoid` rig when
`applied`, usually those attached
to front of its torso (such as medals or ties).

A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as
`Accessories` to a `Humanoid` rig when
`applied`, usually those attached
to its head resembling hair.

members.name: HatAccessory
members.summary:
A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as
`Accessories` to a `Humanoid` rig when
`applied`, usually those attached
to its head.

IKControl.summary:
Specifies a control to generate a procedural animation pose using Inverse
Kinematics.

members.name: ChainRoot
members.summary:
The last part that you are interested in moving your character. For
example, the upper arm. Must be an ancestor of
`EndEffector` and be a `BasePart` or a
`Bone` in your character.

members.name: Enabled
members.summary: Toggles the control on and off. True by default.

members.name: EndEffector
members.summary:
The part that you are interested in moving to reach the
`Target`. For example, the hand of your character.
Must be a descendant of `ChainRoot` and be a
`BasePart` or a `Bone` in your character.

members.name: EndEffectorOffset
members.summary:
An additional offset applied on top of the
`EndEffector` in its local space to change
where it moves.

members.name: Offset
members.summary:
An additional offset applied on top of the `Target`
to change where the `EndEffector` moves.

members.name: Pole
members.summary:
An optional instance that determines which way the chain bends. You can
use this to specify which way an elbow or knee bends.

members.name: Priority
members.summary:
Specifies the order in which controls are solved. Higher values have
higher priority.

members.name: SmoothTime
members.summary:
Specifies the average number of seconds that it takes for the
`EndEffector` to smoothly reach the
`Target`.

members.name: Target
members.summary:
The object that the `EndEffector` reaches for
or points at. It can be anything that has a position in the world, such as
`BasePart`, `Attachment`, `Bone`, or `Motor6D`.

members.name: Type
members.summary: Specifies how the solver satisfies this control.

members.name: Weight
members.summary:
Specifies the weight of the IK control target. Should be in the [0, 1]
range.

members.name: GetChainCount
members.summary:
Returns the number of segments in the IK chain between the
`ChainRoot` and the
`EndEffector`.

members.name: GetChainLength
members.summary:
Returns the total length, in studs, of the IK chain between the
`ChainRoot` and the
`EndEffector`.

members.name: GetNodeLocalCFrame
members.summary:
Returns the `CFrame` of the chain node at the given index,
relative to its parent node in the chain.

members.name: GetNodeWorldCFrame
members.summary:
Returns the world-space `CFrame` of the chain node at the given
index.

members.name: GetRawFinalTarget
members.summary:
Returns the world-space target `CFrame` the solver aims for
before `SmoothTime` smoothing is applied.

members.name: GetSmoothedFinalTarget
members.summary:
Returns the world-space target `CFrame` the solver aims for after
`SmoothTime` smoothing is applied.

be.

Lighting.summary:
The `Lighting` service controls global lighting in an experience. It includes
a range of adjustable properties that you can use to change how lighting

The lighting hue applied to areas that are occluded from the sky, such as

members.summary:
A numerical representation (in hours) of the current time of day used by

members.summary:
The hue represented in light reflected in the opposite surfaces to those
facing the sun or moon.

members.name: ColorShift_Top

The hue represented in light reflected from surfaces facing the sun or
moon.

members.name: EnvironmentDiffuseScale
members.summary: Ambient light that is derived from the environment.

members.name: EnvironmentSpecularScale
members.summary: Specular light derived from environment.

members.name: ExposureCompensation
members.summary: The exposure compensation value.

members.name: FogColor
members.summary: A `Color3` value giving the hue of `Lighting` fog.

members.name: FogEnd

The depth from the `Workspace.CurrentCamera`, in studs, at which fog
will be completely opaque.

members.name: FogStart
members.summary:
The depth from the `Workspace.CurrentCamera`, in studs, at which fog
begins to show.

members.summary:
The geographic latitude, in degrees, of the scene, influencing the result
of `Lighting` time on the position of the sun and moon.

members.name: LightingStyle

members.summary: The lighting hue applied to outdoor areas.

members.summary:
This is supposed to change the color of player shadows, but currently

members.name: ShadowSoftness

A 24-hour string representation of the current time of day used by

LineForce.summary:
Applies a force along the theoretical line connecting its two
`Attachments`.

members.name: ApplyAtCenterOfMass
members.summary: Whether force is applied at the center of mass of the parent assembly.

members.name: InverseSquareLaw
members.summary:
When `true`, the force magnitude is multiplied by the inverse square of
the distance.

members.name: Magnitude
members.summary: The magnitude of the force.

members.name: MaxForce
members.summary: Maximum absolute force that can be applied.

members.name: ReactionForceEnabled
members.summary:
Enables an equal and opposite reaction force on the parent of
`Attachment1`.

LineHandleAdornment.summary: A line-shaped handle that can be adorned to a `BasePart`.

members.name: Length
members.summary: Length of the line.

members.name: Thickness
members.summary: Thickness of the line in pixels.

LinearVelocity.summary: Applies force on an assembly to maintain a constant linear velocity.

members.name: ForceLimitMode
members.summary: Determines how the constraint force will be limited.

members.name: ForceLimitsEnabled
members.summary:
Determines if the constraint force will be limited or if the physics
solver can apply an unlimited force to achieve the target velocity.

members.name: LineDirection
members.summary:
The normalized `Vector3` direction for constraining the velocity
along a line.

members.name: LineVelocity
members.summary:
Float value of the velocity when
`VelocityConstraintMode` is
set to `Line`.

members.name: MaxAxesForce
members.summary:
Maximum force along each axis that the constraint can apply to achieve the
vector velocity. Only used if
`ForceLimitsEnabled` is `true`,
`ForceLimitMode` is
`PerAxis`, and
`VelocityConstraintMode` is
`Vector`.

members.name: MaxForce
members.summary: Maximum magnitude of the force vector the constraint can apply.

members.name: MaxPlanarAxesForce
members.summary:
Maximum force along each axis that the constraint can apply to achieve the
plane velocity. Only used if
`ForceLimitsEnabled` is `true`,
`ForceLimitMode` is
`PerAxis`, and
`VelocityConstraintMode` is
`Plane`.

members.name: PlaneVelocity
members.summary:
`Vector2` value of the velocity in each tangent direction of the
plane.

members.name: PrimaryTangentAxis
members.summary:
The primary axis in the plane, when
`VelocityConstraintMode` is
set to `Plane`.

members.name: ReactionForceEnabled
members.summary:
Determines whether an equal and opposite reaction force is also applied to
the assembly of `Attachment1` when
`RelativeTo` is
`Attachment1`.

members.name: RelativeTo
members.summary: Sets the `ActuatorRelativeTo` property for the constraint.

members.name: SecondaryTangentAxis
members.summary:
The secondary axis in the plane, when
`VelocityConstraintMode` is
set to `Plane`.

members.name: VectorVelocity
members.summary:
`Vector3` velocity value when
`VelocityConstraintMode` is
set to `Vector`.

members.name: VelocityConstraintMode
members.summary: The mode of the constraint.

LocalizationTable.summary:
A LocalizationTable is a database of translations. It contains source strings
and translations for various languages.

The default IETF tag to use if the ''languageKey'' parameter is excluded
from the `LocalizationTable:GetString()` method.

members.name: Root
members.summary:
The object that is being targeted for localization by this table.
Localization is applied to it and all of it's descendants.

members.name: SourceLocaleId
members.summary: The locale of source strings.

members.name: GetContents
members.summary:
Returns the contents of the `LocalizationTable` serialized as a JSON

members.summary:
Returns an array of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents an
entry of localization data.

members.name: GetString
members.summary: Returns a translation based on the specified language and key.

Returns a `Translator` for entries in this LocalizationTable, in the

`source`, and `context` to narrow down the specific entry to be removed.

specific entry to be removed.

members.name: RemoveKey
members.summary: Deprecated in favor of `LocalizationTable:RemoveEntry()`.

members.summary:

localeId.

members.summary: Sets the contents of the LocalizationTable, via the legacy JSON format.

members.name: SetEntries
members.summary: Sets the contents of the LocalizationTable.

members.summary:
Sets the translation `text` for the `targetLocaleId` locale on the entry
identified by `key`, creating the entry if it doesn't exist.

members.summary:

members.summary:

using the specified `key`, `source`, and `context` to narrow down the
entry that will have this change applied.

members.name: SetEntryKey
members.summary:
Sets the **Key** field of a LocalizationTable entry to `newKey`, using the
specified `key`, `source`, and `context` to narrow down the entry that
will have this change applied.

members.name: SetEntryValue
members.summary:
Sets the text of the specified localeId in a LocalizationTable entry,

Model.summary:
Models are container objects, meaning they group objects together. They are
best used to hold collections of `BaseParts` and have a number
of functions that extend their functionality.

members.name: LevelOfDetail
members.summary:
Sets the level of detail on the model for experiences with instance
streaming enabled.

members.name: ModelStreamingMode
members.summary:
Controls the model streaming behavior on `Models` when
instance streaming is enabled.

members.name: PrimaryPart
members.summary: The primary part of the `Model`, or `nil` if not explicitly set.

members.name: WorldPivot
members.summary:
Determines where the pivot of a `Model` which does **not** have a
set `Model.PrimaryPart` is located.

members.name: AddPersistentPlayer
members.summary:
Sets this model to be persistent for the specified player.
`ModelStreamingMode` must be set to
`PersistentPerPlayer` for behavior to be changed
as a result of addition.

members.name: BreakJoints
members.summary:
Breaks connections between `BaseParts`, including surface connections with
any adjacent parts, `WeldConstraints` and all
`Welds` and other `JointInstances`.

members.name: GetBoundingBox
members.summary: Returns a description of a volume that contains all parts of a Model.

members.name: GetExtentsSize
members.summary:
Returns the size of the smallest bounding box that contains all of the
`BaseParts` in the `Model`, aligned with the
`Model.PrimaryPart` if it is set.

members.name: GetModelCFrame
members.summary:
This value historically returned the CFrame of a central position in the
model.

members.name: GetModelSize
members.summary: Returns the Vector3 size of the Model.

members.name: GetPersistentPlayers
members.summary:
Returns all the `Player` objects that this model object is
persistent for. Behavior varies based on whether this method is called
from a `Script` or a `LocalScript`.

members.name: GetPrimaryPartCFrame
members.summary:
Returns the `CFrame` of the model's `Model.PrimaryPart`.
This function will throw an error if no primary part exists for the
`Model`.

members.name: GetScale
members.summary:
Returns the canonical scale of the model, which defaults to 1 for newly
created models and will change as it is scaled via
`Model:ScaleTo()`.

members.name: MakeJoints
members.summary:
Goes through all `BaseParts` in the `Model`. If any
part's side has a SurfaceType that can make a joint it will create a joint
with any adjacent parts.

members.name: MoveTo
members.summary:
Moves the `PrimaryPart` to the given position. If
a primary part has not been specified, the root part of the model will be
used.

members.name: RemovePersistentPlayer
members.summary:
Makes this model no longer persistent for the specified player.
`ModelStreamingMode` must be set to
`PersistentPerPlayer` for behavior to be changed
as a result of removal.

members.name: ResetOrientationToIdentity
members.summary:
Resets the rotation of the model's parts to the previously set identity
rotation, which is done through the `Model:SetIdentityOrientation()`
method.

members.name: ScaleTo
members.summary:
Sets the scale factor of the model, adjusting the sizing and location of
all descendant Instances such that they have that scale factor relative to
their initial sizes and locations when scale factor was 1.

members.name: SetIdentityOrientation
members.summary:
Sets the identity rotation of the given model, allowing you to reset the
rotation of the entire model later, through the use of the
`ResetOrientationToIdentity` method.

members.name: SetPrimaryPartCFrame
members.summary:
Sets the `BasePart.CFrame` of the model's `Model.PrimaryPart`.
All other parts in the model will also be moved and will maintain their
orientation and offset respective to the `Model.PrimaryPart`.

members.name: TranslateBy
members.summary:
Shifts a `Model` by the given `Vector3` offset, preserving
the model's orientation. If another `BasePart` or `Terrain`
already exists at the new position then the `Model` will overlap
said object.

members.summary:
Determines the global-axis acceleration of all active particles, measured

members.name: Brightness
members.summary:
Scales the light emitted from the emitter when

members.name: Color
members.summary:
Determines the color of all active particles over their individual
lifetimes.

members.name: Drag
members.summary:
Determines the rate at which particles will lose half their speed through
exponential decay.

members.name: EmissionDirection
members.summary: Determines the face of the object that particles emit from.

members.name: Enabled
members.summary: Determines if particles emit from the emitter.

members.name: FlipbookBlendFrames
members.summary: Determines whether the flipbook frames are blended between.

members.name: FlipbookFramerate
members.summary: Determines how fast the flipbook texture animates in frames per second.

members.name: FlipbookIncompatible
members.summary:
The error message to display if the
`Texture` is incompatible for a flipbook.

members.name: FlipbookLayout
members.summary:
Determines the layout of the flipbook texture. Must be None, Grid2x2,
Grid4x4, Grid8x8 or Custom.

members.name: FlipbookMode
members.summary:
Determines the type of the flipbook animation. Must be Loop, OneShot,
PingPong, or Random.

members.name: FlipbookSizeX

members.name: FlipbookSizeY

members.name: FlipbookStartRandom
members.summary:

members.name: Lifetime
members.summary: Defines a random range of ages for newly emitted particles.

members.name: LightEmission
members.summary:

them.

members.name: LightInfluence
members.summary: Determines how much particles are influenced by the environmental light.

members.name: LocalTransparencyModifier
members.summary:
Determines a multiplier for `ParticleEmitter.Transparency` that is

members.name: LockedToPart
members.summary:
Determines whether the particles rigidly move with the part they're being

members.name: Orientation
members.summary: Specifies how to orient particles.

members.name: Rate
members.summary: Determines the number of particles emitted per second.

members.name: Rotation
members.summary: Determines the range of rotations in degrees for newly emitted particles.

members.name: RotSpeed
members.summary:
Determines the range of angular speeds of emitted particles, measured in
degrees per second.

members.name: Shape
members.summary: Sets the shape of the emitter to either a box, sphere, cylinder, or disc.

members.name: ShapeInOut
members.summary:

directions.

members.name: ShapePartial
members.summary: Influences particle emission from cylinder, disc, sphere, and box shapes.

members.name: ShapeStyle
members.summary: Sets particle emission to either volumetric or surface-only emission.

members.name: Size
members.summary: Determines the world size over individual particles' lifetimes.

members.name: Speed
members.summary:
Determines a random range of velocities (minimum to maximum) at which new
particles will emit, measured in studs per second.

members.name: SpreadAngle
members.summary:
Determines the angles at which particles may be randomly emit, measured in
degrees.

members.name: Squash
members.summary:

members.name: Texture
members.summary: Determines the image rendered on particles.

members.name: TextureContent
members.summary:

[asset URIs](../../../projects/assets/index.md#asset-uris).

members.name: TimeScale
members.summary: Value between 0 and 1 that controls the speed of the particle effect.

members.name: Transparency

members.name: VelocityInheritance
members.summary:

PhysicsSettings.summary:
Lets you view debugging features in Roblox's physics engine, found under the
Physics tab in Studio's settings menu.

members.name: AllowSleep
members.summary:
When set to true, physically simulated objects will stop being simulated
if they have little to no motion for a set period of time.

members.name: AreAnchorsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, parts that are `BasePart.Anchored` will show a
gray surface outline on the surface of the part's bounding box that is
currently facing the ground.

members.name: AreAssembliesShown
members.summary:
When set to true, each physics assembly is assigned a unique color and the
`Part` associated with the assembly are outlined with the color.
Parts that are attached together by `JointInstance` will share the
same color.

members.name: AreAwakePartsHighlighted
members.summary:
When set to true, parts that are actively being physically simulated will
have a red outline.

members.name: AreBodyTypesShown
members.summary:
When set to true, `Part` will be outlined with a specific color,
depending on the state of its root simulation body.

members.name: AreContactIslandsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, each contact island will render `SelectionBox`
adorns on the parts in contact islands, where each contact island is
assigned a random color.

members.name: AreContactPointsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, sphere adorns will be drawn at the contact points of
each part where physics interactions are occurring.

members.name: AreJointCoordinatesShown
members.summary:
When set to true, XYZ axes are rendered at the `BasePart.CFrame` of
every part.

members.name: AreMechanismsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, every individual mechanism of parts is given a unique
color.

members.name: AreModelCoordsShown
members.summary:
An ancient property that hasn't work correctly since late 2007. It's
supposed to render an XYZ axis on the root part of a `Model`, but
the axis rendering component doesn't work correctly.

members.name: AreNonAnchorsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, parts that are not `BasePart.Anchored` will be
highlighted.

members.name: AreOwnersShown
members.summary:
When set to true, each player's character is outlined with a unique color,
and each part that the player has network ownership over is outlined with
the same color.

members.name: ArePartCoordsShown
members.summary:
An ancient property that hasn't worked correctly since late 2007. It's
supposed to render a large XYZ axis in the center of each
`BasePart`, but the axis rendering component doesn't work correctly.

members.name: AreRegionsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, a cylinder is drawn around each player's character,
representing their `Player.SimulationRadius`.

members.name: AreTerrainReplicationRegionsShown
members.summary: When set to true, shows terrain replication streaming regions.

members.name: AreUnalignedPartsShown
members.summary:
When set to true, parts that aren't aligned on the 1x1x1 grid will be
outlined yellow.

members.name: AreWorldCoordsShown
members.summary:
An ancient property that hasn't worked correctly since late 2007. It's
supposed to render a large XYZ axis in the center of the world, but the
axis rendering component doesn't work correctly.

members.name: DisableCSGv2
members.summary:
When set to true, Roblox will fall back to using its legacy CSG solver
when performing solid model operations.

members.name: DisableCSGv3ForPlugins
members.summary: When set to true, disables CSGv3 for plugin solid modeling operations.

members.name: ForceCSGv2
members.summary: When set to true, forces the use of CSGv2 for solid modeling operations.

members.name: IsInterpolationThrottleShown
members.summary: When set to true, shows physics interpolation throttle information.

members.name: IsReceiveAgeShown
members.summary:
This property is supposed to show the `BasePart.ReceiveAge` of a
part, but it does not work correctly.

members.name: IsTreeShown
members.summary:
When set to true, the joint connections of each part, and the states of
their underlying primitive components are visualized as a spanning tree.

members.name: PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle
members.summary: Controls the throttle rate of Roblox's physics engine.

members.name: ShowDecompositionGeometry
members.summary:
When set to true, the underlying collision geometry for
`PartOperation` and `MeshPart` is rendered.

members.name: ThrottleAdjustTime
members.summary:
If the `PhysicsSettings.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle` is set to
`DefaultAuto`, this specifies the maximum time that the physics
environmental throttle has to wait before it is allowed to automatically
change.

members.name: UseCSGv2
members.summary:
If set to true, version 2 of Roblox's CSG solver will be used instead of
version 1.

Plane.summary:

The lower positional limit along the **X** axis of

members.summary:
The constraint's maximum acceleration when

The constraint's maximum force when
`ActuatorType` is set to

Sound.summary:
An object that emits sound. This object can be placed within a
`BasePart` or `Attachment` to emit a sound from a particular
position within a place or world, or it can be attached elsewhere to play the
sound at a constant volume throughout the entire place.

members.name: AudioContent
members.summary: A reference to an audio asset.

members.name: EmitterSize
members.summary:
The minimum distance, in studs, at which a 3D `Sound` (direct child
of a `BasePart` or `Attachment`) will begin to attenuate
(decrease in volume).

members.name: IsLoaded
members.summary:
This property is `true` when the `Sound` has loaded from Roblox
servers and is ready to play.

members.name: IsPaused
members.summary:
Read-only property which returns `true` when the `Sound` is not
playing.

members.name: IsPlaying
members.summary: Read-only property which returns `true` when the `Sound` is playing.

members.name: Looped
members.summary:
Sets whether or not the `Sound` repeats once it has finished
playing.

members.name: LoopRegion
members.summary:
A range denoting a desired loop start and loop end within the
`PlaybackRegion`, in seconds.

members.name: MaxDistance
members.summary:
The maximum distance, in studs, a client's listener can be from the
`Sound\s` origin and still hear it. Only applies to Sounds
parented to a `Part` or `Attachment` (3D sounds).

members.name: MinDistance
members.summary:
The minimum distance at which a 3D `Sound` (direct child of a
`BasePart` or `Attachment`) will begin to attenuate.
Effectively, the emitter size.

members.name: Pitch
members.summary:
Sets how high pitched and fast a `Sound` is when it is played. The
greater the integer, the higher and faster the `Sound` is.

members.name: PlaybackLoudness
members.summary:
A number between `0` and `1000` indicating how loud the `Sound` is
currently playing back.

members.name: PlaybackRegion
members.summary:
A range denoting a desired start and stop time within the
`TimeLength`, in seconds.

members.name: PlaybackRegionsEnabled
members.summary:
If `true`, this property gives your `Sound` access to the
`PlaybackRegion` and
`LoopRegion` properties which can more-accurately
control its playback.

members.name: PlaybackSpeed
members.summary:
Determines the speed at which a `Sound` will play, with higher
values causing the sound to play faster and at a higher pitch.

members.name: Playing
members.summary: Indicates whether the `Sound` is currently playing.

members.name: PlayOnRemove
members.summary:
When `true`, the `Sound` will play when it is removed from the
experience.

members.name: RollOffMaxDistance
members.summary:
The maximum distance, in studs, a client's listener can be from the
sound's origin and still hear it. Only applies to `Sounds`
parented to a `BasePart` or `Attachment`.

members.name: RollOffMinDistance
members.summary:
The minimum distance, in studs, at which a `Sound` which is parented
to a `BasePart` or `Attachment` will begin to attenuate
(decrease in volume).

members.name: RollOffMode
members.summary:
Controls how the volume of a `Sound` which is parented to a
`BasePart` or `Attachment` attenuates (fades out) as the
distance between the listener and parent changes.

members.name: SoundGroup
members.summary: The `SoundGroup` that is linked to this `Sound`.

members.name: SoundId
members.summary: Content ID of the sound file to associate with the `Sound`.

members.name: TimeLength
members.summary: The length of the `Sound` in seconds.

members.name: TimePosition
members.summary:
Progress of the `Sound` in seconds. Can be changed to move the
playback position of the `Sound` both before and during playback.

members.name: Volume
members.summary: The volume of the `Sound`.

members.name: Pause
members.summary: Pauses playback of the `Sound` if it is playing.

members.name: Play
members.summary: Plays the `Sound`.

members.name: Resume
members.summary: Resumes the `Sound`.

members.name: Stop
members.summary: Stops the `Sound`.

members.name: DidLoop
members.summary: Fires whenever the `Sound` loops.

members.name: Ended
members.summary: Fires when the `Sound` has completed playback and stopped.

members.name: Loaded
members.summary: Fires when the `Sound` is loaded.

members.name: Paused
members.summary:
Fires whenever the `Sound` is paused using
`Pause()`.

members.name: Played
members.summary:
Fires whenever the `Sound` is played using
`Play()`.

members.name: Resumed
members.summary:
Fires when the `Sound` is resumed using
`Resume()`.

members.name: Stopped
members.summary:
Fires when the `Sound` is stopped through using
`Stop()`.

members.name: AcousticSimulationEnabled

members.name: AmbientReverb

members.name: CharacterSoundsUseNewApi

members.name: DopplerScale

Degree to which the pitch of a `Sound` varies due to the Doppler

members.name: ListenerCFrame

The `CFrame` that is used as the listener's position if

SpawnLocation.summary:
`SpawnLocations`, or "spawns" determine where a
`Player` respawns when they die. They can be configured to allow only
certain players to use each spawn, using `Teams`. They also control
how `ForceFields` are set up for newly-spawned players.

members.name: AllowTeamChangeOnTouch
members.summary:
Allows a `Player` to join the team by touching the
`SpawnLocation`. When set to true, if a `Player` character
comes into contact with the `SpawnLocation`, the player's
`Player.TeamColor` will be set to `SpawnLocation.TeamColor`.

members.name: Duration
members.summary:
The length of time, in seconds, that a `ForceField` will be applied
to a `Player` character spawning at this `SpawnLocation`. If
Duration is zero, the `ForceField` is never created, and it will not
trigger the `Instance.DescendantAdded` or
`Instance.ChildAdded` events.

members.name: Enabled
members.summary:
Sets whether or not the `SpawnLocation` is enabled. When disabled
players cannot spawn at the `SpawnLocation` and the
AllowTeamChangeOnTouch functionality is disabled.

members.name: Neutral
members.summary:
Whether or not a `SpawnLocation` is affiliated with a specific team.
This means that any `Player`, of any `Team`, can spawn on it
if this property is set to true.

members.name: TeamColor
members.summary:
Sets what team the `SpawnLocation` is affiliated to. If
`SpawnLocation.Neutral` property is false, only
`Players` with the same `Player.TeamColor` as the
spawn's TeamColor will be able to spawn there.

members.name: MinLength

members.name: ContactsCount
members.summary: A measurement of how many parts are currently in contact with one another.

members.name: DataReceiveKbps
members.summary:
In a networked game, this describes roughly how many kilobytes of data are
being received by the current instance, per second.

members.name: DataSendKbps
members.summary:
In a networked game, this describes roughly how many kilobytes of data are
being sent by the current instance, per second.

members.name: FrameTime
members.summary:
A measurement of how long it takes for the engine to process all tasks
required to render a frame.

members.name: HeartbeatTime
members.summary:
A measurement of the total amount of time it takes for the server to
update its task scheduler jobs in seconds.

members.name: HeartbeatTimeMs
members.summary:
A measurement of the total amount of time it takes long it takes for
Roblox to update all of its task scheduler jobs, in milliseconds.

members.name: InstanceCount
members.summary: A measurement of how many `Instance` are currently in memory.

members.name: MemoryTrackingEnabled
members.summary:
An indication of whether memory tracking is enabled. This is guaranteed to
be unchanged until the next time the Client is started.

members.name: MovingPrimitivesCount
members.summary:
A measurement of how many physically simulated components are currently
moving in the game world.

members.name: PhysicsReceiveKbps
members.summary:
In a networked game, this describes roughly how many kilobytes of physics
data are being received by the current instance, per second.

members.name: PhysicsSendKbps
members.summary:
In a networked game, this describes roughly how many kilobytes of physics
data are being sent by the current instance, per second.

members.name: PhysicsStepTime
members.summary:
A measurement of how long it takes for the physics engine to update its
current state.

members.name: PhysicsStepTimeMs
members.summary:
A measurement of how long it takes for the physics engine to update its
current state, in milliseconds. If this value is high, then it means the
game instance is under stress from the physics simulations taking place.

members.name: PrimitivesCount
members.summary:
A measurement of how many physically simulated components currently exist
in the game world.

members.name: RenderCPUFrameTime
members.summary:
A measurement of how long it takes for the CPU to process all of its
rendering tasks for a frame.

members.name: RenderGPUFrameTime
members.summary:
A measurement of how long it takes for the GPU to process all of its tasks
required to render a frame.

members.name: SceneDrawcallCount
members.summary:

scene.

members.name: SceneTriangleCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of triangles rendered by the game's current
scene.

members.name: ShadowsDrawcallCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of draw calls being made for shadows by the
game's current scene.

members.name: ShadowsTriangleCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of triangles rendered as shadows in the game's
current scene.

members.name: UI2DDrawcallCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of 2D draw calls made for UI elements in the
game's current scene.

members.name: UI2DTriangleCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of triangles that are being rendered for 2D UI
elements in the game's current scene.

members.name: UI3DDrawcallCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of 3D draw calls made for UI elements in the
game's current scene.

members.name: UI3DTriangleCount
members.summary:
A measurement of the number of triangles being rendered for 3D UI elements
in the game's current scene.

members.summary: Sets the color of active UI elements when hovered in Studio.

members.summary:

were made during a Play Solo session to the opened place.

If set to true, the hover selection box that is shown when mousing over
selectable objects in the `Workspace` will flash between

closing bracket.

members.name: Auto Closing Quotes

Controls whether the script editor automatically inserts a matching
closing quote.

members.summary:
Controls whether deleting an opening bracket or quote also removes its
closing counterpart.

members.name: Auto Indent Rule

Sets the rule used to determine automatic indentation in the script
editor.

members.name: Auto-Recovery Enabled

interval.

with the movement keys.

pressed.

sessions are switched.

members.name: CommandBarLocalState

members.name: Comment Color

tab.

editor.

members.name: Function Name Color

members.name: HintColor

UnreliableRemoteEvent.summary:
An object which facilitates asynchronous, unordered and unreliable, one-way
communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a
`UnreliableRemoteEvent` do not yield.

members.name: FireAllClients
members.summary:
Fires the `OnClientEvent` event
for all connected clients. Has a 1000 byte limit to the payload of the
event. Events with larger payloads are dropped.

members.name: FireClient
members.summary:
Fires the `OnClientEvent` event
for a specific client. Has a 1000 byte limit to the payload of the event.
Events with larger payloads are dropped.

members.name: FireServer
members.summary:
Fires the `OnServerEvent` event
on the server from one connected client. Has a 1000 byte limit to the
payload of the event. Events with larger payloads are dropped.

members.name: OnClientEvent
members.summary:
Fires from a `LocalScript` when either
`FireClient()` or
`FireAllClients()` is called
on the same `UnreliableRemoteEvent` instance from a `Script`,
although this firing is not guaranteed even if one of the above methods
are called. This can occur due to packet loss or to maintain optimal
engine performance.

members.name: OnServerEvent
members.summary:
Fires from a `Script` when
`FireServer()` is called on the
same `UnreliableRemoteEvent` instance from a `LocalScript`,
although this firing is not guaranteed even if the above methods is
called. This can occur due to packet loss or to maintain optimal engine
performance.

`Workspace` houses 3D objects which are rendered to the 3D world. Objects not
descending from it will not be rendered or physically interact with the world.

affecting the aerodynamic force model.

`Workspace`.

creation mode.

adjacent parts.

Calls/resumes a function/coroutine immediately through the engine's
scheduler.

members.name: defer
members.summary:
Calls/resumes a function/coroutine at the end of the current resumption
cycle.

members.name: delay
members.summary:
Schedules a function/coroutine to be called/resumed on the next Heartbeat
after the given duration (in seconds) has passed, without throttling.

members.name: desynchronize
members.summary: Causes the following code to be run in parallel.

members.name: synchronize
members.summary: Causes the following code to be run in serial.

members.name: wait
members.summary: Yields the current thread without throttling.

members.name: cancel
members.summary: Cancels a thread, preventing it from being resumed.

utf8.summary: This library provides basic support for `UTF-8` encoding.

members.name: charpattern
members.summary:
The pattern `"[%z\x01-\x7F\xC2-\xF4][\x80-\xBF]*"`, which matches exactly
zero or more UTF-8 byte sequences, assuming that the subject is a valid
UTF-8 string.

members.name: char
members.summary: Converts zero or more codepoints to UTF-8 byte sequences.

members.name: codes
members.summary:
Returns an iterator function that iterates over all codepoints in a given
string.

members.name: codepoint
members.summary:
Returns the codepoints (as integers) from all codepoints in a given
string.

members.name: len
members.summary: Returns the number of UTF-8 codepoints in a given string.

members.name: offset
members.summary:
Returns the position (in bytes) where the encoding of the `n`‑th codepoint
of `s` (counting from byte position `i`) starts.

members.name: graphemes
members.summary:
Returns an iterator function that iterates over the grapheme clusters of a
given string.

members.name: nfcnormalize
members.summary: Converts the input string to Normal Form C.

members.name: nfdnormalize
members.summary: Converts the input string to Normal Form D.

members.name: zero
members.summary: Constant vector with all components set to `0`.

members.name: one
members.summary: Constant vector with all components set to `1`.

members.name: create
members.summary: Creates a new vector with the given component values.

members.name: magnitude
members.summary: Calculates the magnitude of a given vector.

members.name: normalize
members.summary: Computes the normalized version (unit vector) of a given vector.

members.name: cross
members.summary: Computes the cross product of two vectors.

members.name: dot
members.summary: Computes the dot product of two vectors.

members.name: angle
members.summary: Computes the angle between two vectors in radians.

members.name: floor
members.summary: Applies `math.floor()` to every component of the input vector.

members.name: ceil
members.summary: Applies `math.ceil()` to every component of the input vector.

members.name: abs
members.summary: Applies `math.abs()` to every component of the input vector.

members.name: sign
members.summary: Applies `math.sign()` to every component of the input vector.

members.name: clamp
members.summary: Applies `math.clamp()` to every component of the input vector.

members.name: lerp
members.summary:
Returns a vector linearly interpolated between two vectors by a fractional
alpha.

members.name: max
members.summary:
Applies `math.max()` to the corresponding components of the input
vectors.

members.name: min
members.summary:
Applies `math.min()` to the corresponding components of the input
vectors.

ActionType.name: Pause
ActionType.summary: The game or round was paused.

ActionType.name: Lose

ActionType.summary: The game or round ended in a draw with no winner.

ActionType.summary: The player won the game or round.

ActivePayerStatus.name: Never
ActivePayerStatus.summary: The player has not made a qualifying purchase in the experience.

ActivePayerStatus.summary:
The player has previously spent in the experience but is not currently an
active payer.

ActivePayerStatus.name: Casual50Percent

ActivePayerStatus.name: Intermediate35Percent

ActuatorRelativeTo.name: Attachment0
ActuatorRelativeTo.summary:
The directional property is interpreted in the local coordinate frame of
`Attachment0`, rotating with its parent part.

ActuatorRelativeTo.name: Attachment1
ActuatorRelativeTo.summary:
The directional property is interpreted in the local coordinate frame of
`Attachment1`, rotating with its parent part.

ActuatorRelativeTo.name: World
ActuatorRelativeTo.summary:
The directional property is interpreted in world-space coordinates,
remaining constant regardless of part orientation.

ActuatorType.name: None
ActuatorType.summary: The motor and servo components are both disabled.

ActuatorType.name: Motor
ActuatorType.summary:
The motor component is enabled. Motor properties are active and the
actuator will apply continuous force.

ActuatorType.name: Servo
ActuatorType.summary:
The servo component is enabled. Servo properties are active and the
actuator will apply force to approach the servo's target.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: IsAvailable
AdAvailabilityResult.summary: An ad is available to show the user.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: DeviceIneligible
AdAvailabilityResult.summary: The device is ineligible to receive ads.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: ExperienceIneligible
AdAvailabilityResult.summary:
The experience is ineligible to receive ads. Check if its eligibility has
been revoked.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: InternalError
AdAvailabilityResult.summary: An unspecified internal error occurred. Try fetching the ad again.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: NoFill
AdAvailabilityResult.summary:
There are no ads available to fill your ad request. You might have hit the
ad frequency limit.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: PlayerIneligible
AdAvailabilityResult.summary:
The user is ineligible to receive ads during this session. The user might
be under 13 or located in a blocked region.

AdAvailabilityResult.name: PublisherIneligible
AdAvailabilityResult.summary:
The publisher is ineligible to receive ads because they have not met the
publisher eligibility requirements.

AdFormat.name: RewardedVideo
AdFormat.summary:
A full-screen video ad that plays to completion and rewards the viewer,
used as the `adFormat` argument for `AdService` methods.

AdShape.name: HorizontalRectangle
AdShape.summary: The ad has an aspect ratio of 16:9 and a minimum size of 8 by 4.5 studs.

AdTeleportMethod.name: Undefined
AdTeleportMethod.summary:
Default uninitialized sentinel value indicating that no teleport method
has been determined yet.

AdTeleportMethod.name: PortalForward
AdTeleportMethod.summary:
The player teleported forward to the advertiser's destination experience
by walking into an `AdPortal`.

AdTeleportMethod.name: InGameMenuBackButton
AdTeleportMethod.summary:
The player initiated a return teleport to the publisher's experience by
pressing the back button in the in-game menu.

AdTeleportMethod.name: UIBackButton
AdTeleportMethod.summary:
The player initiated a return teleport to the publisher's experience by
pressing a back button rendered in the ad destination's UI overlay.

AdUIEventType.name: AdLabelClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the "Sponsored" label on the ad overlay, which opens
the ad disclosure prompt showing advertiser and payer information.

AdUIEventType.name: VolumeButtonClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the volume toggle button on the ad overlay, which mutes
or unmutes the video ad audio.

AdUIEventType.name: FullscreenButtonClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the fullscreen toggle button, which smoothly zooms the
camera to a centered view of the ad surface and enables audio.

AdUIEventType.name: PlayButtonClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the play button on the ad overlay. If the ad is already
in fullscreen, playback resumes; otherwise it enters fullscreen mode which
also starts (or resumes) the video.

AdUIEventType.name: PauseButtonClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the pause button while a video ad is playing in
fullscreen mode, which pauses video playback.

AdUIEventType.name: CloseButtonClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the close button on the fullscreen video ad view, which
exits fullscreen mode and returns to the normal camera position.

AdUIEventType.name: WhyThisAdClicked
AdUIEventType.summary:
The player clicked the "Why this ad?" link, which displays the EUDSA
(European Digital Services Act) disclosure prompt showing the advertiser
and payer names for the current ad creative.

AdUIEventType.name: PlayEventTriggered
AdUIEventType.summary:
A system-initiated play/resume event that clears the force-pause state and
resumes video playback if the stream is open.

AdUIEventType.name: PauseEventTriggered
AdUIEventType.summary:
A system-initiated pause event, used when the engine needs to force-pause
the video (for example, when a dropdown menu opens over the ad). Prevents
viewability-based auto-play from resuming playback until a corresponding
system event clears that pause.

AdUIType.name: None
AdUIType.summary:
The `AdGui` has no ad creative loaded and is not rendering ad
content.

AdUIType.name: Image
AdUIType.summary: The `AdGui` is rendering a static image ad creative.

AdUIType.name: Video
AdUIType.summary: The `AdGui` is rendering a video ad creative.

AdUnitStatus.name: Inactive
AdUnitStatus.summary:
The ad unit isn't currently serving an ad and it may be configured
incorrectly. An `AdGui` with this status will display its fallback
image.

AdUnitStatus.name: Active
AdUnitStatus.summary:
The ad unit is currently serving an ad. Players will observe sponsored
content in an `AdGui` and an `AdPortal` will teleport users
that walk through.

AdornCullingMode.name: Automatic
AdornCullingMode.summary: Automatically culls adornment based on distance.

AdornCullingMode.name: Never
AdornCullingMode.summary: Never culls adornment. Adornment is always visible.

AdornShading.name: Default
AdornShading.summary:
Draws the adornment unlit and occluded by scene geometry like an ordinary
world object.

AdornShading.name: Shaded
AdornShading.summary: Draws the adornment lit by scene lighting and occluded by scene geometry.

AdornShading.name: XRay
AdornShading.summary:
Draws the adornment unlit and visible through geometry that would
otherwise occlude it.

AdornShading.name: XRayShaded
AdornShading.summary:
Draws the adornment lit by scene lighting and visible through geometry
that would otherwise occlude it.

AdornShading.name: AlwaysOnTop
AdornShading.summary:
Draws the adornment unlit on top of all other geometry with no depth
testing.

AgeCheckStatus.name: Unchecked
AgeCheckStatus.summary: The player has not yet completed age verification.

AgeCheckStatus.name: Checked
AgeCheckStatus.summary: The player has successfully completed age verification.

AlignType.name: PrimaryAxisParallel
AlignType.summary:
Aligns the primary axis to be parallel to the axis given by
`Constraint.Attachment1`.

AlignType.name: PrimaryAxisPerpendicular
AlignType.summary:
Aligns the primary axis to be perpendicular to the axis given by
`Constraint.Attachment1`.

AlignType.name: PrimaryAxisLookAt
AlignType.summary:
Aligns the primary axis to look at the point given by
`Constraint.Attachment1` or the
`AlignOrientation.LookAtPosition`.

AlignType.name: AllAxes
AlignType.summary:
Aligns all of the axes of `Constraint.Attachment0` to the axes given
by `Constraint.Attachment1` or to the target orientation provided by
`AlignOrientation.PrimaryAxis` and
`AlignOrientation.SecondaryAxis`.

AlphaMode.name: Overlay
AlphaMode.summary:
Overlays the `ColorMap` on top of the
underlying part color based on the map's alpha channel.

AlphaMode.name: Transparency
AlphaMode.summary:
Uses the `ColorMap` alpha channel to
control the transparency of the surface.

AlphaMode.name: TintMask
AlphaMode.summary:
Uses the `ColorMap` alpha channel to
control the amount of `SurfaceAppearance.Color` tinting.

AlphaMode.name: Opaque
AlphaMode.summary:
Ignores the `ColorMap` alpha channel and
assumes an opacity value of 1 everywhere.

AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.name: CustomField01
AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.summary:
The first custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in
Roblox-provided analytics charts.

AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.name: CustomField02
AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.summary:
The second custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in
Roblox-provided analytics charts.

AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.name: CustomField03
AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.summary:
The third custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in
Roblox-provided analytics charts.

AnalyticsEconomyAction.name: Default
AnalyticsEconomyAction.summary: Default action. Used for an undefined Action.

AnalyticsEconomyAction.name: Acquire
AnalyticsEconomyAction.summary:
Indicates the acquisition of an in game resource. For example, a player
acquires virtual currency by completing a specific in game task.

AnalyticsEconomyAction.name: Spend
AnalyticsEconomyAction.summary:
Indicates the spending or loss of an in game resource. For example, a
player spends virtual currency to acquire a new item.

AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.name: Sink
AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.summary: Currency is being removed from the player's account.

AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.name: Source
AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.summary: Currency is being added to the player's account.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.name: IAP
AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary:
Represents a source of currency purchased via Robux, for example
in-experience "gold" purchased for Robux.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.name: Shop
AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary:
Purchases within a shop, for example in-experience "coins" used to buy an
item within the experience.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.name: Gameplay
AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary:
Currency earned or paid through gameplay, for example in-experience "gold"
earned from winning a match.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.name: ContextualPurchase
AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary:
Purchase with direct context to a reward, for example in-experience "gold"
used to purchase an extra life.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.name: TimedReward
AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary:
Time-based reward, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for logging
in daily.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.name: Onboarding
AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary:
Transaction related to onboarding, for example in-experience "gold"
rewarded for completing the tutorial.

AnalyticsLogLevel.name: Trace
AnalyticsLogLevel.summary:
Trace is the noisiest level, rarely (if ever) enabled for a production
app.

AnalyticsLogLevel.name: Information
AnalyticsLogLevel.summary:
Used for general informational messages that highlight progress or state
changes during normal operation.

AnalyticsLogLevel.name: Error
AnalyticsLogLevel.summary: When functionality is unavailable or expectations broken.

AnalyticsLogLevel.name: Fatal
AnalyticsLogLevel.summary: The most critical level, Fatal events demand immediate attention.

AnalyticsProgressionStatus.name: Default
AnalyticsProgressionStatus.summary: Default status. Used for an undefined status.

AnalyticsProgressionType.name: Custom
AnalyticsProgressionType.summary:
A custom progression status for events outside the standard
start/fail/complete lifecycle.

AnalyticsProgressionType.name: Start
AnalyticsProgressionType.summary: The player started the level attempt.

AnalyticsProgressionType.name: Fail
AnalyticsProgressionType.summary: The player failed the level attempt.

AnalyticsProgressionType.name: Complete
AnalyticsProgressionType.summary: The player completed the level successfully.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: Initializing
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary: The video-to-animation job is being set up on the server.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: Pending
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
The job has been queued on the server and is waiting for processing
resources to become available.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: Processing
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
The server is actively analyzing the video and extracting motion-capture
data to generate the animation clip.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: ErrorGeneric
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary: The server-side video processing encountered an unspecified error.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: Success
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
The video was successfully converted into an `AnimationClip`, which
is returned as the second element of the result tuple.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: ErrorVideoTooLong
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
Processing failed because the uploaded video exceeds the maximum allowed
duration (15 seconds).

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: ErrorNoPersonDetected
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
Processing failed because no person could be detected in the video; the
video must show a person fully in frame, facing the camera.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: ErrorVideoUnstable
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
Processing failed because the video is too shaky for reliable motion
capture; a more stable recording is required.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: Timeout
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
Processing could not be completed in time, typically due to high request
volume on the video processing backend.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: Cancelled
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
The player declined the consent prompt or provided no input, so the video
upload was not started.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: ErrorMultiplePeople
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
Processing failed because more than one person was detected in the video;
the video must contain a single person fully in frame.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.name: ErrorUploadingVideo
AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary:
The client-side video upload failed before the video reached the
processing backend.

AnimationNodeBlendMode.name: Over
AnimationNodeBlendMode.summary:
Composites the one-shot pose on top of the base pose, replacing it by the
current blend weight.

AnimationNodeBlendMode.name: Add
AnimationNodeBlendMode.summary:
Adds the one-shot pose to the base pose as an additive layer scaled by the
current blend weight.

AnimationNodeBlendMode.name: Subtract
AnimationNodeBlendMode.summary:
Subtracts the one-shot pose from the base pose scaled by the current blend
weight.

AnimationNodeType.name: InvalidNode
AnimationNodeType.summary: The default unassigned type indicating a node has not been configured.

AnimationNodeType.name: AddNode
AnimationNodeType.summary: An additive blend node that layers an additive pose on top of a base pose.

AnimationNodeType.name: OverNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A layering node that composites an overlay pose on top of a base pose
using per-joint masking.

AnimationNodeType.name: Blend1DNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A blend node that interpolates between multiple inputs along a single
numeric axis.

AnimationNodeType.name: Blend2DNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A blend node that interpolates between multiple inputs using a
two-dimensional position.

AnimationNodeType.name: ClipNode
AnimationNodeType.summary: A leaf node that plays back an animation clip asset.

AnimationNodeType.name: GraphOutput
AnimationNodeType.summary:
The terminal output node of an animation graph that receives the final
pose.

AnimationNodeType.name: MaskNode
AnimationNodeType.summary: A node that filters its input pose through a per-joint weight mask.

AnimationNodeType.name: PrioritySelectNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A state node that plays the highest-priority input whose trigger condition
is true.

AnimationNodeType.name: RandomSequenceNode
AnimationNodeType.summary: A sequence node that plays its inputs in a weighted random order.

AnimationNodeType.name: SelectNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A state node that plays whichever input is chosen by a string selection
parameter.

AnimationNodeType.name: SequenceNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A node that plays its inputs one after another in order, optionally
looping.

AnimationNodeType.name: SpeedNode
AnimationNodeType.summary: A node that scales the playback speed of its input.

AnimationNodeType.name: SubtractNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A blend node that subtracts one pose from another to produce a difference
pose.

AnimationNodeType.name: OneShotNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A layering node that plays a one-shot pose over a looping base pose on
trigger, blending it in and back out.

AnimationNodeType.name: StateMachineNode
AnimationNodeType.summary:
A node that selects and transitions between animation states according to
a state machine definition.

AnimationPriority.name: Idle
AnimationPriority.summary: (6) - Recommended priority for character idle animations.

AnimationPriority.name: Movement
AnimationPriority.summary:
(5) - Recommended priority for walk, run, swim, climb, and other
locomotion animations.

AnimationPriority.name: Action
AnimationPriority.summary:
(4) - Recommended priority for character actions that must override idle
and locomotion animations.

AnimationPriority.name: Action4
AnimationPriority.summary:
(1) - Action4 is the highest priority available, overriding all other
priority values.

AnimationPriority.name: Core
AnimationPriority.summary:
(7) - Lowest priority, intended for use by Roblox default animations and
catalog animation bundles.

AnimatorRetargetingMode.name: Default
AnimatorRetargetingMode.summary: Retargeting in default state, opt-in initially but subject to change.

AnimatorRetargetingMode.name: Disabled
AnimatorRetargetingMode.summary:
Animation retargeting is off; animations play exactly as authored without
adapting joint transforms to the character's body proportions.

AnimatorRetargetingMode.name: Enabled
AnimatorRetargetingMode.summary:
Animation retargeting is always active; the Animator adapts animations to
the character's body proportions regardless of the platform default.

AntiAliasing.name: Disabled
AntiAliasing.summary: Disables anti-aliasing, resulting in hard edges.

AntiAliasing.name: Enabled
AntiAliasing.summary: Enables anti-aliasing, resulting in soft edges.

AppLifecycleManagerState.name: Detached
AppLifecycleManagerState.summary:
The application has not yet started or is shutting down. This is the
initial state before the lifecycle manager is created and the final state
entered during application termination.

AppLifecycleManagerState.name: Active
AppLifecycleManagerState.summary:
The application is in the foreground and has input focus. This is the
normal running state where the user is actively interacting with the
experience.

AppLifecycleManagerState.name: Inactive
AppLifecycleManagerState.summary:
The application is visible but does not have input focus. On iOS this
occurs during transitions such as incoming calls or notification center
pull-down; on macOS it corresponds to the application resigning active
status.

AppLifecycleManagerState.name: Hidden
AppLifecycleManagerState.summary:
The application is fully in the background and not visible to the user. On
mobile platforms this corresponds to the app being backgrounded; on
desktop it corresponds to the window being minimized or fully occluded.

AppUpdateStatus.name: Unknown
AppUpdateStatus.summary: The default state before any update check has been performed.

AppUpdateStatus.name: NotSupported
AppUpdateStatus.summary: The platform does not support application updates.

AppUpdateStatus.name: Failed
AppUpdateStatus.summary:
The update check failed due to an error such as a network failure or
missing initialization.

AppUpdateStatus.name: NotAvailable
AppUpdateStatus.summary:
No update is currently required; the client is already running the latest
version for its channel.

AppUpdateStatus.name: Available
AppUpdateStatus.summary: An update is available through a public channel or production deployment.

AppUpdateStatus.name: AvailableBoundChannel
AppUpdateStatus.summary:
An update is available because the user is explicitly bound to a private
or public channel.

AppUpdateStatus.name: AvailableBetaProgram
AppUpdateStatus.summary:
An update is available because the user opted into a beta program backed
by a channel.

ApplyShadowMode.name: Shape
ApplyShadowMode.summary: The shadow is applied to the parent element's frame.

ApplyShadowMode.name: Text
ApplyShadowMode.summary:
The shadow is applied to the parent element's text; no-op if the parent is
not a text element.

ApplyStrokeMode.name: Contextual
ApplyStrokeMode.summary: The stroke is applied to the parent UI element's text.

ApplyStrokeMode.name: Border
ApplyStrokeMode.summary: The stroke is applied to the parent UI element's border.

AspectType.name: FitWithinMaxSize
AspectType.summary:
The object will be the maximum size possible within its own
`AbsoluteSize`.

AspectType.name: ScaleWithParentSize
AspectType.summary:
The object's maximum size will be the size of the parent while still
maintaining the aspect ratio.

AssetCreatorType.name: User
AssetCreatorType.summary:
The asset is owned by an individual user; the accompanying creator ID is a
user ID.

AssetCreatorType.name: Group
AssetCreatorType.summary: The asset is owned by a group; the accompanying creator ID is a group ID.

AssetFetchStatus.name: Failure
AssetFetchStatus.summary:
The asset failed to load successfully. Subsequent attempts are likely to
fail; there may be something wrong with the `Content`
string.

AssetFetchStatus.name: None
AssetFetchStatus.summary:
The engine has no information about this asset. The engine never tried to
load it.

AssetFetchStatus.name: Loading
AssetFetchStatus.summary: The engine is in the middle of trying to load this asset.

AssetFetchStatus.name: TimedOut
AssetFetchStatus.summary:
The engine tried to load this asset but timed out. Future attempts to load
may succeed.

AssetType.name: Image
AssetType.summary: The asset is an image.

AssetType.name: TShirt
AssetType.summary:
The asset is a classic t-shirt (a flat image applied to the avatar's
torso).

AssetType.name: Audio
AssetType.summary: The asset is an audio clip.

AssetType.name: Mesh
AssetType.summary: The asset is a mesh.

AssetType.name: Lua
AssetType.summary: The asset is Luau code, for example a `ModuleScript`.

AssetType.name: Hat
AssetType.summary: The asset is a hat.

AssetType.name: Place
AssetType.summary: The asset is a place.

AssetType.name: Model
AssetType.summary: The asset is a model.

AssetType.name: Shirt
AssetType.summary: The asset is a shirt.

AssetType.name: Pants
AssetType.summary: The asset is a pants item.

AssetType.name: Decal
AssetType.summary: The asset is a decal (image).

AssetType.name: Head
AssetType.summary: The asset is a head.

AudioApiRollout.name: Disabled
AudioApiRollout.summary:
Voice chat will use an internal voice chat implementation that is
automatic and hidden.

AudioApiRollout.name: Automatic
AudioApiRollout.summary:
Currently means the same thing as `Disabled`, but will be updated to mean
`Enabled` in the future.

AudioApiRollout.name: Enabled
AudioApiRollout.summary:
Voice chat can be customized or controlled via
`AudioDeviceInputs`.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Mono
AudioChannelLayout.summary: Monaural audio streams contain only one **Center** channel.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Stereo
AudioChannelLayout.summary: Stereophonic audio streams consist of two channels: **Left** and **Right**.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Quad
AudioChannelLayout.summary: Quadrophonic audio streams consist of four channels: **Left**, **Right**, **BackLeft**, and **BackRight**. Quadrophonic streams can encode forward/backward spatial information that stereo streams might struggle with.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Surround_5
AudioChannelLayout.summary: Surround sound audio streams consist of five channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **BackLeft**, and **BackRight**. Surround sound streams encode spatial information with better resolution front and center.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Surround_5_1
AudioChannelLayout.summary: 5.1 surround sound consists of six channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **BackLeft**, **BackRight**, and a **Sub** (subsonic) low‑frequency channel. 5.1 surround sound benefits from low frequencies being less directional in order to encode higher resolution spatial information versus simple 5‑channel surround sound.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Surround_7_1
AudioChannelLayout.summary: 7.1 surround sound consists of eight channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **SurroundLeft**, **SurroundRight**, **BackLeft**, **BackRight**, and a **Sub** (subsonic) low‑frequency channel. 7.1 surround sound is an improvement over 5.1 surround sound, offering better spatial resolution directly to the left and right as well.

AudioChannelLayout.name: Surround_7_1_4
AudioChannelLayout.summary: 7.1.4 surround sound consists of twelve channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **SurroundLeft**, **SurroundRight**, **BackLeft**, **BackRight**, **Sub**, **TopLeft**, **TopRight**, **TopBackLeft**, and **TopBackRight**. 7.1.4 is the only currently supported channel layout that encodes height information.

AudioFilterType.name: Peak
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that boosts or reduces sound near a specified
`Frequency`.

AudioFilterType.name: LowShelf
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that boosts or reduces sound below a specified
`Frequency`.

AudioFilterType.name: HighShelf
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that boosts or reduces sound above a specified
`Frequency`.

AudioFilterType.name: Lowpass12dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound above a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

AudioFilterType.name: Lowpass24dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound above a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

AudioFilterType.name: Lowpass48dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound above a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

AudioFilterType.name: Highpass12dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound below a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

AudioFilterType.name: Highpass24dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound below a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

AudioFilterType.name: Highpass48dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound below a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

AudioFilterType.name: Bandpass
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that only allows sound near a specified
`Frequency` to be heard.

AudioFilterType.name: Notch
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound near a specified
`Frequency`.

AudioFilterType.name: Lowpass6dB
AudioFilterType.summary:
Filter that cuts sound above a specified
`Frequency`, at a slope of -6dB/octave.

to `32767`.

AudioSampleFormat.name: Float32

Samples are represented as 32-bit floating-point numbers, typically
ranging from `-1.0` to `1.0`.

AudioSimulationFidelity.summary:
No acoustic simulation occurs; only direction and distance are taken into
account.

AudioSimulationFidelity.name: Automatic
AudioSimulationFidelity.summary:
The audio engine simulates transmission, diffraction, and reflections at a
level of detail suitable to most devices.

AudioSubType.name: Music

AudioWindowSize.name: Medium

AudioWindowSize.name: Large

The largest buffer size, providing higher frequency resolution at the cost
of more latency.
