AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: None
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
No avatar chat features are enabled. This is the default value of the
bitmask before any capabilities are resolved.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UniverseAudio
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
Voice chat audio is enabled at the universe level. This is a server-side
setting configured by the experience creator; it must be combined with
`AvatarChatServiceFeature.PlaceAudio` for audio to be active in a
given place.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UniverseVideo
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
Avatar video (camera-based facial animation) is enabled at the universe
level. This is a server-side setting configured by the experience creator;
it must be combined with `AvatarChatServiceFeature.PlaceVideo` for
video to be active in a given place.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: PlaceAudio
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
Voice chat audio is enabled for the current place. Both this flag and
`AvatarChatServiceFeature.UniverseAudio` must be set for audio to be
active in the place.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: PlaceVideo
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
Avatar video (camera-based facial animation) is enabled for the current
place. Both this flag and `AvatarChatServiceFeature.UniverseVideo`
must be set for video to be active in the place.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UserAudioEligible
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
The user meets the requirements to use voice chat audio (age-verified, not
banned, etc.). Eligibility is resolved per-player from backend
permissions; it does not imply the user has opted in (see
`AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserAudio`).

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UserAudio
UserVideoEligible
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
The user meets the requirements to use avatar video (camera-based facial
animation). Eligibility is resolved per-player from backend permissions;
it does not imply the user has opted in (see
`AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserVideo`).

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UserVideo
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
The user has opted in to avatar video (camera-based facial animation).
This flag is only meaningful when
`AvatarChatServiceFeature.UserVideoEligible` is also set; together
they indicate the user both can and has chosen to use video.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UserBanned
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary:
The user is currently banned from avatar chat features. When this flag is
present in the client features mask, voice and video capabilities are
unavailable to the player regardless of other eligibility flags.

AvatarChatServiceFeature.name: UserVerifiedForVoice
AvatarChatServiceFeature.summary: The user has completed voice verification.

AvatarContextMenuOption.name: Friend
AvatarContextMenuOption.summary: Sends a friend request to the selected user.

AvatarContextMenuOption.name: Chat
AvatarContextMenuOption.summary: Opens a private conversation with the selected user in the in-game chat.

AvatarContextMenuOption.name: Emote
AvatarContextMenuOption.summary: Plays a wave emote animation directed at the selected user.

AvatarContextMenuOption.name: InspectMenu
AvatarContextMenuOption.summary:
Opens the Avatar Inspect Menu to view the selected user's avatar and
equipped items.

AvatarItemType.name: Asset
AvatarItemType.summary:
An individual avatar catalog item such as a hat, shirt, or accessory,
identified by an asset ID.

AvatarItemType.name: Bundle
AvatarItemType.summary:
A collection of related avatar items sold together as a group, identified
by a bundle ID.

AvatarPromptResult.name: PermissionDenied
AvatarPromptResult.summary: Denied permission to take the prompted action.

AvatarPromptResult.name: Failed
AvatarPromptResult.summary: Failure while trying to take the prompted action.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.name: Scale
AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.summary:
Scales down rigid accessories that exceed the configured bounds, or
removes them if scaling would reduce them below minimum size thresholds.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.name: Remove
AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.summary:
Destroys any rigid accessory whose bounding box exceeds the configured
bounds.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.name: PreviewScale
AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.summary:
Reports whether an accessory would be scaled or removed for exceeding the
configured bounds without actually modifying it.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.name: PreviewRemove
AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.summary:
Reports whether an accessory would be removed for exceeding the configured
bounds without actually destroying it.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsAccessoryMode.summary:
No custom size limits are applied to rigid accessories; the player's own
accessory choices are displayed without modification.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryMode.name: CustomLimit
AvatarSettingsAccessoryMode.summary:
The experience enforces custom size limits on rigid accessories using the
LimitBounds and LimitMethod properties of `AvatarAccessoryRules`.

AvatarSettingsAnimationClipsMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsAnimationClipsMode.summary:
The clips determined by the `AnimationPacksMode` are used, without
experience-level overrides.

AvatarSettingsAnimationClipsMode.name: CustomClips
AvatarSettingsAnimationClipsMode.summary:
The experience overrides individual animation clips using the per-clip
enabled and ID properties on `AvatarAnimationRules` (for example,
`CustomRunAnimationEnabled` and `CustomRunAnimationId`). Only clips whose
enabled flag is true are replaced.

AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.summary:
The player's own equipped animation pack is used. The character's Animate
script supplies the animations without experience-level overrides.

AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.name: StandardR15
AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.summary:
The experience forces the standard R15 animation pack on all characters,
overriding player-equipped animations with a fixed set of R15 locomotion
clips.

AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.name: StandardR6
AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.summary:
The experience forces the standard R6 animation pack on all (R15)
characters, overriding player-equipped animations with a fixed set of
R6-style locomotion clips plus additional R6-style emote and tool
animations.

AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.summary:
Players keep their own avatar body parts; the experience does not override
any body-part assets.

AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.name: CustomParts
AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.summary:
The experience overrides individual body parts (head, face, torso, arms,
legs) using per-part asset IDs and enablement settings on
`AvatarBodyRules`.

AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.name: CustomBody
AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.summary:
The experience replaces the avatar's entire body as a single unit, using
`CustomBodyType` and `CustomBodyBundleId`.

AvatarSettingsBuildMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsBuildMode.summary:
Players can scale their avatar body freely within the full platform-wide
limits. This is the default value.

AvatarSettingsBuildMode.name: CustomBuild
AvatarSettingsBuildMode.summary:
The experience enforces creator-defined min/max ranges for avatar body
scales (height, width, head, body type, and proportions), overriding the
platform defaults.

AvatarSettingsClothingMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsClothingMode.summary:
No spatial limit is applied to layered clothing; the player's layered
clothing accessories deform without a bounding constraint.

AvatarSettingsClothingMode.name: CustomLimit
AvatarSettingsClothingMode.summary: Applies a custom spatial limit to layered clothing based on `LimitBounds`.

AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.name: Default
AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.summary:
Each body part uses its native collision geometry. The HumanoidRootPart,
UpperTorso, and LowerTorso collide while other parts do not. This is the
default value for `CollisionMode`.

AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.name: SingleCollider
AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.summary:
A single box-shaped collider part replaces all per-part collision. The
collider is welded to the HumanoidRootPart and sized by
`SingleColliderSize` (default 2, 3, 1). All other parts become
non-collidable and massless.

AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.name: Legacy
AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.summary:
Collision geometry is determined by `LegacyCollisionMode`, which selects
either inner-box colliders or R6-style colliders.

AvatarSettingsCustomAccessoryMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsCustomAccessoryMode.summary:
No custom accessory replacement is applied; the player's own accessory
choices are displayed without modification.

AvatarSettingsCustomAccessoryMode.name: CustomAccessories
AvatarSettingsCustomAccessoryMode.summary:
The experience replaces player accessories with custom accessories defined
by the per-slot properties on `AvatarAccessoryRules`.

AvatarSettingsCustomBodyType.name: AvatarReference
AvatarSettingsCustomBodyType.summary:
The custom body is assembled from individual per-part asset references on
`AvatarBodyRules`. This is the default value.

AvatarSettingsCustomBodyType.name: BundleId
AvatarSettingsCustomBodyType.summary:
The custom body is sourced from a single avatar bundle, identified by the
`CustomBodyBundleId` property.

AvatarSettingsCustomClothingMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsCustomClothingMode.summary:
Players keep their own clothing selections. The experience does not
override clothing assets. This is the default value.

AvatarSettingsCustomClothingMode.name: CustomClothing
AvatarSettingsCustomClothingMode.summary:
The experience enforces creator-specified clothing assets from
`AvatarClothingRules`, overriding each player's own equipped clothing.

AvatarSettingsHitAndTouchDetectionMode.name: UseParts
AvatarSettingsHitAndTouchDetectionMode.summary:
Individual avatar body parts handle `Touched` events and spatial queries
(`CanTouch` and `CanQuery` enabled on body parts) while the single
collider part has `CanTouch` and `CanQuery` disabled. This is the default
value for `AvatarCollisionRules.HitAndTouchDetectionMode`.

AvatarSettingsHitAndTouchDetectionMode.name: UseCollider
AvatarSettingsHitAndTouchDetectionMode.summary:
The single collider part handles `Touched` events and spatial queries
(`CanTouch` and `CanQuery` enabled on the collider) while all individual
body parts have `CanTouch` and `CanQuery` disabled.

AvatarSettingsJumpMode.name: JumpHeight
AvatarSettingsJumpMode.summary:
The avatar jump is configured using `Humanoid.JumpHeight`, which
specifies the target jump height in studs. Corresponds to
`Humanoid.UseJumpPower` being false.

AvatarSettingsJumpMode.name: JumpPower
AvatarSettingsJumpMode.summary:
The avatar jump is configured using `Humanoid.JumpPower`, which
applies an upward force to the character. Corresponds to
`Humanoid.UseJumpPower` being true.

AvatarSettingsLegacyCollisionMode.name: R6Colliders
AvatarSettingsLegacyCollisionMode.summary:
Creates six invisible box collider parts welded to R15 limbs to
approximate classic R6 collision geometry. The engine spawns six invisible
`Part` instances (head, torso, left arm, right arm, left leg, right
leg) parented to the character and welded to the corresponding R15 body
parts. All original R15 mesh parts have their `BasePart.CanCollide`,
`BasePart.CanTouch`, and `BasePart.CanQuery` disabled and are
made massless; only the HumanoidRootPart retains mass so it remains the
physics assembly root.

AvatarSettingsLegacyCollisionMode.name: InnerBoxColliders
AvatarSettingsLegacyCollisionMode.summary:
Overrides each R15 mesh part's collision physics with inner-box geometry
derived from the standard R15 scaling model. The engine recalculates every
`MeshPart` in the character with collision data from the default R15
model's bounding dimensions, producing tighter collision volumes that
follow the avatar's proportions without adding extra parts. This is the
default value of `LegacyCollisionMode`.

AvatarSettingsScaleMode.name: PlayerChoice
AvatarSettingsScaleMode.summary:
Characters spawn at their natural avatar height without any
experience-level height override. This is the default value.

AvatarSettingsScaleMode.name: CustomScale
AvatarSettingsScaleMode.summary:
The experience clamps the character's height to the range specified by
`CustomHeight`, overriding the player's natural avatar height.

AvatarUnificationMode.name: Default
AvatarUnificationMode.summary:
Resolves to the engine's current built-in default for avatar unification,
which currently behaves the same as `Disabled`.

AvatarUnificationMode.name: Disabled
AvatarUnificationMode.summary:
Disables the R6-to-R15 adapter; R6 avatars in an R6 experience load using
the standard R6 rig with no adapter parts applied.

AvatarUnificationMode.name: Enabled
AvatarUnificationMode.summary:
Enables the R6-to-R15 adapter; R6 avatars joining an R6 experience receive
invisible R15 adapter `MeshParts` welded to their R6-named
joints, preserving R6 scale while enabling R15 features such as layered
clothing and animatable heads.

BenefitType.name: DeveloperProduct
BenefitType.summary:
The benefit is a developer product whose receipt is delivered through
`MarketplaceService:BindReceiptHandler()` upon purchase of a
commerce product.

BenefitType.name: AvatarAsset
BenefitType.summary:
The benefit is a single avatar asset granted to the user's inventory upon
purchase of a commerce product.

BenefitType.name: AvatarBundle
BenefitType.summary:
The benefit is an avatar bundle granted to the user's inventory upon
purchase of a commerce product.

BorderMode.name: Outline
BorderMode.summary:
As `GuiObject.BorderSizePixel` increases, the border grows outward.
The dimensions of the GuiObject's contents do not change.

BorderMode.name: Middle
BorderMode.summary:
As `GuiObject.BorderSizePixel` increases, the border grows evenly
inward and outward. The dimensions of the GuiObject's contents are reduced
at a 1:1 ratio.

BorderMode.name: Inset
BorderMode.summary:
As `GuiObject.BorderSizePixel` increases, the border grows evenly
inward only. The dimensions of the GuiObject's contents are reduced at a
1:2 ratio.

BorderStrokePosition.name: Outer
BorderStrokePosition.summary: The stroke renders on the outer border of the parent UI element.

BorderStrokePosition.name: Center
BorderStrokePosition.summary: The stroke renders on the center border of the parent UI element.

BorderStrokePosition.name: Inner
BorderStrokePosition.summary: The stroke renders on the inner border of the parent UI element.

BreakReason.name: Other
BreakReason.summary:
Pausing for a reason not covered by other values, for example if the user
hit "Pause" button.

BreakReason.name: Error
BreakReason.summary: Pausing on error hit in the code.

BreakReason.name: SpecialBreakpoint
BreakReason.summary:
Pausing on an internal breakpoint set by debugger command: e.g. step over,
step into, step out of.

BreakpointRemoveReason.name: Requested
BreakpointRemoveReason.summary: Breakpoint removal was requested by user or a command.

BreakpointRemoveReason.name: ScriptChanged
BreakpointRemoveReason.summary: Script that contained the breakpoint has changed.

BreakpointRemoveReason.name: ScriptRemoved
BreakpointRemoveReason.summary: Script that contained the breakpoint was removed.

BulkMoveMode.name: FireAllEvents
BulkMoveMode.summary:
Every property changed event fires for each moved part, including
`CFrame`, `Position`,
`Orientation`, and
`Rotation`.

BulkMoveMode.name: FireCFrameChanged
BulkMoveMode.summary:
Only the `CFrame` property changed event fires for
each moved part; `Position`,
`Orientation`, and
`Rotation` changed events are suppressed.

BundleType.name: BodyParts
BundleType.summary: A bundle of body parts and accessories.

BundleType.name: Shoes
BundleType.summary: A bundle of left shoe and right shoe.

BundleType.name: DynamicHead
BundleType.summary:
A bundle consisting of dynamicHead and moodAnimation assets, optionally
with eyebrowAccessory and eyelashAccessory.

BundleType.name: DynamicHeadAvatar
BundleType.summary:
A bundle containing full body parts and a dynamic head with facial
animation support.

Button.name: Dismount
Button.summary:
Represents the dismount action that can be bound on a `Controller`
to detect when a player triggers the dismount input.

Button.name: Jump
Button.summary:
Represents the jump action that can be bound on a `Controller` to
detect when a player triggers the jump input.

ButtonStyle.name: Custom
ButtonStyle.summary:
The button will respect the `GuiObject.BorderColor3` and
`GuiObject.BackgroundColor3` properties.

ButtonStyle.name: RobloxButtonDefault
ButtonStyle.summary: A black background with a red border, and rounded corners.

ButtonStyle.name: RobloxButton
ButtonStyle.summary: A black background with a grey border, and rounded corners.

ButtonStyle.name: RobloxRoundButton
ButtonStyle.summary: A grey background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

ButtonStyle.name: RobloxRoundDefaultButton
ButtonStyle.summary: A blue background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

ButtonStyle.name: RobloxRoundDropdownButton
ButtonStyle.summary:
A white background with a thin grey border, rounded corners, and a slight
drop shadow.

CageType.name: Inner
CageType.summary:
Selects the inner cage mesh, which defines the surface that conforms to
the body or underlying layer beneath the accessory.

CageType.name: Outer
CageType.summary:
Selects the outer cage mesh, which defines the surface that the next
clothing layer above this accessory conforms to.

CameraMode.name: Classic
CameraMode.summary: Third person camera which can be zoomed into first person.

CameraNavigationModel.name: Roblox
CameraNavigationModel.summary:
Classic Roblox Studio camera navigation model with linear zoom and
focus-locked orbiting; the default value.

CameraNavigationModel.name: IndustryCompatible
CameraNavigationModel.summary:
Camera navigation model that follows industry-standard 3D application
conventions, with non-linear zoom and simultaneous WASD-plus-orbit

first.

allowing custom settings to be supplied.

ChatCallbackType.summary:

currently invoked.

ChatCallbackType.summary:
Client-only callback invoked before a message is displayed, allowing its
display data to be modified.

speaker, allowing the message to be modified or suppressed.

`Chat()` and `ChatLocal()`.

ChatColor.name: Green

`Chat()` or `ChatLocal()`.

ChatColor.name: Red

`Chat()` or `ChatLocal()`.

ChatColor.name: White

The white chat color, passed as the `color` argument to
`Chat()` or `ChatLocal()`.

ChatMode.name: TextAndMenu
ChatMode.summary: A player can chat via custom text messages and a menu of chat messages.

ChatPrivacyMode.summary: A player can chat with all users in a game.

ChatPrivacyMode.name: NoOne

ChatPrivacyMode.name: Friends
ChatPrivacyMode.summary:
A player can only chat with users in a game that are on their friends
list.

ChatRestrictionStatus.summary:
The platform's chat restriction status for the user has not yet been
determined; this is the default value for all ChatRestrictionStatus
properties.

The third-party platform has confirmed the user has no chat restrictions

screen.

ChatStyle.name: ClassicAndBubble

Enables `TextChatService` chat and prevents legacy chat system
behavior.

ClientAnimatorThrottlingMode.summary: The default animation throttling mode defined by Roblox.

CollaboratorStatus.summary:
The collaborator has no active editing context; this is the default

CollaboratorStatus.summary:

CollisionFidelity.name: Default
CollisionFidelity.summary:
Collision model uses a voxel-based convex-hull decomposition that is
relatively fast but may not be highly accurate, especially for holes,
doorways, and cavities in general.

CollisionFidelity.name: Hull
CollisionFidelity.summary: Collision model uses the convex hull of the visual mesh.

CollisionFidelity.name: Box
CollisionFidelity.summary: Collision model uses a bounding box that encompasses the visual mesh.

CollisionFidelity.name: PreciseConvexDecomposition
CollisionFidelity.summary:
Collison model uses a convex-hull decomposition of the visual mesh which
is computed by a variation of an algorithm called HACD. This option is the
most accurate representation of collision geometry for complex objects
with built-in tolerances to reduce the total number of convex-hulls by
compromising on accuracy when justified.

CollisionFidelity.name: Tunable
CollisionFidelity.summary:
Collision model that supports precision tuning of convex decomposition
fidelity.

CommandPermission.name: Plugin
CommandPermission.summary:
The command is accessible to scripts running at the standard Plugin
security level.

CommandPermission.name: LocalUser
CommandPermission.summary:
The command requires the LocalUser security level, granting access to
IDE-only APIs.

CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.name: Insert
CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.summary:
Accepting a completion with either Enter or Tab inserts the suggestion
without replacing existing text after the cursor.

CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.name: Replace
CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.summary:
Accepting a completion with either Enter or Tab replaces existing text
after the cursor with the full suggestion text.

CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.name: ReplaceOnEnterInsertOnTab
CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.summary:
Pressing Enter replaces existing text after the cursor; pressing Tab
inserts without replacing text after the cursor.

CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.name: InsertOnEnterReplaceOnTab
CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.summary:
Pressing Enter inserts without replacing text after the cursor; pressing
Tab replaces text after the cursor. This is the default of
`Studio.AutocompleteAcceptanceBehavior`.

CompletionItemKind.name: Text
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a plain text suggestion.

CompletionItemKind.name: Method
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a method on a class or object.

CompletionItemKind.name: Function
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a function.

CompletionItemKind.name: Constructor
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a constructor.

CompletionItemKind.name: Field
CompletionItemKind.summary:
Indicates the completion item represents a field within a record or
struct.

CompletionItemKind.name: Variable
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a variable binding.

CompletionItemKind.name: Class
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a class or type definition.

CompletionItemKind.name: Interface
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an interface type.

CompletionItemKind.name: Module
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a module.

CompletionItemKind.name: Property
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a property on a class or object.

CompletionItemKind.name: Unit
CompletionItemKind.summary:
Indicates the completion item represents a unit of measurement or a
module-level value.

CompletionItemKind.name: Value
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a value expression.

CompletionItemKind.name: Enum
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an enum type.

CompletionItemKind.name: Keyword
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a language keyword.

CompletionItemKind.name: Snippet
CompletionItemKind.summary:
Indicates the completion item represents an insertable code snippet with
tab stops.

CompletionItemKind.name: Color
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a color value.

CompletionItemKind.name: File
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a file reference.

CompletionItemKind.name: Reference
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a reference to another symbol.

CompletionItemKind.name: Folder
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a folder or directory.

CompletionItemKind.name: EnumMember
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an individual enum member value.

CompletionItemKind.name: Constant
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a constant value.

CompletionItemKind.name: Struct
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a struct or table type.

CompletionItemKind.name: Event
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an event.

CompletionItemKind.name: Operator
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an operator.

CompletionItemKind.name: TypeParameter
CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a generic type parameter.

CompletionItemTag.name: Deprecated
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion is deprecated, applying a penalty towards
its score and crossing it out in the completion list.

CompletionItemTag.name: IncorrectIndexType
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion is a member and being accessed with the
wrong index type (e.g. using `:` to access a property), hiding it from the
completion list.

CompletionItemTag.name: PluginPermissions
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion requires Plugin security level to access,
hiding it if the client lacks this level.

CompletionItemTag.name: CommandLinePermissions
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion requires Command line security level to
access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

CompletionItemTag.name: RobloxPermissions
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion requires core script security level to
access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

CompletionItemTag.name: AddParens
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor after inserting
the given completion, if accepted.

CompletionItemTag.name: PutCursorInParens
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor and move the
cursor into the parentheses after inserting the given completion, if
accepted.

CompletionItemTag.name: TypeCorrect
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion is type correct in the current context,
granting a bonus to its score.

CompletionItemTag.name: ClientServerBoundaryViolation
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion is being accessed from the wrong side of the
client/server boundary (e.g. Players.LocalPlayer in a server script),
hiding it from the completion list.

CompletionItemTag.name: Invalidated
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Indicates that the completion is stale because the cursor has moved
outside the item's valid replacement range, hiding it from the completion
list.

CompletionItemTag.name: PutCursorBeforeEnd
CompletionItemTag.summary:
Instructs the editor to move the cursor to just before the nearest
preceding `end` keyword after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: ColorRGB
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"R"`, `"G"`, and `"B"` to animate the
corresponding components of the `Color3` value returned by the
method `CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: ColorHSV
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"H"`, `"S"`, and `"V"` to animate hue,
saturation, and value of a color that will be converted to RGB before
returning a `Color3` value from the method
`CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: NumberRange
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"Min"` and `"Max"` to animate the corresponding
components of the `NumberRange` value returned by the method
`CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: Rect
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"MinX"`, `"MaxX"`, `"MinY"`, and `"MaxY"` to
animate the corresponding components of the `Rect` value returned
by the method `CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: UDim
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"Scale"` and `"Offset"` to animate the
corresponding components of the `UDim` value returned by the
method `CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: UDim2
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"ScaleX"`, `"OffsetX"`, `"ScaleY"`, and
`"OffsetY"` to animate the corresponding components of the
`UDim2` value returned by the method
`CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: Vector2
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"X"` and `"Y"` to animate the corresponding
components of the `Vector2` value returned by the method
`CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

CompositeValueCurveType.name: Vector3
CompositeValueCurveType.summary:
The `CompositeValueCurve` will animate children of type
`FloatCurve` named `"X"`, `"Y"`, and `"Z"` to animate the
corresponding components of the `Vector3` value returned by the
method `CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime()`.

ContextActionPriority.name: Low

The lowest named priority level (value 1000); an action at this level is
invoked after `High` and `Medium` actions bound to the same input.

ContextActionPriority.name: Medium
ContextActionPriority.summary:
The default priority level (value 2000); used automatically by
`ContextActionService:BindAction()` and falls between `High` and
`Low` in processing order.

ContextActionPriority.name: High
ContextActionPriority.summary:
The highest named priority level (value 3000); an action at this level is

ContextActionResult.name: Sink
ContextActionResult.summary:
If `functionToBind` from `ContextActionService:BindAction()` returns
`ContextActionResult.Sink`, the input event will stop at that
function and no other bound actions under it will be processed. This is
the default behavior if `functionToBind` does not return anything or
yields in any way.

ContextActionResult.name: Pass
ContextActionResult.summary:
If `functionToBind` from `ContextActionService:BindAction()` returns
`ContextActionResult.Pass`, the input event is considered to have not
been handled by `functionToBind` and will continue being passed to actions
bound to the same input type.

DistanceAttenuationMode.name: Custom
DistanceAttenuationMode.summary:
Uses the developer-supplied
`DistanceAttenuation` curve for
gain rolloff.

DistanceAttenuationMode.name: InverseTapered
DistanceAttenuationMode.summary:
Volume attenuates according to a hybrid model which follows the
`DistanceAttenuationMode.Inverse` model when close to the lower bound
of `AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds` and the
`DistanceAttenuationMode.LinearSquared` model when close to the upper
bound of `AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds`. This is done by
taking the lesser of these two curves, such that the curve mostly follows
an inverse relationship but tapers to silence at the maximum distance.

DistanceAttenuationMode.name: Linear
DistanceAttenuationMode.summary:
Volume attenuates between the bounds of
`AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds` with a linear relationship.
This is done by computing (`maxDistance` - `distance`) / (`maxDistance` -
`minDistance`), where distance is the `Vector3.Magnitude` between
the `AudioEmitter`'s position and the `AudioListener`'s
position.

DistanceAttenuationMode.name: LinearSquared
DistanceAttenuationMode.summary:
Volume attenuates between the bounds of
`AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds` with a linear-squared
relationship. This is done by squaring the formula used to determine the
volume when using `DistanceAttenuationMode.Linear`, which creates a
parabolic curve with a steeper fade.

DistanceAttenuationMode.name: Inverse
DistanceAttenuationMode.summary:
Volume attenuates from the lower bound of
`AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds` in an inverse manner,
mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world. This is done by
computing (`minDistance`/`distance`), where `distance` is the
`Vector2.Magnitude` between the `AudioEmitter`'s position and
the `AudioListener`'s position.

object, behavior is the same as for an anchored object; however, in a
running experience, the object will be anchored at the start of the drag
and restored to unanchored upon drag release.

DragDetectorResponseStyle.name: Physical

An `Anchored` object will default to **Geometric**
behavior as it is not affected by forces. An unanchored object will be
moved by constraint forces that attempt to bring it to the desired
position and/or orientation given by the proposed motion.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightLowerLipDepressor
FacsActionUnit.summary: Lowers the right side of the lower lip to reveal the lower teeth.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightLipCornerPuller
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the right mouth corner into a smile.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightLipStretcher
FacsActionUnit.summary: Stretches the right mouth corner outward.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightUpperLipRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the right side of the upper lip to reveal the upper teeth.

FacsActionUnit.name: JawDrop
FacsActionUnit.summary: Lowers the jaw to open the mouth.

FacsActionUnit.name: JawLeft
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the mouth and jaw toward the character's left.

FacsActionUnit.name: JawRight
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the mouth and jaw toward the character's right.

FacsActionUnit.name: Corrugator
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the left and right eyebrows inward.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftBrowLowerer
FacsActionUnit.summary: Lowers the left eyebrow.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftOuterBrowRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the outer part of the left eyebrow.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftNoseWrinkler
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the left nostril and wrinkles the left side of the nose.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftInnerBrowRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the inner half of the left eyebrow.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightBrowLowerer
FacsActionUnit.summary: Lowers the right eyebrow.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightOuterBrowRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the outer part of the right eyebrow.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightInnerBrowRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the inner half of the right eyebrow.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightNoseWrinkler
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the right nostril and wrinkles the right side of the nose.

FacsActionUnit.name: EyesLookDown
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the gaze downward.

FacsActionUnit.name: EyesLookLeft
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the gaze to the left.

FacsActionUnit.name: EyesLookUp
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the gaze upward.

FacsActionUnit.name: EyesLookRight
FacsActionUnit.summary: Moves the gaze to the right.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftCheekRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the left cheek and squints the left eye.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftEyeUpperLidRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the left upper eyelid to reveal more of the eye above the iris.

FacsActionUnit.name: LeftEyeClosed
FacsActionUnit.summary: Closes the left eyelid.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightCheekRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the right cheek and squints the right eye.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightEyeUpperLidRaiser
FacsActionUnit.summary: Raises the right upper eyelid to reveal more of the eye above the iris.

FacsActionUnit.name: RightEyeClosed
FacsActionUnit.summary: Closes the right eyelid.

FacsActionUnit.name: TongueDown
FacsActionUnit.summary: Bends the tongue downward.

FacsActionUnit.name: TongueOut
FacsActionUnit.summary: Extends the tip of the tongue out of the mouth.

FacsActionUnit.name: TongueUp
FacsActionUnit.summary: Bends the tongue upward.

FieldOfViewMode.name: Vertical
FieldOfViewMode.summary:
The camera holds its vertical field of view constant when the viewport is
resized.

FieldOfViewMode.name: Diagonal
FieldOfViewMode.summary:
The camera holds its diagonal field of view constant when the viewport is
resized.

FieldOfViewMode.name: MaxAxis
FieldOfViewMode.summary:
The camera holds the field of view along the longer viewport axis constant
when the viewport is resized.

FileMode.name: Binary
FileMode.summary:
Reads or writes raw bytes with no line-ending transformation, preserving
all characters exactly as stored on disk.

FileMode.name: Text
FileMode.summary:
Reads or writes file content with `\r\n` sequences normalized to `\n`,
ensuring consistent line endings across platforms.

FileSystemWalkMode.name: NonRecursive
FileSystemWalkMode.summary:
Visits only the immediate entries of the specified directory, without
descending into subdirectories.

FileSystemWalkMode.name: Recursive
FileSystemWalkMode.summary:
Visits all entries in the specified directory and all of its
subdirectories, incrementing the iterator's `Depth` field for each level
descended.

FilterErrorType.name: BackslashNotEscapingAnything
FilterErrorType.summary: A backslash at the end of a quoted string has nothing after it to escape.

FilterErrorType.name: BadBespokeFilter
FilterErrorType.summary:
A recognized bespoke filter keyword (such as `classname:`) is missing its
required value, or a `query:` expression contains an invalid query string.

FilterErrorType.name: BadName
FilterErrorType.summary:
An unexpected token was encountered where a name or identifier was
expected.

FilterErrorType.name: IncompleteOr
FilterErrorType.summary:
Reserved error code for an incomplete `or` expression; currently not
emitted by the filter engine.

FilterErrorType.name: IncompleteParenthesis
FilterErrorType.summary:
An opening parenthesis `(` in the filter expression has no matching
closing parenthesis `)`.

FilterErrorType.name: InvalidDoubleStar
FilterErrorType.summary:
A `**` wildcard token directly follows a `*` wildcard in a dotted name
path (for example, `A.*.**.X`), which is not allowed.

FilterErrorType.name: InvalidTilde
FilterErrorType.summary:
A lone `~` character was found that is not part of the `~=` not-equal
operator.

FilterErrorType.name: PropertyBadOperator
FilterErrorType.summary:
A comparison operator other than `=` or `~=` was used with a property type
that only supports equality comparisons.

FilterErrorType.name: PropertyDoesNotExist
FilterErrorType.summary:
The named property does not exist on any reflected class known to the
filter engine.

FilterErrorType.name: PropertyInvalidField
FilterErrorType.summary:
A sub-field index (such as `.W`) was used with a vector or color property
that does not have a field by that name.

FilterErrorType.name: PropertyInvalidValue
FilterErrorType.summary:
The value string provided for a property comparison cannot be parsed into
the expected type for that property (for example, `Locked=notabool`).

FilterErrorType.name: PropertyUnsupportedFields
FilterErrorType.summary:
A sub-field index was used with a property type that does not support
field access (for example, `Locked.X=true`).

FilterErrorType.name: PropertyUnsupportedProperty
FilterErrorType.summary:
The named property exists but its type is not supported by the filter
engine (for example, complex datatypes such as `CFrame` or `TweenInfo`).

FilterErrorType.name: UnexpectedNameIndex
FilterErrorType.summary:
A `.` in a dotted name path is not followed by a valid name, number, or
wildcard token.

FilterErrorType.name: UnexpectedToken
FilterErrorType.summary:
A token that cannot be a value (such as an operator) appears where a value
is expected after a comparison operator.

FilterErrorType.name: UnfinishedBinaryOperator
FilterErrorType.summary: An `and` or `or` binary operator appears with no right-hand operand.

FilterErrorType.name: UnfinishedQuote
FilterErrorType.summary:
A quoted string was opened but not closed before the end of the filter
input.

FilterErrorType.name: UnknownBespokeFilter
FilterErrorType.summary:
A `name:value` token uses a keyword that is not a recognized bespoke
filter type (for example, `foo:Bar`).

FilterErrorType.name: WildcardInProperty
FilterErrorType.summary:
A wildcard (`*` or `**`) appears in the property portion of a dotted
expression where a concrete property name is required.

FinishRecordingOperation.name: Cancel
FinishRecordingOperation.summary: Cancels the recording, automatically undoing any work in progress.

FinishRecordingOperation.name: Append
FinishRecordingOperation.summary:
Commits the recorded work and merges with the previous recording if
possible.

FluidFidelity.name: Automatic
FluidFidelity.summary:
Let the physics engine select the geometric representation for aerodynamic
force and torque calculations.

FluidFidelity.name: UseCollisionGeometry
FluidFidelity.summary:
Use the current collision geometry specified by
`TriangleMeshPart.CollisionFidelity` for aerodynamic force and
torque calculations .

FluidFidelity.name: UsePreciseGeometry
FluidFidelity.summary:
Force the engine to compute aerodynamic forces and torques using a more
precise geometry representation based on the original mesh. This option
may increase join and replication time if used on a large scale.

FluidForces.name: Default
FluidForces.summary:
Aerodynamic forces will not be calculated on any
`BaseParts`.

FluidForces.name: Experimental
FluidForces.summary:
Aerodynamic forces will be calculated on `BaseParts` with
`EnableFluidForces` set to true. During
the beta phase, the behavior of the aerodynamic force model may change as
the model improves.

Font.name: Arial
Font.summary:
`Arial` has been removed. Using it will map to the `Arimo` font family of
the `Font` data type.

Font.name: ArialBold
Font.summary:
`ArialBold` has been removed. Using it will map to the `Arimo` font family
of the `Font` data type.

Font.name: Gotham
Font.summary:
`Gotham` has been removed. Using it will map to the `Montserrat` font
family of the `Font` data type.

Font.name: GothamMedium
Font.summary:
`GothamMedium` has been removed. Using it will map to the `Montserrat`
font family of the `Font` data type.

Font.name: GothamBold
Font.summary:
`GothamBold` has been removed. Using it will map to the `Montserrat` font
family of the `Font` data type.

Font.name: GothamBlack
Font.summary:
`GothamBlack` has been removed. Using it will map to the `Montserrat` font
family of the `Font` data type.

Font.name: Unknown
Font.summary:
Set when the GUI object's font face is set to a `Font` that has
no corresponding enum value.

FontStyle.name: Normal
FontStyle.summary: The text renders normally with this font.

FontStyle.name: Italic
FontStyle.summary: The text renders italic with this font.

ForceLimitMode.name: Magnitude
ForceLimitMode.summary:
A single number is used to specify the magnitude of the maximum constraint
force. The constraint will ensure that the force it applies will have a
magnitude that is less than this limit.

ForceLimitMode.name: PerAxis
ForceLimitMode.summary:
A vector is used to specify the maximum force value along each axis of a
given reference frame. The constraint will ensure that each component of
the force will have an absolute value that's less than the corresponding
vector entry.

FormFactor.name: Symmetric
FormFactor.summary: Increases by a rate of 1 along all axes.

FormFactor.name: Brick
FormFactor.summary: Increases by a rate of 1 along the x- and z- axes, 1.2 along the y-axis.

FormFactor.name: Plate
FormFactor.summary: Increases by a rate of 1 along the x- and z- axes, 0.4 along the y-axis.

FormFactor.name: Custom
FormFactor.summary: Increases by a rate as low as .001 along all axes.

FrameStyle.name: Custom
FrameStyle.summary:
Uses the frame's `GuiObject.BackgroundColor3`,
`GuiObject.BorderColor3`, and
`GuiObject.BackgroundTransparency` properties to determine the
frame's appearance. It has no padding; elements with the position
`UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)` will appear at the frame's top-left
corner.

FrameStyle.name: ChatBlue
FrameStyle.summary:
Causes the frame to appear similar to a `Dialog` with its
`Tone` property set to `DialogTone.Neutral`. Like
**ChatGreen** and **ChatRed**, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on all
sides.

FrameStyle.name: RobloxSquare
FrameStyle.summary:
Causes the frame to appear as a translucent dark gray rectangle with a
padding of five pixels on all sides.

FrameStyle.name: RobloxRound
FrameStyle.summary:
Causes the frame to appear as a translucent dark gray rectangle with
rounded edges. Like **RobloxSquare**, this has a padding of five pixels on
all sides.

FrameStyle.name: ChatGreen
FrameStyle.summary:
Causes the frame to appear similar to a `Dialog` with its
`Tone` property set to `DialogTone.Friendly`. Like
**ChatBlue** and **ChatRed**, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on all
sides.

FrameStyle.name: ChatRed
FrameStyle.summary:
Causes the frame to appear similar to a `Dialog` with its
`Tone` property set to `DialogTone.Enemy`. Like
**ChatBlue** and **ChatGreen**, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on
all sides.

FrameStyle.name: DropShadow
FrameStyle.summary:
Causes the frame to appear as a translucent gray rectangle with blurred
sides. The blur is more apparent on the bottom edge. It has a padding of
eight pixels on all sides.

FramerateManagerMode.name: Automatic
FramerateManagerMode.summary:
The engine selects whether to run FRM based on hardware and platform
context. This is the default.

FramerateManagerMode.name: On
FramerateManagerMode.summary:
FRM is explicitly enabled and dynamically adjusts rendering quality to
meet frame rate targets.

FramerateManagerMode.name: Off
FramerateManagerMode.summary:
FRM quality throttling is disabled; block count is fixed at the baseline
level regardless of frame rate.

FrustumStreamingMode.name: Automatic
FrustumStreamingMode.summary:
Allow the engine to decide when to stream the camera view based client
ability and gameplay factors.

FunctionalTestResult.name: Warning
FunctionalTestResult.summary: The test run is potentially unstable.

GameAvatarType.name: PlayerChoice
GameAvatarType.summary:
The rig (either R6 or
[R15](../../../avatar/character-bodies/specifications.md#rigging)
determined by a player's character settings set on the website in the
'Edit Avatar' page.

GamepadType.name: Unknown
GamepadType.summary:
A gamepad whose hardware type could not be determined, or no gamepad has
connected yet.

GearGenreSetting.name: MatchingGenreOnly
GearGenreSetting.summary:
Only gear genres matching the allowed genres specified in a place's
configuration settings.

Genre.name: All
Genre.summary:
The game's genre is set to All. The game will be listed as all possible
genres.

Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Town and City.

Genre.name: Fantasy

Genre.name: SciFi
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to SciFi (Science Fiction).

Genre.name: Ninja
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Ninja.

Genre.name: Scary
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Scary.

Genre.name: Pirate
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Pirate.

Genre.name: Adventure
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Adventure.

Genre.name: Sports
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Sports.

Genre.name: Funny
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Funny.

Genre.name: WildWest
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Wild West.

Genre.name: War
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to War.

Genre.name: SkatePark
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Skate Park.

Genre.name: Tutorial
Genre.summary: The game's genre is set to Tutorial.

GradientTileMode.name: Clamp
GradientTileMode.summary:
Default mode where the color/transparency values at the start and end of
the sequence extend infinitely, so the start values fill any area before
the gradient and the end values fill any area after it.

GradientTileMode.name: Repeat
GradientTileMode.summary:
The gradient repeats by wrapping the color/transparency sequence tiles
seamlessly from end back to start. This can produce a visible seam if the
first and last color/transparency values in the sequence differ.

GradientTileMode.name: Mirror
GradientTileMode.summary:
The gradient reflects at each boundary so the color/transparency sequence
ping-pongs. This produces a smooth repetition with no seam, since the
direction reverses at each tile edge.

GradientType.name: Linear
GradientType.summary:
The color/transparency sequence transitions in a straight line across the
element. The direction is controlled by
`Rotation` and the position by
`Offset`.

GradientType.name: Radial
GradientType.summary:
The color/transparency sequence radiates outward from the element's
center, optionally shifted by `Offset`. The radius
is defined by the average of the element's width and height divided by
two, effectively `(width+height)/4`. `Rotation`
has no effect on a radial gradient.

GradientType.name: Conical
GradientType.summary:
The color/transparency sequence sweeps clockwise around the center of the
element, optionally shifted by `Offset`.
`Rotation` controls the starting angle of the
sweep.

GraphicsMode.name: Automatic
GraphicsMode.summary:
Roblox will automatically decide what graphics mode to use, depending on
what best suits your device's specifications.

GraphicsMode.name: NoGraphics
GraphicsMode.summary:
Game will not be rendered, and instead a _Diagnostics_ window is rendered
on screen.

GraphicsOptimizationMode.name: Performance
GraphicsOptimizationMode.summary:
Prefers frame rate over visual fidelity, corresponding to manual render
quality levels 1–3.

GraphicsOptimizationMode.name: Balanced
GraphicsOptimizationMode.summary:
Middle-ground preference, corresponding to manual render quality levels
4–7. This is the default of
`UserGameSettings.GraphicsOptimizationMode`.

GraphicsOptimizationMode.name: Quality
GraphicsOptimizationMode.summary:
Prefers visual fidelity over frame rate, corresponding to manual render
quality levels 8–10.

GroupMembershipStatus.name: None
GroupMembershipStatus.summary:
The player chose not to join, cancelled the prompt, or was not eligible to
join the group.

GroupMembershipStatus.name: Joined
GroupMembershipStatus.summary: The player successfully joined the group during the prompt.

GroupMembershipStatus.name: JoinRequestPending
GroupMembershipStatus.summary:
The player submitted a request to join the group, or already had a pending
join request prior to prompting.

GroupMembershipStatus.name: AlreadyMember
GroupMembershipStatus.summary: The player was already a member of the group.

GuiState.name: Idle
GuiState.summary: The GuiObject is idle — neither hovered nor pressed.

GuiState.name: Hover
GuiState.summary: The GUI is being hovered over by the user.

GuiState.name: Press
GuiState.summary: The GUI is being pressed/held down by the user.

GuiState.name: NonInteractable
GuiState.summary: The GUI cannot be interacted with and therefore has no states.

HandlesStyle.name: Resize
HandlesStyle.summary:
Renders `Handles` as sphere shapes for resizing an adornee along its
face axes (the default style).

HandlesStyle.name: Movement
HandlesStyle.summary:
Renders `Handles` as directional arrow shapes for translating an
adornee along its face axes.

HapticEffectType.name: Custom
HapticEffectType.summary:
Allows for application of a custom haptic waveform through the
`HapticEffect:SetWaveformKeys()` method.

HapticEffectType.name: UIHover
HapticEffectType.summary:
Useful for when a player browses over an object (often a UI object)
without the intention of triggering its action; it can also alert the
player that they have browsed over an interactable object. This effect
type is subtle and does not disrupt the gameplay experience.

HapticEffectType.name: UIClick
HapticEffectType.summary:
Useful for when a player has selected an object (often a UI object) with
the intention of triggering its action. This effect type is crisp and it
provides immediate feedback without being overwhelming.

HapticEffectType.name: UINotification
HapticEffectType.summary:
Useful for when there is an inbound message that should draw the player's
attention away from their current gameplay and prompt them that the
notification requires immediate attention or action.

HapticEffectType.name: GameplayExplosion
HapticEffectType.summary:
Useful to signify a large-scale physics event that triggers impact across
a large portion of a given scene. This effect is high intensity in order
to represent the magnitude of the impact and it lingers for a longer
period of time than `GameplayCollision`.

HapticEffectType.name: GameplayCollision
HapticEffectType.summary:
This effect is a large immediate rumble that dies down quickly, useful to
signify a clear and purposeful impact between objects.

HashAlgorithm.name: Blake2b
HashAlgorithm.summary:
Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the
[BLAKE2b](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BLAKE2) algorithm.

HashAlgorithm.name: Blake3
HashAlgorithm.summary:
Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the
[BLAKE3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BLAKE3) algorithm.

HashAlgorithm.name: Md5
HashAlgorithm.summary:
Used to compute a 128-bit (16-byte) hash digest using the
[MD5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MD5) algorithm.

HashAlgorithm.name: Sha1
HashAlgorithm.summary:
Used to compute a 160-bit (20-byte) hash digest using the
[SHA-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-1) algorithm.

HashAlgorithm.name: Sha256
HashAlgorithm.summary:
Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the
[SHA256](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHA-2) algorithm.

HighlightDepthMode.name: AlwaysOnTop
HighlightDepthMode.summary: Allows the `Highlight` to display regardless if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object. This means the viewer is always able to see the highlight regardless of what is between the highlighted object and the camera.

HighlightDepthMode.name: Occluded
HighlightDepthMode.summary: Hides the `Highlight` if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object. This means the viewer is only able to see the object if there are no obstructing objects between the highlighted object and the camera's view.

HorizontalAlignment.name: Center
HorizontalAlignment.summary: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the **X** axis.

HorizontalAlignment.name: Left
HorizontalAlignment.summary: Grid is aligned to the left edge of its parent.

HorizontalAlignment.name: Right
HorizontalAlignment.summary: Grid is aligned to the right edge of its parent.

HttpCompression.name: None
HttpCompression.summary: No compression is applied to the request body. This is the default.

HttpCompression.name: Gzip
HttpCompression.summary: The request body is compressed using the Gzip algorithm before being sent.

HttpError.name: OK
HttpError.summary:
No error occurred; the request completed successfully. This value is
unrelated to the HTTP 200 OK status code.

HttpError.name: InvalidUrl
HttpError.summary:
The request URL is malformed or otherwise invalid; depending on the
platform, a bad URL might instead surface as `HttpError.DnsResolve`
or `HttpError.ConnectFail`.

HttpError.name: DnsResolve
HttpError.summary: The hostname in the request URL could not be resolved via DNS.

HttpError.name: ConnectFail
HttpError.summary: The client failed to establish a TCP connection to the remote host.

HttpError.name: OutOfMemory
HttpError.summary:
The client ran out of memory while processing the HTTP request or
response.

HttpError.name: TimedOut
HttpError.summary: The request did not receive a response within the allowed time limit.

HttpError.name: TooManyRedirects
HttpError.summary:
The server returned more redirects than the client is configured to
follow.

HttpError.name: InvalidRedirect
HttpError.summary:
The server returned a redirect response with an invalid or malformed
Location header.

HttpError.name: NetFail
HttpError.summary:
A general network-level failure occurred that does not fall into a more
specific error category.

HttpError.name: Aborted
HttpError.summary: The HTTP request was aborted before it could complete.

HttpError.name: SslConnectFail
HttpError.summary:
The TLS/SSL handshake with the remote server failed during connection
establishment.

HttpError.name: SslVerificationFail
HttpError.summary: The server's TLS certificate could not be verified.

HttpError.name: Unknown
HttpError.summary: An error occurred that does not map to any other `HttpError` value.

HttpError.name: ConnectionClosed
HttpError.summary:
The connection was closed by the remote end before the full response was
received, typically indicating a server or network problem.

HttpError.name: ServerProtocolError
HttpError.summary: An HTTP/2 protocol-level error was returned by the server.

HttpError.name: CreatorEnvironmentsNotSupportedByService
HttpError.summary:
The request was sent from a non-live environment (such as Studio) and the
target service does not support creator environments.

HttpError.name: InactivityTimeout
HttpError.summary:
A streaming request timed out because no data was transferred during the
inactivity window.

HttpError.name: TooManyOutstandingRequests
HttpError.summary:
The request was rejected because the client has exceeded its limit for
concurrent or pending requests.

HttpError.name: InvalidRangeResponse
HttpError.summary:
The server returned an invalid response to a ranged HTTP request, such as
responding with a full 200 status instead of the expected 206 Partial
Content.

HumanoidCollisionType.name: OuterBox
HumanoidCollisionType.summary: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

HumanoidCollisionType.name: InnerBox
HumanoidCollisionType.summary: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.name: Viewer
HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.summary:
A player selecting `Viewer` on their `Humanoid` will see the Name
and healthbar of other players if those other players are within the
distance settings set in the `Humanoid` selecting `Viewer` (this can
be thought of as the lowest priority, and will not be taken into account
if other players are selecting 'Subject' or 'None').

HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.name: Subject
HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.summary:
A player selecting `Subject` on their `Humanoid` will allow other
players to see their Name and healthbar if those other players are within
the distance settings set in the `Humanoid` selecting `Subject`
(this can be thought of as the second highest priority).

HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.name: None
HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.summary:
A player selecting `None` on their `Humanoid` will not have their
Name and healthbar displayed to other players under any circumstance (this
can be thought of as the highest priority).

HumanoidHealthDisplayType.name: DisplayWhenDamaged
HumanoidHealthDisplayType.summary:
The humanoid's health bar is only visible when the humanoid is not at full
health (assuming `MaxHealth` is greater than zero).

HumanoidHealthDisplayType.name: AlwaysOn
HumanoidHealthDisplayType.summary:
The humanoid's health bar is always visible (assuming `MaxHealth` is
greater than zero).

HumanoidHealthDisplayType.name: AlwaysOff
HumanoidHealthDisplayType.summary: The humanoid's health bar is never visible.

HumanoidRigType.name: R6
HumanoidRigType.summary: Indicates that a character is using the legacy R6 rig.

HumanoidRigType.name: R15
HumanoidRigType.summary: Indicates that a character is using an R15 rig.

HumanoidStateType.name: FallingDown
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid has been tripped, and will attempt to get up in a few
moments.

HumanoidStateType.name: Ragdoll
HumanoidStateType.summary:
(Deprecated) The Humanoid has been hit by a fast moving object
(uncontrolled falling). _The Humanoid can recover from this._ This state
has to be set and unset manually using `Humanoid:ChangeState()`.

HumanoidStateType.name: GettingUp
HumanoidStateType.summary: The Humanoid is getting back on their feet after FallingDown or Ragdoll.

HumanoidStateType.name: Jumping
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid just jumped. (Check `Humanoid.Jump`). This state lasts
only briefly. This state normally transitions into either Landed, if on
the ground, or Freefall, if still in the air.

HumanoidStateType.name: Swimming
HumanoidStateType.summary: The Humanoid is currently swimming in `Terrain` water.

HumanoidStateType.name: Freefall
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid is currently freefalling (jumped from a height or fell off a
ledge).

HumanoidStateType.name: Flying
HumanoidStateType.summary:
When set, the Humanoid won't be animated, as with the
`Humanoid.PlatformStand` property. This state lasts as long as the
player flies.

HumanoidStateType.name: Landed
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid touched the ground after a Freefall. This state lasts only
briefly.

HumanoidStateType.name: Running
HumanoidStateType.summary: Currently running while on the ground.

HumanoidStateType.name: RunningNoPhysics
HumanoidStateType.summary: (Deprecated) Currently running and not near other physical objects.

HumanoidStateType.name: StrafingNoPhysics
HumanoidStateType.summary:
Not currently used with default Humanoid. Cannot be set with
`Humanoid:ChangeState()`.

HumanoidStateType.name: Climbing
HumanoidStateType.summary: The Humanoid is climbing (e.g. up a `TrussPart` or ladder).

HumanoidStateType.name: Seated
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid is currently sitting in a Seat or VehicleSeat. Check the
`Humanoid.Sit` property.

HumanoidStateType.name: PlatformStanding
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid is platformstanding. Check the `Humanoid.PlatformStand`
property.

HumanoidStateType.name: Dead
HumanoidStateType.summary: The Humanoid died. Changing a Humanoid's state to this state will kill it.

HumanoidStateType.name: Physics
HumanoidStateType.summary:
The Humanoid doesn't apply any force on its own and will not automatically
transition to any other state. This state has to be set and unset manually
using `Humanoid:ChangeState()`.

HumanoidStateType.name: None
HumanoidStateType.summary: Unusable placeholder in case an unknown state gets triggered internally.

IKCollisionsMode.name: NoCollisions
IKCollisionsMode.summary:
Only the part and any parts directly joined to it via
joints/`constraints` will be involved in the resolution;
everything else in the workspace will be treated as though it doesn't
exist.

IKCollisionsMode.name: OtherMechanismsAnchored
IKCollisionsMode.summary:
Only the part and any parts directly joined to it via
joints/`constraints` will be moved during resolution, but
they will collide with other objects in the workspace.

IKCollisionsMode.name: IncludeContactedMechanisms
IKCollisionsMode.summary:
The part, any parts directly joined to it via
joints/`constraints`, and any parts which it comes into
contact with during the solve will be moved during the resolution. That
is, the moved parts will be allowed to "push" other unanchored parts in
the workspace out of the way in order to get to the target position.

IKControlConstraintSupport.name: Default
IKControlConstraintSupport.summary:
The default option for `IKControls`. The default is
currently set to `Enabled`.

IKControlConstraintSupport.name: Disabled
IKControlConstraintSupport.summary:
Disables support for constraints for `IKControls`. When
disabled, `IKControls` still work, but ignore physics
constraints.

IKControlType.name: Transform
IKControlType.summary:
It is a full 6-DoF constraint. Aligns the
`EndEffector` `CFrame` to that of the
`Target`. It is the default value.

IKControlType.name: Position
IKControlType.summary:
Aligns the `EndEffector` position to that of
the `Target` .

IKControlType.name: Rotation
IKControlType.summary:
Aligns the `EndEffector` rotation to that of
the `Target`.

IKControlType.name: LookAt
IKControlType.summary:
Moves and orients the whole chain to make the forward axis on the
`EndEffector` point at a position in the world
specified by `Target`.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: None
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
The default status when the IXP controller is first constructed or after
layers have been cleared.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: Pending
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
An HTTP request to fetch layer assignments has been sent and a response is
awaited.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: Initialized
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
The HTTP request completed successfully and layer variable values have
been populated from the response.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: ErrorInvalidUser
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
The fetch failed because the requested subject (user) was invalid at the
time of the request.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: ErrorConnection
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
The HTTP request to fetch layer assignments failed due to a connection
error.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: ErrorJsonParse
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
The HTTP request succeeded but the response body could not be parsed as
valid JSON.

IXPLoadingStatus.name: ErrorTimedOut
IXPLoadingStatus.summary:
The HTTP request to fetch layer assignments timed out before a response
was received.

ImageAlphaType.name: Default
ImageAlphaType.summary: The default behavior in which neither color nor alpha values are locked.

ImageAlphaType.name: LockCanvasAlpha
ImageAlphaType.summary: The alpha values of the image will not be modified.

ImageAlphaType.name: LockCanvasColor
ImageAlphaType.summary: The color values of the image will not be modified.

ImageCombineType.name: BlendSourceOver
ImageCombineType.summary:
Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination using
source over alpha blending.

ImageCombineType.name: Overwrite
ImageCombineType.summary:
Overwrites all pixels in the destination image with pixels from the source
image.

ImageCombineType.name: Add
ImageCombineType.summary:
Adds pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together.
Source RGB values are scaled by the source alpha, while source alpha is
added directly to destination alpha.

ImageCombineType.name: Multiply
ImageCombineType.summary:
Multiplies pixels from the source and pixels from the destination
together. RGBA values are multiplied as values between `0` and `1`. Values
lower than `1` have a darkening effect on the image.

ImageCombineType.name: AlphaBlend
ImageCombineType.summary:
Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination based on
the alpha of the source pixels. Unlike **BlendSourceOver**, the
destination color in **AlphaBlend** affects the resulting color of the
image, regardless of the destination color's alpha.

ImageCombineType.name: NormalMapBlend
ImageCombineType.summary:
Blends pixels from the source with the destination using alpha blending,
then renormalizes the resulting RGB values as a tangent-space normal
vector.

ImageCombineType.name: Subtract
ImageCombineType.summary:
Subtracts pixels of the source from pixels of the destination. Source RGB
values are scaled by the source alpha, while source alpha is subtracted
directly from destination alpha.

InOut.name: Edge
InOut.summary: The object is located along an edge of its parent.

InOut.name: Inset
InOut.summary: The object's located is inset from its parent's location.

InOut.name: Center
InOut.summary: The object's location is centered on it's parent.

InfoType.name: GamePass
InfoType.summary: The product is a game pass.

InitialDockState.name: Top
InitialDockState.summary: The widget will appear docked above the game screen.

InitialDockState.name: Bottom
InitialDockState.summary: The widget will appear docked below the game screen.

InitialDockState.name: Left
InitialDockState.summary: The widget will appear docked to the left of the game screen.

InitialDockState.name: Right
InitialDockState.summary: The widget will appear docked to the right of the game screen.

InitialDockState.name: Float
InitialDockState.summary:
The widget will not be docked to any side of the game screen, and instead
can be freely dragged around.

InputActionType.name: Bool
InputActionType.summary:
The `InputAction` will receive boolean values from button inputs,
for example `true`/`false` on press/release from inputs such as
`KeyCode.ButtonA` or `KeyCode.E`. This setting also exposes the
`UIButton` property on child
`InputBindings`, allowing you to easily hook up press
or release of a `GuiButton` for the action.

InputActionType.name: Direction1D
InputActionType.summary:
The `InputAction` will receive numerical values, generally from
analog gamepad triggers such as `KeyCode.ButtonL2` or
`KeyCode.ButtonR2`. This setting also exposes the
`Up` and `Down` properties
on child `InputBindings`, allowing for boolean inputs
or "1D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

InputActionType.name: Direction2D
InputActionType.summary:
The `InputAction` will receive `Vector2` values, generally
from thumbstick inputs such as `KeyCode.Thumbstick1` and
`KeyCode.Thumbstick2`. This setting also exposes the
`Up`, `Down`,
`Left`, and `Right`
properties on child `InputBindings`, allowing for "2D"
inputs as composite directions for the action.

InputActionType.name: Direction3D
InputActionType.summary:
The `InputAction` will receive `Vector3` values from inputs
assigned to the `Up`,
`Down`, `Left`,
`Right`, `Forward`,
and/or `Backward` properties on child
`InputBindings`, allowing for "3D" inputs as composite
directions for the action.

InputActionType.name: ViewportPosition
InputActionType.summary:
The `InputAction` will receive `Vector2` values
representing the absolute pixel (**X**, **Y**) coordinates of a pointer
input in the viewport.

InputBindingType.name: Automatic
InputBindingType.summary:
The `InputBinding` responds to physical input devices (keyboard,
mouse, gamepad, touch) based on its `KeyCode`
or composite direction properties. This is the default.

InputBindingType.name: Scriptable
InputBindingType.summary:
The `InputBinding` ignores hardware input and instead receives state
updates exclusively through the `InputBinding:Fire()` method.

InputSink.name: None
InputSink.summary:
The element does not sink any input events; pointer and activation events
pass through to elements beneath it.

InputSink.name: Activate
InputSink.summary:
The element sinks activation input (button presses and taps) but allows
hover, `MouseEnter`, and `MouseLeave` events to pass through to elements
beneath it.

InputSink.name: All
InputSink.summary:
The element sinks all input events, preventing them from reaching any GUI
element beneath it.

InputType.name: NoInput
InputType.summary: Behaves like a weld and does nothing.

InputType.name: Constant
InputType.summary: Rotate at a constant velocity of `BasePart` `ParamB`.

InputType.name: Sin
InputType.summary:
Rotate at a velocity of:
`ParamA * math.sin(workspace.DistributedGameTime * ParamB)`, where
`BasePart` `ParamA` determines the maximum speed at which the part
spins, and `BasePart` `ParamB` determines how frequently it changes
direction.

InstanceFileSyncStatus.name: NotSynced
InstanceFileSyncStatus.summary: The `Instance` is not being synced or errored.

InstanceFileSyncStatus.name: Errored
InstanceFileSyncStatus.summary: The `Instance` is a sync root that has errored and stopped syncing.

InstanceFileSyncStatus.name: SyncedAsRoot
InstanceFileSyncStatus.summary: The `Instance` is being synced as the root of a sync tree.

InstanceFileSyncStatus.name: SyncedAsDescendant
InstanceFileSyncStatus.summary:
The `Instance` is being synced because it is a descendant of a sync
root.

InstanceFileSyncStatus.name: AncestorErrored
InstanceFileSyncStatus.summary:
The `Instance` is not currently being synced because the root of its
sync tree is `Errored`.

IntermediateMeshGenerationResult.name: HighQualityMesh
IntermediateMeshGenerationResult.summary:
Signals that the intermediate mesh delivered to the callback is
high-quality.

InterpolationThrottlingMode.name: Default
InterpolationThrottlingMode.summary:
The engine automatically throttles physics interpolation for distant
assemblies when client frame time is high.

InterpolationThrottlingMode.name: Disabled
InterpolationThrottlingMode.summary:
Physics interpolation throttling is unconditionally disabled; all
assemblies interpolate at the full rate regardless of client load.

InterpolationThrottlingMode.name: Enabled
InterpolationThrottlingMode.summary:
Physics interpolation throttling is unconditionally enabled; distant
assemblies have their interpolation update rate reduced even when the
client is not under load.

ItemLineAlignment.name: Automatic
ItemLineAlignment.summary:
Aligns the siblings of the `UIListLayout` or the specific
`UIFlexItem` parent to the layout's
`HorizontalAlignment` or
`VerticalAlignment`, depending on its
`FillDirection`. If
`HorizontalFlex` or
`VerticalFlex` is enabled for the
`UIListLayout` cross‑direction, `Stretch` will be used for that
direction.

ItemLineAlignment.name: Start
ItemLineAlignment.summary:
Aligns the siblings of the `UIListLayout` or the specific
`UIFlexItem` parent to the line's **top** in a horizontal fill or
the line's **left** in a vertical fill.

ItemLineAlignment.name: Center
ItemLineAlignment.summary:
Aligns the siblings of the `UIListLayout` or the specific
`UIFlexItem` parent to the line's **center** in either a horizontal
or vertical fill.

ItemLineAlignment.name: End
ItemLineAlignment.summary:
Aligns the siblings of the `UIListLayout` or the specific
`UIFlexItem` parent to the line's **bottom** in a horizontal fill or
the line's **right** in a vertical fill.

ItemLineAlignment.name: Stretch
ItemLineAlignment.summary:
Stretches the siblings of the `UIListLayout` or the specific
`UIFlexItem` parent to fill the entire cross‑direction of the line
in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

JoinSource.name: CreatedItemAttribution

KeyCode.name: TouchPosition

KeyCode.name: TouchDelta

KeyCode.name: TouchPinch

used in the [Input Action System](../../../input/input-action-system.md).

KeyCodeStringFormat.name: Abbreviated

KeyInterpolationMode.name: Linear

The segment starting at this key will evaluate using a linear
interpolation at this key and the value at the next key.

KeyInterpolationMode.name: Cubic
KeyInterpolationMode.summary:
The segment starting at this key will evaluate using cubic interpolation
of this key value using its right tangent and the next key value and its
left tangent.

LeftRight.name: Right

LexemeType.name: Eof
LexemeType.summary:
End-of-input token emitted when the lexer reaches the end of the filter
string.

LexemeType.name: Name
LexemeType.summary:
An unquoted identifier token, such as an instance name or property key in
a filter expression.

LexemeType.name: QuotedString
LexemeType.summary:
A string literal token delimited by single (`'`) or double (`"`) quotes,
with backslash escape support.

LexemeType.name: Number
LexemeType.summary:
A numeric literal token representing an integer or decimal value used in a
comparison.

LexemeType.name: And
LexemeType.summary:
The case-insensitive keyword `and`, used to combine filter conditions with
logical AND.

LexemeType.name: Or
LexemeType.summary:
The case-insensitive keyword `or`, used to combine filter conditions with
logical OR.

LexemeType.name: Equal
LexemeType.summary:
The equality comparison operator, matched as `=` or `==` in a filter
expression.

LexemeType.name: Colon
LexemeType.summary:
The colon character (`:`), used as a separator in filter expressions such
as `ClassName:PropertyName`.

LexemeType.name: Dot
LexemeType.summary:
The dot character (`.`), used to navigate nested property paths in a
filter expression.

LexemeType.name: LeftParenthesis
LexemeType.summary:
The opening parenthesis character (`(`), used to begin a grouped
subexpression in a filter.

LexemeType.name: RightParenthesis
LexemeType.summary:
The closing parenthesis character (`)`), used to end a grouped
subexpression in a filter.

LexemeType.name: Star
LexemeType.summary:
The single wildcard character (`*`), used to match any single name segment
in a filter path.

LexemeType.name: DoubleStar
LexemeType.summary:
The double wildcard token (`**`), which matches any number of path
segments recursively across the instance hierarchy.

LexemeType.name: ReservedSpecial
LexemeType.summary:
A character that is syntactically recognized but has no defined meaning in
the current filter grammar.

LightingStyle.name: Realistic
LightingStyle.summary: The most advanced and realistic lighting and shadows Roblox can deliver.

LightingStyle.name: Soft
LightingStyle.summary: A flat, retro-Roblox look with softer lights and shadows.

Limb.name: RightLeg
Limb.summary:
If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Right Leg. This includes

Limb.name: Unknown
