ListenerLocation.name: Default
ListenerLocation.summary:
Behavior depends on the value of
`VoiceChatService.EnableDefaultVoice` and
`VoiceChatService.UseAudioApi`. When using the default voice setup
with the audio API, this behaves similarly to `Camera`.

ListenerLocation.name: None
ListenerLocation.summary:
No `AudioListener` will be created by default, but they can be
created separately by scripts.

ListenerLocation.name: Character
ListenerLocation.summary:
All of the following, resulting in the world being heard from the position
of your character while matching the orientation of your camera.

- An `Attachment` will be created and parented to the
  `PrimaryPart` of the local player's
  `Character` model.

- An `AudioListener` will be created and parented to the
  `Attachment`.

- An `AudioDeviceOutput` will be created and parented to
  `SoundService`.

- A `Wire` will be created and parented to the previously-created
  `AudioListener`. The wire's
  `SourceInstance` will be set to the
  previously-created `AudioListener` and its
  `TargetInstance` will be set to the
  previously-created `AudioDeviceOutput`.

- The previously-created `Attachment` will be updated once per frame
  to face the same direction as `Workspace.CurrentCamera`.

ListenerLocation.name: Camera
ListenerLocation.summary:
All of the following, resulting in the world being heard from the
perspective (postition and orientation) of the camera.

- An `AudioListener` will be created and parented to
  `Workspace.CurrentCamera`.
- An `AudioDeviceOutput` will be created and parented to
  `SoundService`.
- A `Wire` will be created and parented to the previously-created
  `AudioListener`. The wire's
  `SourceInstance` will be set to the
  previously-created `AudioListener` and its
  `TargetInstance` will be set to the
  previously-created `AudioDeviceOutput`.

ListenerPositionType.name: Parent
ListenerPositionType.summary:
Uses the position and orientation of the `AudioListener`'s parent
`Instance`.

ListenerPositionType.name: Instance
ListenerPositionType.summary:
Uses the position and orientation of the `Instance` specified by
`AudioListener.PositionInstance`.

ListenerType.name: ObjectPosition
ListenerType.summary:
Uses the world position of an instance and the rotation of
`workspace.CurrentCamera`.

ListenerType.name: ObjectCFrame
ListenerType.summary: Uses the world CFrame from an instance.

LoadCharacterLayeredClothing.name: Default
LoadCharacterLayeredClothing.summary:
The behavior of the default setting is not constant. It can mean Disabled
or Enabled depending on what the global back-end flag settings are
currently.

LoadCharacterLayeredClothing.name: Disabled
LoadCharacterLayeredClothing.summary:
This means layered clothing will not be equipped on characters in the
experience.

LoadCharacterLayeredClothing.name: Enabled
LoadCharacterLayeredClothing.summary:
This means layered clothing will be equipped on characters in the
experience (Although `MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories` also need to be
enabled for the experience).

LoadDynamicHeads.name: Default
LoadDynamicHeads.summary: Uses Roblox's default dynamic-head loading behavior.

LocationType.name: Character
LocationType.summary:
Use the player's character model world position as the heatmap location
(default).

LocationType.name: Camera
LocationType.summary:
Use the current workspace camera's world position as the player's heatmap
location.

LocationType.name: ObjectPosition
LocationType.summary:
Use the world position of a configured target object as the player's
heatmap location.

LuauTypeCheckMode.name: Strict

Material.name: Glass
Material.summary:
Applies to `BasePart` only. Note that refraction of light through
this material is not supported on mobile devices due to computational
limitations.

Material.name: ForceField
Material.summary:
Must be used on a `MeshPart` with UVs laid out to cover much of the
0:1 UV space or more (larger is better). The `MeshPart` must also
have a texture applied to its `TextureID`, and
that texture image must have a wide value range since the material
displays the range from dark/black to light/white values. Obtain
[this model](https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/15507769146/ForceFieldMesh)
for a functional example.

MaterialPattern.name: Regular
MaterialPattern.summary: Material has ordered pattern, usually man-made, like brick or wood planks.

MaterialPattern.name: Organic
MaterialPattern.summary: Material pattern has less repetition, like stone or dirt.

MeshScaleUnit.name: Meter

MeshScaleUnit.name: CM

MeshScaleUnit.name: Inch

ModelLevelOfDetail.name: StreamingMesh
ModelLevelOfDetail.summary:
A lower resolution "imposter" mesh (colored, coarse mesh that wraps around
all child parts of the model) renders outside the streaming radius. Does
not support textures.

ModelLevelOfDetail.name: Disabled
ModelLevelOfDetail.summary: A lower resolution mesh will not be displayed.

ModelLevelOfDetail.name: SLIM
ModelLevelOfDetail.summary:
A **SLIM** model (Scalable Lightweight Interactive Model) renders a
composite of all child parts at progressively lower resolutions at
distances based on the streaming radius. Greatly improves visual quality
over `StreamingMesh`.

ModelStreamingBehavior.name: Legacy
ModelStreamingBehavior.summary:
Models are sent when their parent is sent, typically during player join.
Models are never streamed out unless an ancestor of the model is streamed
out.

ModelStreamingBehavior.name: Improved
ModelStreamingBehavior.summary:
Models are never sent during player join. See
[model streaming controls](../../../workspace/streaming/index.md#model-streaming-controls)
for detailed behavioral notes.

ModelStreamingMode.name: Atomic
ModelStreamingMode.summary:
The `Model` and all of its descendants are streamed in/out together.
For streaming in, this applies when **any** descendant `BasePart` is
eligible for streaming in. For streaming out, this applies when **all**
descendant `BaseParts` are eligible for streaming out.

ModelStreamingMode.name: Persistent
ModelStreamingMode.summary:
Persistent models are sent as a complete atomic unit soon after the player
joins and before the `Workspace.PersistentLoaded` event fires.
Persistent models and their descendants are never streamed out.

ModelStreamingMode.name: PersistentPerPlayer
ModelStreamingMode.summary:
Behaves as a persistent model for players that have been added using
`Model:AddPersistentPlayer()`. For other players, behavior is the
same as `Atomic`. You can revert a model from player persistence via
`Model:RemovePersistentPlayer()`.

ModelStreamingMode.name: Nonatomic
ModelStreamingMode.summary:
When a nonatomic model is streamed, descendants are also sent, except for
part descendants. Nonatomic models that are not descendants of parts are
sent during experience loading.

NegateOperationHiddenHistory.name: NegatedIntersection

NetworkOwnership.summary: Network ownership is determined automatically by the server.

NetworkOwnership.summary: Network ownership is set manually by the developer.

NetworkOwnership.name: OnContact
NetworkOwnership.summary:
The first player to touch a part is given ownership of that part for the

NetworkStatus.name: Unknown

NetworkStatus.name: Disconnected
NetworkStatus.summary: The device does not currently have a network connection.

ParticleEmitterShape.name: Box
ParticleEmitterShape.summary: Emits particles from a box-shaped region.

ParticleEmitterShape.summary: Emits particles from a sphere-shaped region.

ParticleEmitterShape.name: Cylinder
ParticleEmitterShape.summary: Emits particles from a cylinder-shaped region.

ParticleEmitterShape.name: Disc
ParticleEmitterShape.summary: Emits particles from a disc-shaped region.

ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.name: Outward
ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.summary: Particles emit directed outward away from the emitter shape surface.

ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.name: Inward
ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.summary: Particles emit directed inward toward the center of the emitter shape.

ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.name: InAndOut
ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.summary:
Particles emit in both outward and inward directions from the emitter

ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.name: Volume
ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.summary: Particles emit from throughout the interior volume of the emitter shape.

ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.name: Surface

ParticleFlipbookLayout.name: None
ParticleFlipbookLayout.summary:
Disable flipbook features and use the texture as a single static texture
over the particle's lifetime.

ParticleFlipbookLayout.name: Custom
ParticleFlipbookLayout.summary:
A custom grid size defined by
`FlipbookSizeX` and
`FlipbookSizeY`.

ParticleFlipbookMode.name: Loop
ParticleFlipbookMode.summary:
Continuously play through all frames, starting back at the first frame
after playing the last.

ParticleFlipbookMode.name: OneShot
ParticleFlipbookMode.summary:
Play through the animation only once across the particle's lifetime. With
this setting, the `ParticleEmitter.FlipbookFramerate` property
doesn't apply; instead, the framerate is determined by the particle's
`ParticleEmitter.Lifetime` divided evenly by the number of frames in
the animation. **OneShot** animations are useful for clear non-repeating
animations, such as an explosion that creates a puff of smoke and then
fades out.

ParticleFlipbookMode.name: PingPong
ParticleFlipbookMode.summary:
Play from the first to the last frame, then in reverse from the last to
the first, repeating throughout the `ParticleEmitter.Lifetime` of
the particle.

ParticleFlipbookMode.name: Random
ParticleFlipbookMode.summary:
Play the frames in a random order, blending/crossfading from one frame to
the next. This can be useful for organic particle textures at low
framerates, such as stars slowly twinkling between subtly different
shapes.

ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.name: NotCompatible
ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.summary:
The `ParticleEmitter`'s flipbook texture dimensions are incompatible
with the active flipbook layout (the texture must be 1024×1024); flipbook
playback is suppressed.

ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.name: Compatible
ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.summary:
The `ParticleEmitter`'s flipbook texture dimensions are confirmed
compatible with the active flipbook layout; flipbook playback proceeds
normally.

ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.name: Unknown
ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.summary:
Compatibility has not yet been determined; this is the initial state
before the engine resolves the flipbook texture dimensions.

ParticleOrientation.name: FacingCamera
ParticleOrientation.summary: Orients particles as billboards that face the camera.

ParticleOrientation.name: FacingCameraWorldUp
ParticleOrientation.summary:

ParticleOrientation.name: VelocityParallel
ParticleOrientation.summary: Orients particles parallel to their direction of movement.

ParticleOrientation.name: VelocityPerpendicular
ParticleOrientation.summary: Orients particles perpendicular to their direction of movement.

PhysicsSteppingMethod.name: Adaptive
PhysicsSteppingMethod.summary:
The engine attempts to assign optimal simulation rates for individual
assemblies of either 240 Hz, 120 Hz, or 60 Hz. This setting is optimized
for performance.

PoseEasingDirection.name: In
PoseEasingDirection.summary:
The EasingStyle curve is reversed, with the easing becoming linear as it
approaches the next keyframe.

PoseEasingDirection.name: Out
PoseEasingDirection.summary:
EasingStyle curves are applied in the forward direction, from the current
keyframe to the next.

PoseEasingDirection.name: InOut
PoseEasingDirection.summary:
Two easing curves are applied back-to-back with the linear ends of the
curves meeting in the middle.

PoseEasingStyle.name: Constant
PoseEasingStyle.summary:
Poses do not interpolate but snap to the keyframe indicated by the
`PoseEasingDirection`.

PoseEasingStyle.name: Elastic
PoseEasingStyle.summary: Pose interpolation overshoots like an elastic curve.

PoseEasingStyle.name: Cubic
PoseEasingStyle.summary:
Deprecated - Use `PoseEasingStyle.CubicV2`. Pose interpolation is a
cubic curve between keyframes based on the `PoseEasingDirection`.

PoseEasingStyle.name: Bounce
PoseEasingStyle.summary: Pose interpolation produces a bounce-like effect between keyframes.

PoseEasingStyle.name: CubicV2
PoseEasingStyle.summary:
Pose interpolation is a cubic curve between keyframes based on
`PoseEasingDirection`.

PredictionMode.name: Automatic
PredictionMode.summary:
The engine will automatically decide if this instance should be predicted
or not. Currently, only `BaseParts` near the local player
character's `Humanoid` will be predicted within a dynamic radius
that grows and shrinks based on the device's capability to handle the
simulation load.

PredictionMode.name: On
PredictionMode.summary:
The instance will be predicted. Mismatches in the attributes of this
instance between the client and server will cause a rollback and
resimulation. If the instance is a `BasePart`, its physics
properties will be predicted ahead of the replicated authoritative server
state.

PredictionMode.name: Off
PredictionMode.summary:
The instance will **not** be predicted. Regular network ownership
semantics apply.

PredictionStatus.name: None
PredictionStatus.summary:
The instance will not be resimulated; classic simulation rules apply
instead.

PredictiveStreamingMode.name: Default
PredictiveStreamingMode.summary: Uses the engine's current default behavior for predictive streaming.

PredictiveStreamingMode.name: Enabled
PredictiveStreamingMode.summary:
Enables predictive streaming, pre-fetching content in the direction of
player movement to reduce pop-in.

PredictiveStreamingMode.name: Disabled
PredictiveStreamingMode.summary:
Disables predictive streaming; content is streamed based on the player's
current position radius only.

PreferredInput.name: KeyboardAndMouse
PreferredInput.summary:

mouse.

ReceiptDecision.name: NotProcessedYet
ReceiptDecision.summary:
The receipt has not been processed yet. Returning this value keeps the

if they have disconnected.

ReceiptDecision.name: Processed
ReceiptDecision.summary:
The receipt has been processed and all benefits have been granted. The

ReceiptType.name: DeveloperProduct
ReceiptType.summary:
Used for processing receipts from developer product purchases made with

The receipt includes `ProductId`, `CurrencyType`, and `CurrencySpent`
fields. A handler bound for this type processes developer product receipts
in place of the legacy
`ProcessReceipt` callback;
receipts with no matching bound handler fall through to `ProcessReceipt`.

ReceiptType.name: RobuxTransferSender
ReceiptType.summary:
Used for processing receipts for the user who initiated a Robux transfer.
The receipt's `PlayerId` is the sender's user ID and includes a
`TransferRequestId` field. Delivered immediately if the transfer settles
synchronously. If receiver approval is required, delivered to the server
the sender is currently in once the receiver accepts, or on the sender's
next session join if they are offline.

ReceiptType.name: RobuxTransferReceiver
ReceiptType.summary:
Used for processing receipts for the user who received Robux via a
transfer. The receipt's `PlayerId` is the receiver's user ID and includes
a `TransferRequestId` field. Delivered to the server the receiver is
currently in once the transfer settles, or on their next session join if
they are offline.

RollOffMode.name: Inverse
RollOffMode.summary:
Volume attenuates from `Sound.RollOffMinDistance` in an inverse
manner, mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world. This is done
through `Sound.RollOffMinDistance`/`distance`, where `distance` is
the `Vector3.Magnitude` between the audio source and the audio
listener.

RollOffMode.name: Linear
RollOffMode.summary:
Volume attenuates between `Sound.RollOffMinDistance` and
`Sound.RollOffMaxDistance` with a linear relationship. This is done
through
(`Sound.RollOffMaxDistance`/`distance`)/(`Sound.RollOffMaxDistance`-`Sound.RollOffMinDistance`),
where `distance` is the `Vector3.Magnitude` between the audio
source and the audio listener.

RollOffMode.name: LinearSquare
RollOffMode.summary:
Volume attenuates between `Sound.RollOffMinDistance` and
`Sound.RollOffMaxDistance` with a linear squared relationship. This
is done through squaring `Linear`.

RollOffMode.name: InverseTapered
RollOffMode.summary:
A hybrid model which follows the `Inverse` model when close to
`Sound.RollOffMinDistance` and the `LinearSquare` model when close
to `Sound.RollOffMaxDistance`. This is done by taking the lesser of
`Inverse` and `LinearSquare`.

RuntimeUndoBehavior.name: Aggregate
RuntimeUndoBehavior.summary:
Rejects waypoint requests during a run session; all runtime changes
accumulate into a single waypoint that is reverted together when the
session stops or resets.

RuntimeUndoBehavior.name: Snapshot
RuntimeUndoBehavior.summary:
Accepts waypoint requests during a run session and captures a snapshot of
each instance's position and velocity at every waypoint boundary so that
physics state can be fully restored on undo.

RuntimeUndoBehavior.name: Hybrid
RuntimeUndoBehavior.summary:
Accepts waypoint requests during a run session but excludes unsolicited
physics changes (position and velocity drift from simulation) from the
recorded history.

SafeAreaCompatibility.name: None
SafeAreaCompatibility.summary:
Do not apply compatibility transformations to any descendants of the
`ScreenGui`.

SafeAreaCompatibility.name: FullscreenExtension
SafeAreaCompatibility.summary:
If the total area of any descendant `GuiObject` within the
`ScreenGui` (including any applied border or `UIStroke`)
covers the device's safe area both horizontally and vertically, its
background area will be expanded to cover the fullscreen area. This
expansion does **not** affect the size or position of the descendant's
**content**, except in the case of `ImageLabel`,
`ImageButton`, or `VideoFrame` where the image/video is
considered part of the background and will be expanded to fullscreen.

Note that this option is intended to automatically improve the appearance
of UI that was authored for screens without any cutouts. However, it's
recommended that you avoid fullscreen extensions for new work; instead,
use the `ScreenInsets` property to specify
which insets should be respected for different
`ScreenGuis`.

calling context.

ScopeCheckResult.name: Timeout
ScopeCheckResult.summary:
The scope-check request exceeded the configured timeout period before the
player responded.

ScopeCheckResult.name: NoUserInput
ScopeCheckResult.summary:
The authorization prompt was dismissed without any explicit player action,
such as when the player disconnects or the UI is closed without a
response.

ScopeCheckResult.name: BackendError
ScopeCheckResult.summary:
The Roblox backend returned an error or unexpected HTTP status when
exchanging the consent grant for an authorization token.

ScopeCheckResult.name: UnexpectedError
ScopeCheckResult.summary:
An unexpected error occurred that is not covered by a more specific result
code.

ScopeCheckResult.name: InvalidArgument
ScopeCheckResult.summary:
One or more arguments passed to the scope-check call were invalid, such as
an empty scope list, a null player instance, or a player who is no longer
in the experience.

ScopeCheckResult.name: ConsentDenied
ScopeCheckResult.summary: The player explicitly declined the authorization prompt.

ScreenInsets.name: None
ScreenInsets.summary:
No insets are added to the fullscreen area. This mode may result in UI
that is obscured or completely hidden by device notches and cutouts, so
you should only use it for a `ScreenGui` that contains
non‑interactive content like background images.

ScreenInsets.name: DeviceSafeInsets
ScreenInsets.summary:
Device safe area insets are added to the fullscreen area. The resulting
area is guaranteed to not be occluded by any **device** screen cutouts
such as the camera notch, although no inset is added for Roblox core UI
elements like the top bar buttons. As a result, it's recommended that you
use `CoreUISafeInsets` for a `ScreenGui` whose contents should
remain unobscured by both device cutouts **and** core screen elements.

ScreenInsets.name: CoreUISafeInsets
ScreenInsets.summary:
Core UI insets are added to the `DeviceSafeInsets` area, resulting in an
area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox
core UI elements like the top bar buttons. This mode is recommended for
any `ScreenGui` that contains interactive and/or important UI
elements such as buttons and status messages.

ScreenInsets.name: TopbarSafeInsets
ScreenInsets.summary:
Top bar safe area insets are added to the `DeviceSafeInsets` area,
resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen
cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the experience controls. Unlike
`CoreUISafeInsets`, this area's position and size is dynamic and is
limited to the space available within the top bar area itself, outside of
`CoreUISafeInsets`. See the `GuiService.TopbarInset` property which
represents the absolute size and position of the unobstructed area within
the top bar space.

ScreenOrientation.name: LandscapeLeft
ScreenOrientation.summary:
A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the
bottom of the device on the left side of the screen.

ScreenOrientation.name: LandscapeRight
ScreenOrientation.summary:
A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the
bottom of the device on the right side of the screen.

ScreenOrientation.name: LandscapeSensor
ScreenOrientation.summary:
A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the
bottom of the device on the left of right side of the screen depending on
the device's orientation (the sensor determines which side allows for the
game to be displayed right-side-up).

ScreenOrientation.name: Portrait
ScreenOrientation.summary:
A preference where the game is displayed portrait (vertically) with the
bottom of the device on the bottom of the screen.

ScreenOrientation.name: Sensor
ScreenOrientation.summary:
A preference where the game is displayed depending on the best match to
the device's current orientation - either landscape (left/right) or
portrait.

ScreenshotCaptureResult.name: OtherError
ScreenshotCaptureResult.summary: The screenshot capture failed due to an unspecified error.

ScreenshotCaptureResult.name: NoDeviceSupport
ScreenshotCaptureResult.summary: The device does not support screenshot captures.

ScreenshotCaptureResult.name: NoSpaceOnDevice
ScreenshotCaptureResult.summary:
The device does not have enough storage space to save the screenshot
capture.

ScriptStoppedReason.name: Breakpoint
ScriptStoppedReason.summary: Execution stopped because a user-defined breakpoint was hit.

ScriptStoppedReason.name: Exception
ScriptStoppedReason.summary:
Execution stopped because an exception was thrown (governed by the current
`DebugBreakModeType`).

ScriptStoppedReason.name: Step
ScriptStoppedReason.summary: Execution stopped after completing a step operation.

ScriptStoppedReason.name: Entry
ScriptStoppedReason.summary: Execution stopped at a script's entry point.

ScriptVariableScope.name: Local
ScriptVariableScope.summary: A local variable declared in the current function scope.

ScriptVariableScope.name: Upvalue
ScriptVariableScope.summary: A variable captured from an enclosing function scope.

ScrollBarInset.name: None
ScrollBarInset.summary: The canvas will never be inset for the respective scroll bar.

ScrollBarInset.name: ScrollBar
ScrollBarInset.summary: The canvas will only be inset if the respective scroll bar is showing.

ScrollBarInset.name: Always
ScrollBarInset.summary:
The canvas will always be inset for the respective scroll bar, regardless
of whether that scroll bar is showing.

ScrollingDirection.name: X
ScrollingDirection.summary: The canvas can only be scrolled along the **X** axis.

ScrollingDirection.name: Y
ScrollingDirection.summary: The canvas can only be scrolled along the **Y** axis.

ScrollingDirection.name: XY
ScrollingDirection.summary: The canvas can be scrolled along both the **X** and **Y** axes.

SecurityCapability.name: RunClientScript
SecurityCapability.summary:
Indicates that a script container is permitted to execute scripts on the
client (`LocalScript`).

SecurityCapability.name: RunServerScript
SecurityCapability.summary:
Indicates that a script container is permitted to execute scripts on the
server (`Script`).

SecurityCapability.name: AccessOutsideWrite
SecurityCapability.summary:
Grants a script read-write access to instances that live outside its
sandboxed container.

SecurityCapability.name: AssetRequire
SecurityCapability.summary: Deprecated. Use `SecurityCapability.LoadUnownedAsset` instead.

SecurityCapability.name: LoadString
SecurityCapability.summary:
Allows a script to use the `loadstring()` Luau built-in to compile and
execute a string as code.

SecurityCapability.name: ScriptGlobals
SecurityCapability.summary:
Allows a script to access the `shared` and `_G` shared global variable
tables.

SecurityCapability.name: CreateInstances
SecurityCapability.summary: Allows a script to create new `Instance` objects using `Instance.new()`.

SecurityCapability.name: Basic
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to a broad set of general-purpose engine APIs that do not
belong to a more specific capability category.

SecurityCapability.name: Audio
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to audio engine APIs such as `Sound`,
`AudioPlayer`, and related classes.

SecurityCapability.name: DataStore
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to data store APIs such as `DataStoreService` and its
associated objects.

SecurityCapability.name: Network
SecurityCapability.summary: Guards access to low-level networking APIs such as `HttpService`.

SecurityCapability.name: Physics
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to physics engine APIs such as `Constraint` classes
and `BasePart` physics properties.

SecurityCapability.name: UI
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to UI engine APIs such as `ScreenGui`, `Frame`,
and other `GuiObject` classes.

SecurityCapability.name: CSG
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) APIs such as
`UnionOperation` and `NegateOperation`.

SecurityCapability.name: Chat
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to chat engine APIs such as `TextChatService` and
related chat classes.

SecurityCapability.name: Animation
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to animation engine APIs such as `AnimationController`
and related classes.

SecurityCapability.name: Avatar
SecurityCapability.summary: Deprecated. Use `SecurityCapability.AvatarAppearance` instead.

SecurityCapability.name: Input
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to user input APIs such as `UserInputService` and
`ContextActionService`.

SecurityCapability.name: Environment
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to environment and world-setting APIs such as
`Lighting` and `Atmosphere`.

SecurityCapability.name: RemoteEvent
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to remote event and function APIs such as
`RemoteEvent` and `RemoteFunction`.

SecurityCapability.name: LegacySound
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to the legacy `Sound` and
pre-`VoiceChatService.UseAudioApi` sound stack APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: Players
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to `Players` service APIs that query or manage
connected players.

SecurityCapability.name: CapabilityControl
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to the `Instance.Capabilities` and `Instance.Sandboxed`
properties that configure script sandboxing.

SecurityCapability.name: Plugin
SecurityCapability.summary:
Mirrors the legacy `Plugin` permission level, granting access to Studio
plugin APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: LocalUser
SecurityCapability.summary:
Mirrors the legacy `LocalUser` permission level, granting access to
IDE-only and Studio-level APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: WritePlayer
SecurityCapability.summary:
Mirrors the legacy `WritePlayer` permission level, granting the ability to
modify player identity properties such as name and `UserId`.

SecurityCapability.name: RobloxScript
SecurityCapability.summary:
Mirrors the legacy `RobloxScript` permission level, granting access to
`CoreScript` APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: RobloxEngine
SecurityCapability.summary:
Mirrors the legacy `RobloxEngine` permission level, granting access to
internal engine-level APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: Unassigned
SecurityCapability.summary:
The default capability assigned to API members that have not been
explicitly assigned to any other capability category.

SecurityCapability.name: InternalTest
SecurityCapability.summary:
Restricts access to non-sensitive APIs that are intentionally kept
internal.

SecurityCapability.name: PluginOrOpenCloud
SecurityCapability.summary:
Restricts access to APIs callable only from Studio plugin or Open Cloud
Luau execution sessions.

SecurityCapability.name: Assistant
SecurityCapability.summary:
Restricts access to APIs that may only be called from Studio Assistant
execution contexts.

SecurityCapability.name: RemoteCommand
SecurityCapability.summary:
Restricts access to APIs that are executable only from Studio's
`RemoteCommandService` in Team Create sessions.

SecurityCapability.name: AssetRead
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to APIs that read or query asset metadata from the Roblox
catalog.

SecurityCapability.name: AssetManagement
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to asset management APIs such as
`ContentProvider:PreloadAsync()` and encryption-key registration.

SecurityCapability.name: DynamicGeneration
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to procedural and AI-driven content generation APIs such as
`EditableMesh` and `AvatarCreationService`.

SecurityCapability.name: PlatformAvatarEditing
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to platform-level avatar editing APIs provided by
`AvatarEditorService`.

SecurityCapability.name: AssetCreateUpdate
SecurityCapability.summary: Guards access to APIs that create or update published Roblox assets.

SecurityCapability.name: Capture
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to `CaptureService` APIs that take screenshots and
record video.

SecurityCapability.name: SensitiveInput
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to sensitive user input APIs such as those that can read raw
keyboard or mouse data beyond normal game input.

SecurityCapability.name: Monetization
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to in-experience purchase and monetization APIs such as
`MarketplaceService`.

SecurityCapability.name: LoadOwnedAsset
SecurityCapability.summary:
Allows a script to load assets that are owned by the experience's creator
using `InsertService` or `Global.LuaGlobals.require()`.

SecurityCapability.name: Social
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to social APIs such as `SocialService`,
`FriendPages`, and `ExperienceInviteOptions`.

SecurityCapability.name: ServerCommunication
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to server-to-server messaging APIs such as
`MessagingService`.

SecurityCapability.name: Logging
SecurityCapability.summary: Guards access to `LogService` and logging-related APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: PromptExternalPurchase
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to APIs that initiate external (non-Roblox) purchase
prompts.

SecurityCapability.name: Groups
SecurityCapability.summary: Guards access to group-related APIs such as `GroupService`.

SecurityCapability.name: Teleport
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to teleportation APIs such as `TeleportService`,
`TeleportOptions`, and `TeleportAsyncResult`.

SecurityCapability.name: Consequences
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to moderation and player-consequence APIs such as
`Players:BanAsync()` and `ModerationService`.

SecurityCapability.name: Material
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to `MaterialService`, `MaterialVariant`, and
custom material APIs.

SecurityCapability.name: AvatarBehavior
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to APIs that control avatar locomotion and behavior at
runtime.

SecurityCapability.name: AvatarAppearance
SecurityCapability.summary:
Guards access to APIs that read or modify avatar appearance, such as
`HumanoidDescription`.

SecurityCapability.name: LoadUnownedAsset
SecurityCapability.summary:
Allows a script to `Global.LuaGlobals.require()` asset IDs or call
`InsertService:LoadAsset()` for assets not owned by the creator.

SelectionBehavior.name: Escape
SelectionBehavior.summary:
Prioritizes GuiObjects within the same SelectionGroup but allows the
selection to move to other outside GuiObjects if no suitable button is
found.

SelectionBehavior.name: Stop
SelectionBehavior.summary: Constrains gamepad selection to the SelectionGroup.

SelectionRenderMode.name: Outlines
SelectionRenderMode.summary: Renders selected objects using an outline drawn along each object's edges.

SelectionRenderMode.name: BoundingBoxes
SelectionRenderMode.summary:
Renders selected objects using a bounding box drawn around each object's
extents.

SelectionRenderMode.name: Both
SelectionRenderMode.summary:
Renders selected objects with both outlines and bounding boxes
simultaneously.

SelfViewPosition.name: LastPosition
SelfViewPosition.summary: The position of the self view when it was last closed.

SelfViewPosition.name: TopLeft
SelfViewPosition.summary:
Top-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and left
edges.

SelfViewPosition.name: TopRight
SelfViewPosition.summary:
Top-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and right
edges.

SelfViewPosition.name: BottomLeft
SelfViewPosition.summary:
Bottom-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and
left edges.

SelfViewPosition.name: BottomRight
SelfViewPosition.summary:
Bottom-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and
right edges.

SensorMode.name: Floor
SensorMode.summary:
Detects floor surfaces below the part using the modern detection
algorithm; the default value of `ControllerPartSensor.SensorMode`.

SensorMode.name: Ladder
SensorMode.summary:
Detects ladder surfaces adjacent to the part using the modern
piercing-based detection algorithm.

SensorMode.name: ClassicFloor
SensorMode.summary:
Detects floor surfaces below the part using the legacy raycast-based
algorithm.

SensorMode.name: ClassicLadder
SensorMode.summary:
Detects ladder surfaces adjacent to the part using the legacy ladder
detection algorithm.

SensorUpdateType.name: OnRead
SensorUpdateType.summary:
The sensor lazily recalculates its output the next time an output property
is read and the output is marked dirty.

SensorUpdateType.name: Manual
SensorUpdateType.summary:
The sensor never automatically recalculates its output; scripts are
responsible for driving output updates.

ServiceVisibility.name: Always
ServiceVisibility.summary: The service is always visible in the Explorer window.

ServiceVisibility.name: Off
ServiceVisibility.summary:
The service is hidden from the Explorer window by default, but can still
be added via the Insert Service menu.

ServiceVisibility.name: WithChildren
ServiceVisibility.summary:
The service is visible in the Explorer window only when it has children;
it can still be added via the Insert Service menu.

Severity.name: Error
Severity.summary: Reports a critical error that indicates a definite problem in the script.

Severity.name: Warning
Severity.summary:
Reports a potential problem that can cause incorrect behavior but does not
prevent the script from running.

Severity.name: Information
Severity.summary:
Conveys informational context about the script without indicating a
problem.

Severity.name: Hint
Severity.summary:
Provides a subtle suggestion, such as a style improvement or an
unused-variable notice.

ShowAdResult.name: ShowCompleted
ShowAdResult.summary: The ad was successfully shown to completion.

ShowAdResult.name: AdNotReady
ShowAdResult.summary:
You are trying to show a full-screen ad before the ad has fully loaded.
You might have failed to properly fetch the ad, or the ad might have
expired.

ShowAdResult.name: AdAlreadyShowing
ShowAdResult.summary:
You are trying to show a full-screen ad while another full-screen ad is
already playing.

ShowAdResult.name: InternalError
ShowAdResult.summary: An unspecified internal error occurred. Try showing the ad again.

ShowAdResult.name: ShowInterrupted
ShowAdResult.summary:
The ad view of the user has been interrupted. The user might have closed
the ad view or left the experience, and should not receive a reward.

ShowAdResult.name: InsufficientMemory
ShowAdResult.summary:
The device does not have sufficient video memory available to display the
ad.

SignalBehavior.name: Default
SignalBehavior.summary:
The default behavior; currently equivalent to `Immediate` but this will
eventually change to `Deferred`.

SignalBehavior.name: Immediate
SignalBehavior.summary: Event handlers are resumed immediately when the event occurs.

SignalBehavior.name: Deferred
SignalBehavior.summary:
All events are deferred and their handlers resumed at specific resumptions
points each frame.

SignalBehavior.name: AncestryDeferred
SignalBehavior.summary:
Equivalent to `Deferred` but only for events triggered by changes in
ancestry.

SizeConstraint.name: RelativeXY
SizeConstraint.summary: The scale of X and Y are independent.

SizeConstraint.name: RelativeXX
SizeConstraint.summary: The scale of X is shared with Y.

SizeConstraint.name: RelativeYY
SizeConstraint.summary: The scale of Y is shared with X.

SlimTintMode.name: None
SlimTintMode.summary: No tint is applied. Meshes render with their normal appearance.

SlimTintMode.name: LevelOfDetail
SlimTintMode.summary:
Colors each mesh by its current level of detail. Blue is the coarsest, red
the finest, and every rank in between maps to a fixed color. A given color
always means the same LOD rank across every mesh, with the exception that
each mesh's own highest available LOD is always shown red.

SlimTintMode.name: DataModelState
SlimTintMode.summary:
Colors SLIM models by whether their DataModel instances are streamed in or
out. Green indicates streamed in (full DataModel present); yellow
indicates streamed out (a placeholder). Both are still rendered via SLIM.

SlimTintMode.name: TranscoderStatus
SlimTintMode.summary:
Colors each SLIM model by its `SlimTranscoderStatus`. Follow the link
to see which color maps to each status.

SlimTranscoderStatus.name: Unknown
SlimTranscoderStatus.summary:
The transcoding status has not yet been determined. This is the initial
state before the model has been queried. Shown as yellow in the debug tint
overlay.

SlimTranscoderStatus.name: Transcoding
SlimTranscoderStatus.summary:
SLIM transcoding is currently in progress on the backend. The model is
expected to transition to Succeeded or Failed once transcoding completes.
Shown as blue in the debug tint overlay.

SlimTranscoderStatus.name: Succeeded
SlimTranscoderStatus.summary:
Transcoding completed successfully and the SLIM assets are available for
streaming. Shown as green in the debug tint overlay.

SlimTranscoderStatus.name: Failed
SlimTranscoderStatus.summary:
Transcoding did not complete successfully. Shown as red in the debug tint
overlay.

SolverConvergenceMetricType.name: IterationBased
SolverConvergenceMetricType.summary:
Identifies the least-converged constraint using the estimated force change
from an additional, non-applied solver iteration.

SolverConvergenceMetricType.name: AlgorithmAgnostic
SolverConvergenceMetricType.summary:
Identifies the least-converged constraint using a residual-based
convergence metric supported across solver algorithms.

SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.name: Disabled
SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.summary: No solver convergence visualization is rendered; the default state.

SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.name: PerIsland
SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.summary:
Renders a single convergence metric label at the center of each simulation
island displaying the velocity-stage and position-stage maxima, which may
come from different constraints.

SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.name: PerEdge
SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.summary:
Renders convergence metrics as text labels on each aggregated body-pair
edge between assembly root bodies.

SortDirection.name: Ascending
SortDirection.summary:
Orders results from lowest to highest value, or from oldest to newest
entry.

SortDirection.name: Descending
SortDirection.summary:
Orders results from highest to lowest value, or from newest to oldest
entry.

SortOrder.name: Name
SortOrder.summary: Elements are ordered by their `Instance.Name` in alphanumeric order.

SortOrder.name: Custom
SortOrder.summary:
Elements are ordered by the function passed to
`UIGridStyleLayout:SetCustomSortFunction()`.

SortOrder.name: LayoutOrder
SortOrder.summary:
Elements are ordered by `GuiObject.LayoutOrder` in ascending order;
for example `0` will be placed before `1`.

StartCorner.name: TopLeft
StartCorner.summary: Grid starts in top left corner.

StartCorner.name: TopRight
StartCorner.summary: Grid starts in top right corner.

StartCorner.name: BottomLeft
StartCorner.summary: Grid starts in bottom left corner.

StartCorner.name: BottomRight
StartCorner.summary: Grid starts in bottom right corner.

StateObjectFieldType.name: INVALID
StateObjectFieldType.summary: An invalid or unrecognized field type.

StepFrequency.name: Hz60
StepFrequency.summary: The bound function is called at 60 Hz.

StepFrequency.name: Hz30
StepFrequency.summary: The bound function is called at 30 Hz.

StepFrequency.name: Hz15
StepFrequency.summary: The bound function is called at 15 Hz.

StepFrequency.name: Hz10
StepFrequency.summary: The bound function is called at 10 Hz.

StepFrequency.name: Hz5
StepFrequency.summary: The bound function is called at 5 Hz.

StepFrequency.name: Hz1
StepFrequency.summary: The bound function is called at 1 Hz.

StreamOutBehavior.name: LowMemory
StreamOutBehavior.summary: Only stream out when memory is low.

StreamOutBehavior.name: Opportunistic
StreamOutBehavior.summary:
Stream out content that is significantly outside of the current
`Workspace.StreamingTargetRadius`.

StreamingIntegrityMode.name: Disabled
StreamingIntegrityMode.summary:
Simulation of the replication focus is never paused, regardless of the
amount of content streamed in on the client.

StreamingIntegrityMode.name: MinimumRadiusPause
StreamingIntegrityMode.summary:
All client-side simulation is paused when content is not streamed in up to
the minimum radius.

StreamingIntegrityMode.name: PauseOutsideLoadedArea
StreamingIntegrityMode.summary:
Simulation of the replication focus is paused when any part of its
bounding box is not in a streamed-in area.

StreamingPauseMode.name: Disabled
StreamingPauseMode.summary: No change to gameplay due to streaming region availability.

StrokeSizingMode.name: ScaledSize
StrokeSizingMode.summary:
`Thickness` is relative to minimum parent width
or height. If stroke is on text, thickness is relative to font size.

StudioCaptureScreenshotFormat.name: RGBA8
StudioCaptureScreenshotFormat.summary:
The buffer contains raw, uncompressed RGBA pixel data with 8 bits per
channel (4 bytes per pixel).

StudioCaptureScreenshotFormat.name: PNG
StudioCaptureScreenshotFormat.summary: The buffer contains a complete PNG-encoded image.

StudioPlaceUpdateFailureReason.name: Other
StudioPlaceUpdateFailureReason.summary: The place publish or update failed for an unspecified or generic reason.

StudioPlaceUpdateFailureReason.name: TeamCreateConflict
StudioPlaceUpdateFailureReason.summary:
The place publish failed because a Team Create server currently holds a
lock on the place.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Default
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Fallback foreground color used for script text that does not match any
more specific syntax category.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Operator
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to operator tokens such as `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `==`, and
`..` in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Number
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to numeric literal tokens in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: String
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to string literal tokens, including quoted strings and
long-string literals.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Comment
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to comment tokens (single-line `--` and block `--[[ ]]`
comments) in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Keyword
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to Luau reserved keywords such as `if`, `then`, `else`,
`do`, `end`, `return`, and `while`.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Builtin
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to Luau built-in functions and standard library identifiers
in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Method
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to method call identifiers in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Property
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to property access identifiers (tokens following a `.`
operator) in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Nil
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to the `nil` literal token in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Bool
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Foreground color used to highlight boolean literals (`true` and `false`)
in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Function
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to the `function` keyword token in function declarations.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Local
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to the `local` keyword token in local variable and function
declarations.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Self
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to the `self` identifier token in method bodies.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: LuauKeyword
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to Luau-specific type annotation keywords such as `type` and
`typeof`.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: FunctionName
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to the identifier that names a function in its declaration.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: TODO
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color applied to `TODO` markers found inside comments in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Background
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Main background color of the Script Editor canvas.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: SelectionText
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Foreground color for text within the currently selected range in the
Script Editor.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: SelectionBackground
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Background highlight color for the currently selected text range in the
Script Editor.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: FindSelectionBackground
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Background highlight color applied to text ranges matched by a Find or
Replace operation.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: MatchingWordBackground
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Background highlight color applied to all occurrences of the word under
the cursor when word-highlight is active.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Warning
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color used for warning-severity diagnostic markers and underlines in
scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Error
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color used for error-severity diagnostic markers and underlines in
scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Info
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color used for information-severity diagnostic markers in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Hint
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color used for hint-severity diagnostic markers in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Whitespace
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color used to render visible whitespace characters (spaces and tabs) when
that display option is enabled.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: ActiveLine
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Background highlight color applied to the line that currently contains the
text cursor.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: DebuggerCurrentLine
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Background highlight color for the line the debugger is currently paused
on.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: DebuggerErrorLine
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Background highlight color for a line that caused a runtime error during a
debugging session.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Ruler
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color of the vertical column ruler line drawn at the configured
character-width limit in the Script Editor.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Bracket
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to bracket characters such as `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, and
`}` in scripts.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.name: Type
StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary:
Color applied to Luau type name tokens in type annotations and
declarations.

SurfaceConstraint.name: Hinge
SurfaceConstraint.summary:
Makes the side appear with a yellow hinge. Any part connected to this
hinge will stick to the side and rotate using physics.

SurfaceConstraint.name: SteppingMotor
SurfaceConstraint.summary:
Functions identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in
the past, but that functionality no longer seems to exist.

SurfaceConstraint.name: Motor
SurfaceConstraint.summary:
Acts the same as a Hinge, but has a grey ring around it and automatically
rotates any part connected to it.

SurfaceGuiSizingMode.name: FixedSize
SurfaceGuiSizingMode.summary: Renders with a fixed size set using `SurfaceGui.CanvasSize`.

SurfaceGuiSizingMode.name: PixelsPerStud
SurfaceGuiSizingMode.summary:
Renders with a variable size based on `SurfaceGui.PixelsPerStud` and
the SurfaceGui's size in studs.

SurfaceType.name: Smooth
SurfaceType.summary: Adds no details on the surface.

SurfaceType.name: Glue
SurfaceType.summary: Adds an "X" pattern across the surface.

SurfaceType.name: Weld
SurfaceType.summary: Adds an "X" pattern across the surface.

SurfaceType.name: Studs
SurfaceType.summary: Adds square studs across the surface.

SurfaceType.name: Inlet
SurfaceType.summary: Adds square holes across the surface where studs would be.

SurfaceType.name: Universal
SurfaceType.summary: Adds a checker pattern to the surface using studs and inlets.

SurfaceType.name: Hinge
SurfaceType.summary:
Adds a yellow hinge to the surface. Parts touching it stick to the
surface, allowing for rotations using physics. This should not be used for
future work and existing instances should be replaced with a
`HingeConstraint`.

SurfaceType.name: Motor
SurfaceType.summary: Functioned identically to a hinge with the addition of a grey ring.

SurfaceType.name: SteppingMotor
SurfaceType.summary:
Functioned identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in
the past, but that functionality is non-existent.

SurfaceType.name: SmoothNoOutlines
SurfaceType.summary:
Previously similar to **Smooth** with outlines but no longer relevant
since outlines have been removed.

Technology.name: Voxel
Technology.summary: Uses a 4×4×4 voxel map for light and shadow calculation.

Technology.name: Compatibility
Technology.summary:
Simulates the removed legacy technology and is now deprecated. To achieve
a similar look, use `Voxel` Lighting and add a `ColorGradingEffect`
post‑processing effect set to the `Retro` preset.

Technology.name: ShadowMap
Technology.summary:
Features shadow mapping that produces more realistic and crisp shadows
from sunlight or directional light sources.

Technology.name: Future
Technology.summary:
Features the most advanced technology for high-fidelity lighting and
shadows.

TeleportMethod.name: TeleportToSpawnByName
TeleportMethod.summary:

which sends a player to a named `SpawnLocation` in a place.

TeleportMethod.name: TeleportToPlaceInstance
TeleportMethod.summary:

TeleportMethod.name: TeleportToVIPServer
TeleportMethod.summary:
Teleport was initiated to a VIP (creator-owned private) server; the engine
upgrades the method tag to this value when VIP server credentials are
present at teleport time.

TeleportMethod.name: TeleportToInstanceBack
TeleportMethod.summary:
Teleport was initiated by back-navigation, returning a player to a
specific prior place instance.

TeleportMethod.name: TeleportUnknown
TeleportMethod.summary: Fallback value used when the teleport method cannot be determined.

TeleportState.summary: The client is waiting for the server to respond to the teleport request.

TeleportState.name: InProgress

TextDirection.summary:
Automatically determines text direction from the first strong directional
character using the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm.

text content.

TextDirection.name: RightToLeft

TextFilterContext.name: PrivateChat

users, applying filtering appropriate for one-to-one or small-group
exchanges.

TextTruncate.name: AtEnd
TextTruncate.summary:
Text is truncated at the end of the text; extra graphemes that cannot fit
into the space are replaced with `...`. Word boundaries are respected if
possible.

For example, if the control is between -> and <- like so:

`->Long text is truncated at the en<-d of the last complete word`

The text will be:

`Long text is truncated at the...`

TextTruncate.name: SplitWord
TextTruncate.summary:
If the end of the line occurs in the middle of a word, the text is
truncated inside of that word. Extra graphemes that cannot fit into the
space are replaced with `...`.

For example, if the control is between -> and <- like so:

`->Long text is truncated at the en<-d of the last complete word`

The text will be:

`Long text is truncated at the en...`

TextXAlignment.name: Left
TextXAlignment.summary: Alignment starts at the left side of the GUI object.

TextXAlignment.name: Right
TextXAlignment.summary: Alignment starts at the right side of the GUI object.

TextXAlignment.name: Center
TextXAlignment.summary:
Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally left
and right.

TextYAlignment.name: Top
TextYAlignment.summary: Alignment starts at the top of the GUI object.

TextYAlignment.name: Center

Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally toward
the top and bottom.

TextYAlignment.name: Bottom
TextYAlignment.summary: Alignment starts at the bottom of the GUI object.

TextureMode.name: Stretch
TextureMode.summary:
For a `Trail`, the texture will stretch out based on the lifetime of
the trail, and shrink inwards if the trail's attachments stop moving.

For a `Beam`, the texture will repeat
`TextureLength` times across the beam's overall
length. See [here](../../../effects/beams.md#texture-lengthmode) for
details.

TextureMode.name: Wrap
TextureMode.summary:
For a `Trail`, the texture will be tiled as the length of the trail
changes, but the textures will remain stationary relative to their
attachments.

For a `Beam`, the texture repetitions will equal the beam's overall
length (in studs) divided by its
`TextureLength`. See
[here](../../../effects/beams.md#texture-lengthmode) for details.

TextureMode.name: Static
TextureMode.summary:
For a `Trail`, the texture will be rolled out as the attachments
move, and they will remain in place until their lifetime is met. This
setting is ideal for trail textures that should appear "stamped" where
rendered, such as paw prints or tire tracks.

This value is not supported for `Beam` and therefore behaves
identically to **Wrap**.

TextureQueryType.name: NonHumanoid
TextureQueryType.summary: Texture memory for objects other than `Humanoid`.

TextureQueryType.name: NonHumanoidOrphaned
TextureQueryType.summary: Unreferenced texture memory for objects other than `Humanoid`.

TouchMovementMode.summary: Change the movement controller to the dynamic thumbstick.

TrackerError.name: Ok
TrackerError.summary: No error; the tracker is operating normally.

TrackerError.name: NoService
TrackerError.summary:
A required engine service was unavailable when the tracker attempted to
connect.

TrackerError.name: InitFailed
TrackerError.summary: The tracker failed to create or initialize its tracking session.

TrackerError.name: NoVideo
TrackerError.summary:
Video input is unavailable because no camera device was found or the
camera was disconnected.

TrackerError.name: VideoError
TrackerError.summary:
A generic video error occurred during face-tracking camera input
processing.

TrackerError.name: VideoNoPermission
TrackerError.summary: The user denied camera permission required for video-based face tracking.

TrackerError.name: VideoUnsupported
TrackerError.summary: Video-based face tracking is not supported on this device or platform.

TrackerError.name: NoAudio
TrackerError.summary:

connected.

TrackerError.name: AudioError
TrackerError.summary:
A generic audio error occurred during face-tracking audio input
processing.

TrackerError.name: AudioNoPermission
TrackerError.summary:
The user denied microphone permission required for audio-based face
tracking.

TrackerError.name: UnsupportedDevice
TrackerError.summary: The current device or platform does not support face tracking.

TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.name: ForceDisabled
TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.summary:
Disables all extrapolation so that facial animation updates only when a
new camera frame is processed.

TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.name: ExtrapolateFacsAndPose
TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.summary:
Extrapolates both FACS blend-shape values and head-pose data between
camera frames.

TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.name: ExtrapolateFacsOnly
TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.summary:
Extrapolates only FACS blend-shape values between camera frames, leaving
head-pose data unchanged.

TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.name: Auto
TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.summary:
Lets the `TrackerLodController` automatically select the extrapolation
strategy based on current performance conditions.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingSuccess
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary: Face tracking is active and a face is being tracked successfully.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingNoFaceFound
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary: The tracker is running but no face has been detected in the camera feed.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingUnknown
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary:
The face tracking state is indeterminate or could not be mapped to a known
status.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingLost
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary:
Face tracking was previously active but the face has been lost from the
camera feed.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingHasTrackingError
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary:
Face tracking is active but has encountered an error that prevents
reliable pose estimation.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingIsOccluded
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary:
A face is detected but is partially or fully occluded, reducing tracking
reliability.

TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.name: FaceTrackingUninitialized
TrackerFaceTrackingStatus.summary:
Face tracking has not yet been initialized; this is the default state
before the tracker starts.

TrackerLodFlagMode.name: ForceFalse
TrackerLodFlagMode.summary:
Forces the associated tracker feature disabled, regardless of the current
LOD state.

TrackerLodFlagMode.name: ForceTrue
TrackerLodFlagMode.summary:
Forces the associated tracker feature enabled, regardless of the current
LOD state.

TrackerLodFlagMode.name: Auto
TrackerLodFlagMode.summary: Defers the enabled/disabled decision to the automatic LOD system.

TrackerLodValueMode.name: Force0
TrackerLodValueMode.summary:
Forces the face-tracking video pipeline to LOD level 0, the faster but
less accurate processing mode.

TrackerLodValueMode.name: Force1
TrackerLodValueMode.summary:
Forces the face-tracking video pipeline to LOD level 1, the more accurate
but more resource-intensive processing mode.

TrackerLodValueMode.name: Auto
TrackerLodValueMode.summary:
The LOD controller selects the video LOD level automatically based on
real-time performance metrics.

TrackerMode.name: None
TrackerMode.summary:
No tracking inference is active; the tracker is idle or has not
successfully started.

TrackerMode.name: Audio
TrackerMode.summary:
Only audio-to-curve (lipsync) inference is active; no camera-based facial
tracking is running.

TrackerMode.name: Video
TrackerMode.summary:
Only video-to-curve facial tracking is active; audio-based lipsync
inference is not running.

TrackerMode.name: AudioVideo
TrackerMode.summary:
Both audio-to-curve lipsync inference and video-to-curve facial tracking
are active simultaneously.

TrackerPromptEvent.name: LODCameraRecommendDisable
TrackerPromptEvent.summary:
The LOD controller has determined that device performance is insufficient
to sustain camera-based face tracking and recommends disabling camera
input.

TrackerType.name: None
TrackerType.summary:
No tracking type is selected; the tracking engine does not initialize, and
attempting to start tracking with this type set raises
`TrackerError.UnsupportedDevice`.

TrackerType.name: Face
TrackerType.summary:
Enables face tracking from a connected video device (and optionally audio)
to produce FACS blendshape weights and head-orientation data each step.

TrackerType.name: UpperBody
TrackerType.summary:
Reserved for upper-body motion tracking. Setting this type raises
`TrackerError.UnsupportedDevice` on initialization.

TriStateBoolean.name: Unknown
TriStateBoolean.summary:
Indicates the condition has not yet been determined or resolved; the
default value.

TriStateBoolean.name: True
TriStateBoolean.summary: Indicates the condition is explicitly true.

TriStateBoolean.name: False
TriStateBoolean.summary: Indicates the condition is explicitly false.

TweenStatus.name: Canceled
TweenStatus.summary: The tween was cancelled before completion.

UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.name: Automatic
UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.summary:
Mimics **EntireObject** behavior for a UI object that's entirely contained
by the `BoundingUI`, or else **HitPoint**
for a UI object that's partially outside the
`BoundingUI`.

UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.name: EntireObject
UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.summary:
Bounds the entire dragged UI object within the
`BoundingUI`.

UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.name: HitPoint
UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.summary:
Bounds the dragged UI only by the exact hit/grab point and its respective
position after translation/rotation.

UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.name: Absolute
UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.summary:
Designates the input and return values as the absolute target
position/rotation in the space defined by
`DragSpace`.

UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.name: Relative
UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.summary:
Designates the input and return values as the change from the current
position/rotation in the space defined by
`DragSpace`.

UIDragDetectorDragSpace.name: Parent
UIDragDetectorDragSpace.summary:
Designates the input and return values' space as the local space of the
detector's parent `GuiObject`.

UIDragDetectorDragSpace.name: LayerCollector
UIDragDetectorDragSpace.summary:
Designates the input and return values' space as that of the
`LayerCollector`.

UIDragDetectorDragSpace.name: Reference
UIDragDetectorDragSpace.summary:
Designates the input and return values' space as that of the
`ReferenceUIInstance`. For
`DragRelativity` and
`DragUDim2` purposes, the `(0, 0)` origin
is the absolute center position of the
`ReferenceUIInstance`.

If `ReferenceUIInstance` is not
`nil`, this will behave the same as **Parent**.

UIDragDetectorDragStyle.name: TranslatePlane
UIDragDetectorDragStyle.summary: 2D motion in the plane of the `LayerCollector`.

UIDragDetectorDragStyle.name: Rotate
UIDragDetectorDragStyle.summary:
By default, rotation about the absolute center position of the detector's
parent `GuiObject`. If
`ReferenceUIInstance` is set,
rotation happens about that instance's absolute center position.

UIDragDetectorDragStyle.name: Scriptable
UIDragDetectorDragStyle.summary:
Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through
`SetDragStyleFunction()`.

UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.name: Offset
UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.summary:
Move by the `Offset` values of the detector's
parent's `GuiObject.Position` value.

UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.name: Scale
UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.summary:
Move by the `Scale` values of the detector's parent's
`GuiObject.Position` value.

UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.name: CustomOffset
UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.summary:
The UI element will not move at all, but the `Offset`
values of the detector's `DragUDim2` will
still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you
to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.name: CustomScale
UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.summary:
The UI element will not move at all, but the `Scale`
values of the detector's `DragUDim2` will
still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you
to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.name: XY
UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.summary:
Default setting for a detector's
`UIDragSpeedAxisMapping` where
the **X** and **Y** axis speeds are based off the **X** and **Y**
`Scale`/`Offset` values
respectively.

UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.name: XX
UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.summary:
Both the **X** and **Y** axis speeds are based off the **X** axis for
`Scale`, while the `Offset`
values still apply to their respective axis.

UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.name: YY
UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.summary:
Both the **X** and **Y** axis speeds are based off the **Y** axis for
`Scale`, while the `Offset`
values still apply to their respective axis.

UIFlexAlignment.name: None
UIFlexAlignment.summary: No flex behavior; siblings maintain their defined width or height.

UIFlexAlignment.name: Fill
UIFlexAlignment.summary:
Siblings resize to fill the entire parent container, overriding their
defined width or height.

UIFlexAlignment.name: SpaceAround
UIFlexAlignment.summary:
Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added on
both sides of each sibling.

UIFlexAlignment.name: SpaceBetween
UIFlexAlignment.summary:
Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added
**between** siblings, but no additional space is added **around**
siblings.

UIFlexAlignment.name: SpaceEvenly
UIFlexAlignment.summary:
Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added
both **between** and **around** siblings.

UIFlexMode.name: None
UIFlexMode.summary: The parent `GuiObject` is unaffected and neither shrinks nor grows.

UIFlexMode.name: Grow
UIFlexMode.summary:
Sets an effective `1:0` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent `GuiObject`.
Objects set to `Grow` never shrink below their basis size, so overflow may
occur if the container becomes smaller than the flex line's combined basis
size.

UIFlexMode.name: Shrink
UIFlexMode.summary:
Sets an effective `0:1` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent `GuiObject`.
Objects set to `Shrink` never grow above their basis size, so underflow
may occur if the container becomes larger than the flex line's combined
basis size.

UIFlexMode.name: Fill
UIFlexMode.summary:
Sets an effective `1:1` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent `GuiObject`.
This setting ensures the flex line always fills the container, even if the
container size changes.

UIFlexMode.name: Custom
UIFlexMode.summary:
Enables the `GrowRatio` and
`ShrinkRatio` properties for the
`UIFlexItem`, allowing for relative growth or shrinking of the
parent `GuiObject` in a ratio compared to other flex objects also
under control of a `UIFlexItem`.

UITheme.name: Light

UITheme.summary: The dark Studio UI color theme. Deprecated; has no effect.

check for completion.

UploadCaptureResult.name: UploadFailed
UploadCaptureResult.summary:
The upload completed but a backend processing error occurred, so the
capture was not saved as an asset.
