UserNewReturningStatus.name: New
UserNewReturningStatus.summary: The player is playing the experience for the first time.

UserNewReturningStatus.name: Returning
UserNewReturningStatus.summary: The player has played the experience before.

VRComfortSetting.name: Comfort
VRComfortSetting.summary:
Most restrictive comfort preset: enables vignette, disables smooth
rotation, and disables the third-person follow camera.

VRComfortSetting.name: Normal
VRComfortSetting.summary:
Default balanced preset: enables vignette and third-person follow camera
while keeping smooth rotation disabled.

VRComfortSetting.name: Expert
VRComfortSetting.summary:
Least restrictive comfort preset: disables vignette and enables both
smooth rotation and the third-person follow camera.

VRComfortSetting.name: Custom
VRComfortSetting.summary:
Lets vignette, smooth rotation, and third-person follow camera be
configured independently rather than as a fixed preset.

VRControllerModelMode.name: Disabled
VRControllerModelMode.summary: The player's VR hand controller models are not rendered.

VRControllerModelMode.name: Transparent
VRControllerModelMode.summary: The player's VR hand controller models are rendered with transparency.

VRLaserPointerMode.name: Disabled
VRLaserPointerMode.summary: The laser pointer is hidden and no pointer is rendered for any VR hand.

VRLaserPointerMode.name: Pointer
VRLaserPointerMode.summary:
A single laser pointer is shown for the primary VR hand; this is the
default value of `VRService.LaserPointer`.

VRLaserPointerMode.name: DualPointer
VRLaserPointerMode.summary: A laser pointer is shown for each VR hand simultaneously.

VRScaling.name: World
VRScaling.summary:
Adjusts `Camera.HeadScale` so that the world in VR is seen from the
avatar's perspective.

VRScaling.name: Off
VRScaling.summary:
Disables VR automatic scaling; set `Camera.HeadScale` manually if
needed.

VRSessionState.name: Undefined
VRSessionState.summary:
The VR session state is unknown or has not yet been established; the
default value of `VRSessionState`.

VRSessionState.name: Idle
VRSessionState.summary:
The VR headset is connected and ready but is not yet presenting frames to
the user.

VRSessionState.name: Visible
VRSessionState.summary:
The VR session is rendering frames visible to the user but does not yet
have XR input focus; haptic feedback is available.

VRSessionState.name: Focused
VRSessionState.summary:
The VR session has full XR input focus and is rendering visible frames;
haptic feedback is available.

VRSessionState.name: Stopping
VRSessionState.summary:
The VR session is in the process of stopping and will transition to an
inactive state.

VRTouchpadMode.name: Touch
VRTouchpadMode.summary:
The touchpad is treated as ButtonB if it is the left touchpad, or ButtonA
if it is the right touchpad.

VRTouchpadMode.name: VirtualThumbstick
VRTouchpadMode.summary: The touchpad will function as a gamepad joystick.

VRTouchpadMode.name: ABXY
VRTouchpadMode.summary:
The touchpad will function as a means of inputting the standard ABXY
gamepad input, dividing it up into 4 diagonal pie slices.

VelocityConstraintMode.name: Line
VelocityConstraintMode.summary:
The velocity component in the direction of the line is constrained to the
specified value. The line direction is based on the
`RelativeTo` property:

- `Attachment0` - The line direction is the
  primary axis of `Attachment0`.
- `Attachment1` - The line direction is the
  primary axis of `Attachment1`.
- `World` - The line direction must be specified.

VelocityConstraintMode.name: Plane
VelocityConstraintMode.summary:
The velocity components in the plane are constrained to the specified
values. The plane tangents are based on the
`RelativeTo` property:

- `Attachment0` - The plane tangents are the two
  axes of `Attachment0`.
- `Attachment1` - The plane tangents are the two
  axes of `Attachment1`.
- `World` - The two plane tangents must be
  specified

VelocityConstraintMode.name: Vector
VelocityConstraintMode.summary:
The velocity components must be equal to the vector components specified.
The coordinate system of the vector is based on the
`RelativeTo` property:

- `Attachment0` - The vector components are in the
  coordinate system defined by the axes of
  `Attachment0`.
- `Attachment1` - The vector components are in the
  coordinate system defined by the axes of
  `Attachment1`.
- `World` - The coordinate system is in the world
  and the vector components must be specified.

VerifiedLevel.name: Low
VerifiedLevel.summary:
Requires the player to meet the low verification level or higher. This is
the default value for `Player:IsVerified()`.

VerifiedLevel.name: High
VerifiedLevel.summary: Requires the player to meet the high verification level.

VerticalAlignment.name: Center
VerticalAlignment.summary: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the **Y** axis.

VerticalAlignment.name: Top
VerticalAlignment.summary: Grid is aligned to the top edge of its parent.

VerticalAlignment.name: Bottom
VerticalAlignment.summary: Grid is aligned to the bottom edge of its parent.

VibrationMotor.name: LeftHand
VibrationMotor.summary: Left hand motor for VR devices.

VibrationMotor.name: RightHand
VibrationMotor.summary: Right hand motor for VR devices.

VideoCaptureResult.name: Success
VideoCaptureResult.summary: Video capture ended normally without any errors.

VideoCaptureResult.name: OtherError
VideoCaptureResult.summary: Video capture stopped due to an unspecified internal error.

VideoCaptureResult.name: ScreenSizeChanged
VideoCaptureResult.summary:
Video capture was interrupted because the screen dimensions changed while
recording was in progress.

VideoCaptureResult.name: TimeLimitReached
VideoCaptureResult.summary:
Video capture was stopped automatically because the maximum allowed
recording duration was reached.

VideoCaptureStartedResult.name: OtherError
VideoCaptureStartedResult.summary: Video capture failed due to an unspecified internal error.

VideoCaptureStartedResult.name: CapturingAlready
VideoCaptureStartedResult.summary:
A video capture session is already in progress and a new one cannot be
started.

VideoCaptureStartedResult.name: NoDeviceSupport
VideoCaptureStartedResult.summary: The device does not have the required capture capabilities.

VideoCaptureStartedResult.name: NoSpaceOnDevice
VideoCaptureStartedResult.summary:
The device does not have sufficient storage space available to begin
capturing video.

VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.name: Low
VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.summary:
Captures at a reduced quality to lower resource usage on constrained or
mobile platforms.

VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.name: Medium
VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.summary: Captures at a balanced quality suitable for most use cases.

VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.name: High
VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.summary: Captures at the highest available quality.

VideoError.name: Ok
VideoError.summary: The video operation completed successfully without error.

VideoError.name: Eof
VideoError.summary: The end of the video stream or file has been reached.

VideoError.name: EAgain
VideoError.summary:
No data is available at this moment; the caller should retry the
operation.

VideoError.name: BadParameter
VideoError.summary: An invalid or out-of-range parameter was supplied to the video operation.

VideoError.name: AllocFailed
VideoError.summary: A memory allocation required for the video operation failed.

VideoError.name: CodecInitFailed
VideoError.summary: The video codec failed to initialize.

VideoError.name: CodecCloseFailed
VideoError.summary: The video codec failed to shut down cleanly.

VideoError.name: DecodeFailed
VideoError.summary: The video decoder failed to decode a frame from the stream.

VideoError.name: ParsingFailed
VideoError.summary: Parsing the video stream or container format failed.

VideoError.name: Unsupported
VideoError.summary: The requested video operation or format is not supported on this platform.

VideoError.name: Generic
VideoError.summary: A generic or unclassified error occurred in the video subsystem.

VideoError.name: DownloadFailed
VideoError.summary: The video asset could not be downloaded.

VideoError.name: StreamNotFound
VideoError.summary: The requested video stream could not be found.

VideoError.name: EncodeFailed
VideoError.summary: The video encoder failed to encode a frame.

VideoError.name: CreateFailed
VideoError.summary: Creating a required video resource or object failed.

VideoError.name: NoPermission
VideoError.summary:
The video operation was denied because the required permission, such as
camera access, has not been granted.

VideoError.name: NoService
VideoError.summary: The required video service is unavailable on this device or platform.

VideoError.name: Unknown
VideoError.summary:
An unknown or unrecognized error occurred; this value covers errors that
have no specific classification in this enum.

VideoSampleSize.name: Small
VideoSampleSize.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly a quarter of the screen.

VideoSampleSize.name: Medium
VideoSampleSize.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly half the screen.

VideoSampleSize.name: Large
VideoSampleSize.summary:
Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly three quarters of the
screen.

VideoSampleSize.name: Full
VideoSampleSize.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed full screen.

ViewMode.name: None
ViewMode.summary:
Disables the debug rendering visualization overlay; the default value of
`RenderSettings.ViewMode`.

ViewMode.name: GeometryComplexity
ViewMode.summary:
Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting geometric complexity
across rendered surfaces.

ViewMode.name: Transparent
ViewMode.summary:
Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting surfaces rendered with
transparency.

ViewMode.name: Decal
ViewMode.summary:
Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting surfaces rendered with
decals.

VirtualCursorMode.name: Default
VirtualCursorMode.summary: The Virtual Cursor is in the default state.

VirtualInputMode.name: None
VirtualInputMode.summary:
The `VirtualInputManager` is idle and neither recording nor playing
back input.

VirtualInputMode.name: Recording
VirtualInputMode.summary:
The `VirtualInputManager` is actively capturing input events into a
sequence.

VirtualInputMode.name: Playing
VirtualInputMode.summary:
The `VirtualInputManager` is replaying a previously recorded input
sequence.

VoiceChatDistanceAttenuationType.name: Inverse
VoiceChatDistanceAttenuationType.summary:
Represents a distance attenuation curve that follows the inverse-squared
law. This is identical to the default distance attenuation of an
`AudioEmitter` instance.

VoiceChatDistanceAttenuationType.name: Legacy
VoiceChatDistanceAttenuationType.summary:
Represents a linear-squared distance attenuation curve with a minimum
distance of `7` and a maximum distance of `80`. This is identical to the
distance attenuation used in the internal-only default voice setup that
does not use `AudioDeviceInput` and `AudioEmitter` objects.

VoiceChatState.name: Idle
VoiceChatState.summary:
The player is not connected to voice chat and no join attempt is in
progress.

VoiceChatState.name: Joining
VoiceChatState.summary: A voice chat join attempt is in progress for the first time.

VoiceChatState.name: JoiningRetry
VoiceChatState.summary:
A voice chat join is being retried after a previous attempt did not
succeed.

VoiceChatState.name: Joined
VoiceChatState.summary:
The player has successfully joined the voice chat session and is actively
connected.

VoiceChatState.name: Leaving
VoiceChatState.summary: The player is in the process of disconnecting from the voice chat session.

VoiceChatState.name: Ended
VoiceChatState.summary: The voice chat session has ended normally.

VoiceChatState.name: Failed
VoiceChatState.summary:
The voice chat session ended due to an error, such as a failure to join or
a mid-session error.

VoiceControlPath.name: Publish
VoiceControlPath.summary:
Represents the outbound audio path, through which a client sends local
microphone audio to the room.

VoiceControlPath.name: Subscribe
VoiceControlPath.summary:
Represents the inbound audio path, through which a client receives remote
participants' audio streams.

VoiceControlPath.name: Join
VoiceControlPath.summary:
Represents the room-join path, through which a client establishes
membership in a voice room.

VolumetricAudio.name: Disabled
VolumetricAudio.summary: Volumetric audio is disabled; sound emanates from a single point.

VolumetricAudio.name: Enabled
VolumetricAudio.summary: Volumetric audio is enabled; sound emanates from the object's volume.

WaterDirection.name: NegX
WaterDirection.summary: The negative X-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterDirection.name: X
WaterDirection.summary: The positive X-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterDirection.name: NegY
WaterDirection.summary: The negative Y-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterDirection.name: Y
WaterDirection.summary: The positive Y-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterDirection.name: NegZ
WaterDirection.summary: The negative Z-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterDirection.name: Z
WaterDirection.summary: The positive Z-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterForce.name: None
WaterForce.summary: No flow force on a legacy voxel terrain water cell; the water is still.

WaterForce.name: Small
WaterForce.summary: A low flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell.

WaterForce.name: Medium
WaterForce.summary:
A moderate flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell, between
`WaterForce.Small` and `WaterForce.Strong`.

WaterForce.name: Strong
WaterForce.summary:
A high flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell, one step
below `WaterForce.Max`.

WaterForce.name: Max
WaterForce.summary: The maximum flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell.

WebStreamClientState.name: Connecting
WebStreamClientState.summary:
The client has sent a request to connect with the server and is waiting
for a response.

WebStreamClientState.name: Open
WebStreamClientState.summary:
The client is connected to the server, allowing for data to be streamed
between the server and client.

WebStreamClientState.name: Error
WebStreamClientState.summary:
An unrecoverable error has occured while setting up the connection
orduring the connection lifetime, cutting off the stream.

WebStreamClientState.name: Closed
WebStreamClientState.summary:
The connection has run to completion without issues, either closed
naturally by the server or manually by the user.

WebStreamClientType.name: SSE
WebStreamClientType.summary:
Traditional Server-Sent Events (SSE) client. Requires `text/event-stream`
to be returned in the `Content-Type` header. Messages in the stream will
follow the
[event stream format](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events#event_stream_format).

WebStreamClientType.name: RawStream
WebStreamClientType.summary:
General purpose HTTP streaming client. It can connect to any server that
provides streaming data transfer (e.g.
[chunked encoding](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Transfer-Encoding)).
It provides no guarantees about the stream format.

WebStreamClientType.name: WebSocket
WebStreamClientType.summary:
[WebSocket](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WebSocket) client that provides
a bidirectional communication channel over a TCP connection.

WeldConstraintPreserve.name: All
WeldConstraintPreserve.summary:
All `WeldConstraints` will be returned in the
recommended table.

WeldConstraintPreserve.name: None
WeldConstraintPreserve.summary:
`WeldConstraints` will be ignored and not returned in
the recommended table.

WeldConstraintPreserve.name: Touching
WeldConstraintPreserve.summary:
Only `WeldConstraints` that connect touching parts in
the performed operation will be returned in the recommended table.

WhenUserFirstPlayed.name: Days0To30
WhenUserFirstPlayed.summary: The player first played the experience within the last 30 days.

WhenUserFirstPlayed.name: Days31To90
WhenUserFirstPlayed.summary: The player first played the experience between 31 and 90 days ago.

WhenUserFirstPlayed.name: Days91To180
WhenUserFirstPlayed.summary: The player first played the experience between 91 and 180 days ago.

WhenUserFirstPlayed.name: Days181To365
WhenUserFirstPlayed.summary: The player first played the experience between 181 and 365 days ago.

WhenUserFirstPlayed.name: Days366Plus
WhenUserFirstPlayed.summary: The player first played the experience more than 365 days ago.

WhisperChatPrivacyMode.name: AllUsers
WhisperChatPrivacyMode.summary:
The player allows any other player in the experience to initiate a whisper
chat with them.

WhisperChatPrivacyMode.name: NoOne
WhisperChatPrivacyMode.summary:
The player does not allow any other player to initiate a whisper chat with
them.

WrapLayerAutoSkin.name: Disabled
WrapLayerAutoSkin.summary:
No automatic skinning transfer is applied; the accessory uses its authored
skinning data as-is, and an unskinned mesh will not deform with the
character.

WrapLayerAutoSkin.name: EnabledPreserve
WrapLayerAutoSkin.summary:
Applies automatic skinning transfer only when the mesh has no existing
skinning data; otherwise the authored weights are kept.

WrapLayerAutoSkin.name: EnabledOverride
WrapLayerAutoSkin.summary:
Unconditionally overrides all skinning weights by running the cage-based
skinning transfer algorithm, regardless of whether the mesh was originally
skinned.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: None
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary: This debug rendering mode does nothing. This is the default value.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: BoundCage
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
This debug mode visualizes corresponding cage mesh vertices bound to an
underlying `WrapTarget`. In order to find corresponding vertices
between different cages, the Wrap Deformer algorithm uses UV matching. As
long as your `WrapLayer` cage mesh share the same UV layout as
`WrapTarget`, its vertices will be marked as "bound".

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: LayerCage
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
This debug mode shows the resulting layer mesh as a whole. The deformer
will use vertex locations from the previous layer for all unbound
vertices.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: BoundCageAndLinks
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
The same as BoundCage but also visualizes how bound vertices were moved.
You can use this mode to identify where they belong on a previous layer
and where they are located on the current layer.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: Reference
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary: This debug mode shows the original inner cage mesh as it was created.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: Rbf
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate
the wrap deformer's expected behavior by looking at this state. All
renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere"
along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: OuterCage
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary: This debug mode shows the original outer cage mesh as it was created.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: ReferenceMeshAfterMorph
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Renders the layer's outer cage after the morph step that aligns it to the
previous layer's outer cage surface, prior to HSR processing.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: HSROuterDetail
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Interactive mode that highlights the render-mesh triangle under the cursor
and draws the corresponding outer cage vertices on the layer above using
HSR association data.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: HSROuter
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Highlights outer cage vertices that HSR associates with visible
render-mesh faces.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: HSRInner
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Highlights inner cage vertices that Hidden Surface Removal (HSR)
classifies as occluded by the clothing layer above, drawn at the previous
layer's outer-cage positions.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: HSRInnerReverse
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Highlights inner cage vertices that HSR classifies as visible (not
occluded), the complement of `WrapLayerDebugMode.HSRInner`.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: LayerCageFittedToBase
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Renders the layer's outer cage at positions from fitting it to the base
body mesh (rest pose), shown as spheres and wireframe edges.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: LayerCageFittedToPrev
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Renders the layer's outer cage at positions from fitting it to the
previous layer's deformed shape, shown as spheres and wireframe edges.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: PreWrapDeformerOuterCage
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Draws each outer cage vertex that moved during deformation as a sphere at
its pre-deformation position connected by a line to its post-deformation
position.

WrapLayerDebugMode.name: SkinningTransfer
WrapLayerDebugMode.summary:
Visualizes per-vertex skinning weight transfer for the layer mesh, drawing
lines from each mesh vertex to its influencing skeleton joints.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: None
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary: This debug rendering mode does nothing, and this is the default value.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: TargetCageOriginal
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary: This debug mode shows the original cage mesh as it was created.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: TargetCageCompressed
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
This debug mode shows corresponding cage mesh compressed by clothing
layers above it. This debug mode is intended to validate that the
compression algorithm and corresponding cages work as intended.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: TargetCageInterface
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
This debug mode shows the resulting cage mesh for the corresponding Wrap
Instance. This debug mode is intended to validate that the final deformed
cage looks as intended.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: TargetLayerCageOriginal
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
The same as TargetCageOriginal but affects all WrapTargets that belong to
the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular
WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: TargetLayerCageCompressed
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
The same as TargetCageCompressed but affects all WrapTargets that belong
to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular
WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: TargetLayerInterface
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
The same as TargetCageInterface but affects all WrapTargets that belong to
the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular
WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: Rbf
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate
the wrap deformer expected behavior by looking at this state. All
renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere"
along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: OuterCageDetail
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
Visualizes outer cage vertices and related cage faces when hovering a mesh
triangle in Studio.

WrapTargetDebugMode.name: PreWrapDeformerCage
WrapTargetDebugMode.summary:
Renders the outer cage as wireframe with vertex markers in its
pre-deformation state.

ZIndexBehavior.name: Global
ZIndexBehavior.summary:
The ZIndex property overrides the default value computed from the depth in
the hierarchy.

ZIndexBehavior.name: Sibling
ZIndexBehavior.summary:
The ZIndex property controls the order in which the GuiObject renders
relative to its siblings.
